=== PATH: D:\Work\car_rental_service\frontend\src\App.jsx ===
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './context/AuthContext';
import { BookingProvider } from './context/BookingContext';

import HomePage from './pages/HomePage';
import SegmentSelectPage from './pages/booking/SegmentSelectPage';   // ← CHANGED (was CarModelSelectPage)
import VendorSelectPage from './pages/booking/VendorSelectPage';
import ReturnVendorPage from './pages/booking/ReturnVendorPage';
import AddonsPage from './pages/booking/AddonsPage';
import ConfirmBookingPage from './pages/booking/ConfirmBookingPage';
import CustomerDashboard from './pages/CustomerDashboard/CustomerDashboard';
import VendorDashboard from './pages/VendorDashboard/VendorDashboard';
import AdminDashboard from './pages/AdminDashboard/AdminDashboard';
import AuthModal from './components/auth/AuthModal';

function RequireAuth({ children, role }) {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();
  const [showAuth, setShowAuth] = useState(false);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        minHeight: '100vh', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center', background: 'var(--clr-bg)',
        color: 'var(--clr-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-body)',
      }}>
        Loading…
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!user) {
    return (
      <>
        <div style={{
          minHeight: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 24,
          background: 'var(--clr-bg)',
        }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 48 }}>🔐</div>
          <h2 style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-display)', color: 'var(--clr-text)', fontSize: 28 }}>
            Sign in required
          </h2>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--clr-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-body)' }}>
            Please sign in to access this page.
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAuth(true)}
            style={{
              background: 'var(--clr-accent)', color: '#000', fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: 15, padding: '14px 36px', borderRadius: '32px',
              border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'var(--font-body)',
            }}
          >
            Sign In
          </button>
        </div>
        {showAuth && <AuthModal onClose={() => setShowAuth(false)} />}
      </>
    );
  }

  if (role && user.role !== role) {
    return (
      <Navigate
        to={user.role === 'admin' ? '/admin' : user.role === 'vendor' ? '/vendor' : '/customer'}
        replace
      />
    );
  }

  return children;
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <AuthProvider>
        <BookingProvider>
          <Routes>
            {/* Public homepage */}
            <Route path="/" element={<HomePage />} />

            {/* ── Booking wizard ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
            {/* Step 1: Segment selection (replaces CarModelSelectPage) */}
            <Route path="/book/select-car"    element={<SegmentSelectPage />} />
            {/* Step 2: Browse vehicles & choose vendor (now segment-aware) */}
            <Route path="/book/select-vendor" element={<VendorSelectPage />} />
            {/* Step 3 (one-way only): Choose return vendor */}
            <Route path="/book/return-vendor" element={<ReturnVendorPage />} />
            {/* Step 3/4: Add-ons & pricing */}
            <Route path="/book/addons"        element={<AddonsPage />} />
            {/* Step 4/5: Confirm & pay (auth required) */}
            <Route path="/book/confirm"       element={<RequireAuth><ConfirmBookingPage /></RequireAuth>} />

            {/* ── Role dashboards ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
            <Route path="/customer" element={<RequireAuth role="customer"><CustomerDashboard /></RequireAuth>} />
            <Route path="/vendor"   element={<RequireAuth role="vendor"><VendorDashboard /></RequireAuth>} />
            <Route path="/admin"    element={<RequireAuth role="admin"><AdminDashboard /></RequireAuth>} />

            {/* Catch-all */}
            <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
          </Routes>
        </BookingProvider>
      </AuthProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
    getActiveAgreement,
    getAgreementVersion,
    getMyAgreementHistory,
    signAgreement,
} from '../../services/api';
import './AgreementModal.css';

// ── Shared: Spinner ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Spinner({ size = 18 }) {
    return (
        <span
            className="agr-spinner"
            style={{ width: size, height: size }}
            aria-hidden="true"
        />
    );
}

// ── Shared: Markdown-ish content renderer ──────────────────────────────
// Renders the text returned by the backend.
// Supports: # H1, ## H2, numbered lists, blank lines, plain paragraphs.
function AgreementContent({ content }) {
    if (!content) return null;
    const lines = content.split('\n');
    return (
        <div className="agr-content">
            {lines.map((line, i) => {
                if (line.startsWith('# '))
                    return <h2 key={i} className="agr-h1">{line.slice(2)}</h2>;
                if (line.startsWith('## '))
                    return <h3 key={i} className="agr-h2">{line.slice(3)}</h3>;
                if (/^\d+\./.test(line))
                    return <p key={i} className="agr-numbered">{line}</p>;
                if (line.trim() === '')
                    return <div key={i} className="agr-spacer" />;
                return <p key={i} className="agr-p">{line}</p>;
            })}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Shared: Version badge ───────────────────────────────────────────────
function VersionBadge({ versionTag, isActive }) {
    return (
        <span className={`agr-version-badge${isActive ? ' agr-version-badge--active' : ''}`}>
            {isActive && <span className="agr-version-dot" />}
            {versionTag}
            {isActive && <span className="agr-version-live">LIVE</span>}
        </span>
    );
}

// ── Shared: Method badge ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MethodBadge({ otpVerified }) {
    return (
        <span className={`agr-method-badge ${otpVerified ? 'otp' : 'checkbox'}`}>
            {otpVerified ? '🔐 OTP Verified' : '☑ Checkbox'}
        </span>
    );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SIGN MODAL
// Opens when a customer clicks "View & Sign Agreement" on a booking.
// 1. Fetches active version from backend
// 2. Displays T&C (must scroll to bottom to enable signing)
// 3. OTP send → OTP verify → create acceptance record on backend
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function AgreementSignModal({ booking, onSigned, onClose, showToast }) {
    // phase: loading | error | reading | otp_pending | done
    const [phase, setPhase] = useState('loading');
    const [version, setVersion] = useState(null);
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
    const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState('');
    const [otpBusy, setOtpBusy] = useState(false);
    const bodyRef = useRef(null);
    const otpInputRef = useRef(null);

    // Fetch active version on mount
    useEffect(() => {
        getActiveAgreement()
            .then(({ data }) => {
                setVersion(data);
                setPhase('reading');
            })
            .catch(err => {
                setError(err.response?.data?.error ||
                    'Could not load the agreement. Please try again.');
                setPhase('error');
            });
    }, []);

    // Auto-focus OTP input when phase changes
    useEffect(() => {
        if (phase === 'otp_pending' && otpInputRef.current) {
            setTimeout(() => otpInputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
        }
    }, [phase]);

    // Detect scroll-to-bottom
    const handleScroll = useCallback(() => {
        const el = bodyRef.current;
        if (el && el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight >= el.scrollHeight - 32) {
            setScrolled(true);
        }
    }, []);

    // Step 1 — send OTP
    const handleSendOtp = useCallback(async () => {
        setOtpBusy(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await signAgreement(booking.id, 'send', null);
            // Version mismatch guard: if the active version changed since we
            // loaded the modal, reload it so the user sees the correct content.
            if (data.version_id && version && data.version_id !== version.id) {
                showToast('The agreement was just updated. Please review again.', 'error');
                setScrolled(false);
                setPhase('loading');
                getActiveAgreement().then(({ data: v }) => {
                    setVersion(v);
                    setPhase('reading');
                });
                setOtpBusy(false);
                return;
            }
            setPhase('otp_pending');
            showToast('OTP sent to your registered email.');
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to send OTP.', 'error');
        } finally {
            setOtpBusy(false);
        }
    }, [booking.id, version, showToast]);

    // Step 2 — verify OTP (backend creates the acceptance record)
    const handleVerifyOtp = useCallback(async () => {
        if (otpCode.length !== 6) {
            showToast('Please enter the 6-digit OTP.', 'error');
            return;
        }
        setOtpBusy(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await signAgreement(
                booking.id, 'verify', otpCode, version?.id
            );
            setPhase('done');
            showToast(`Agreement signed! (${data.version_tag})`);
            onSigned?.({
                versionTag: data.version_tag,
                versionId: data.version_id,
                acceptanceId: data.acceptance_id,
                acceptedAt: data.accepted_at,
            });
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Invalid OTP. Please try again.', 'error');
        } finally {
            setOtpBusy(false);
        }
    }, [booking.id, otpCode, version, showToast, onSigned]);

    const handleOtpKeyDown = (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') handleVerifyOtp();
    };

    return (
        <div
            className="agr-backdrop"
            onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="Rental Agreement"
        >
            <div className="agr-modal">

                {/* Header */}
                <div className="agr-modal__head">
                    <div className="agr-modal__head-left">
                        <span className="agr-modal__icon" aria-hidden="true">📄</span>
                        <div>
                            <h2 className="agr-modal__title">Rental Agreement</h2>
                            {version && (
                                <VersionBadge
                                    versionTag={version.version_tag}
                                    isActive={version.is_active}
                                />
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                        className="agr-modal__close"
                        onClick={onClose}
                        aria-label="Close"
                    >
                        ✕
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* Loading */}
                {phase === 'loading' && (
                    <div className="agr-modal__body agr-modal__body--center">
                        <Spinner size={28} />
                        <span className="agr-loading-text">Loading agreement…</span>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* Error */}
                {phase === 'error' && (
                    <div className="agr-modal__body agr-modal__body--center">
                        <div className="agr-error">⚠ {error}</div>
                        <button
                            className="agr-btn agr-btn--primary"
                            onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                        >
                            Retry
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* Reading / OTP pending */}
                {(phase === 'reading' || phase === 'otp_pending') && version && (
                    <>
                        {/* Summary strip */}
                        {version.summary && (
                            <div className="agr-summary">
                                <span className="agr-summary__icon" aria-hidden="true">💡</span>
                                <p>{version.summary}</p>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Effective date */}
                        <div className="agr-effective-bar">
                            <span>📅 Effective from</span>
                            <strong>
                                {new Date(version.effective_from).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
                                    day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric',
                                })}
                            </strong>
                        </div>

                        {/* Scrollable content */}
                        <div
                            className="agr-modal__body agr-modal__body--scroll"
                            ref={bodyRef}
                            onScroll={handleScroll}
                        >
                            <AgreementContent content={version.content} />
                        </div>

                        {/* Scroll nudge */}
                        {!scrolled && (
                            <div className="agr-scroll-hint" role="status">
                                <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span>
                                Please scroll through the entire agreement before signing
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {/* OTP input */}
                        {phase === 'otp_pending' && (
                            <div className="agr-otp-bar">
                                <div className="agr-otp-bar__label">
                                    <span aria-hidden="true">🔐</span>
                                    Enter the OTP sent to your registered email
                                </div>
                                <div className="agr-otp-bar__inputs">
                                    <input
                                        ref={otpInputRef}
                                        className="agr-otp-input"
                                        type="text"
                                        inputMode="numeric"
                                        maxLength={6}
                                        placeholder="● ● ● ● ● ●"
                                        value={otpCode}
                                        onChange={e =>
                                            setOtpCode(
                                                e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6)
                                            )
                                        }
                                        onKeyDown={handleOtpKeyDown}
                                        aria-label="OTP code"
                                    />
                                    <button
                                        className="agr-btn agr-btn--ghost agr-btn--sm"
                                        onClick={handleSendOtp}
                                        disabled={otpBusy}
                                    >
                                        Resend
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Footer */}
                        <div className="agr-modal__foot">
                            <button className="agr-btn agr-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>
                                Cancel
                            </button>

                            {phase === 'reading' ? (
                                <button
                                    className={`agr-btn agr-btn--primary${!scrolled ? ' agr-btn--disabled' : ''}`}
                                    onClick={handleSendOtp}
                                    disabled={!scrolled || otpBusy}
                                    title={!scrolled
                                        ? 'Scroll to the bottom to enable signing'
                                        : undefined}
                                >
                                    {otpBusy && <Spinner size={14} />}
                                    {otpBusy ? 'Sending OTP…' : '✓ I Accept — Send OTP to Sign'}
                                </button>
                            ) : (
                                <button
                                    className="agr-btn agr-btn--primary"
                                    onClick={handleVerifyOtp}
                                    disabled={otpCode.length !== 6 || otpBusy}
                                >
                                    {otpBusy && <Spinner size={14} />}
                                    {otpBusy ? 'Signing…' : 'Verify OTP & Sign Agreement'}
                                </button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </>
                )}

                {/* Success screen */}
                {phase === 'done' && (
                    <div className="agr-modal__body agr-modal__body--center">
                        <div className="agr-success-icon" aria-hidden="true">✅</div>
                        <h3 className="agr-success-title">Agreement Signed!</h3>
                        <p className="agr-success-sub">
                            Your digital signature has been recorded. You can view
                            the signed agreement from your booking details at any time.
                        </p>
                        {version && (
                            <VersionBadge
                                versionTag={version.version_tag}
                                isActive={version.is_active}
                            />
                        )}
                        <button
                            className="agr-btn agr-btn--primary"
                            onClick={onClose}
                        >
                            Continue
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VIEW MODAL (read-only, post-sign)
// Fetches the exact version that was signed using the acceptance record.
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function AgreementViewModal({ booking, acceptance, onClose }) {
    const [version, setVersion] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState('');

    useEffect(() => {
        const versionId =
            acceptance?.agreement_version_id ||
            booking?.agreement_version_id;

        if (!versionId) {
            // Fallback: show the active version
            getActiveAgreement()
                .then(({ data }) => setVersion(data))
                .catch(() => setError('Could not load agreement.'))
                .finally(() => setLoading(false));
            return;
        }

        getAgreementVersion(versionId)
            .then(({ data }) => setVersion(data))
            .catch(() => setError('Could not load the signed version.'))
            .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, [acceptance, booking]);

    return (
        <div
            className="agr-backdrop"
            onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="Signed Agreement"
        >
            <div className="agr-modal agr-modal--view">

                {/* Header */}
                <div className="agr-modal__head">
                    <div className="agr-modal__head-left">
                        <span className="agr-modal__icon" aria-hidden="true">📋</span>
                        <div>
                            <h2 className="agr-modal__title">Signed Agreement</h2>
                            {version && (
                                <VersionBadge
                                    versionTag={version.version_tag}
                                    isActive={version.is_active}
                                />
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                        className="agr-modal__close"
                        onClick={onClose}
                        aria-label="Close"
                    >
                        ✕
                    </button>
                </div>

                {loading && (
                    <div className="agr-modal__body agr-modal__body--center">
                        <Spinner size={28} />
                        <span className="agr-loading-text">Loading signed agreement…</span>
                    </div>
                )}

                {!loading && error && (
                    <div className="agr-modal__body agr-modal__body--center">
                        <div className="agr-error">⚠ {error}</div>
                    </div>
                )}

                {!loading && !error && version && acceptance && (
                    <>
                        {/* Signed confirmation banner */}
                        <div className="agr-signed-banner">
                            <span className="agr-signed-banner__icon" aria-hidden="true">✅</span>
                            <div className="agr-signed-banner__body">
                                <strong>Digitally Signed</strong>
                                <span>
                                    {new Date(acceptance.accepted_at).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
                                        day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric',
                                        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="agr-signed-banner__meta">
                                <MethodBadge otpVerified={acceptance.otp_verified} />
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Signature metadata block */}
                        <div className="agr-sig-block">
                            {[
                                ['Signed By', acceptance.user_email || booking?.customer?.email || '—'],
                                ['Booking', acceptance.booking_ref || booking?.booking_ref || '—'],
                                ['Agreement', version.version_tag],
                                ['Date & Time', acceptance.accepted_at
                                    ? new Date(acceptance.accepted_at).toLocaleString('en-IN')
                                    : '—'],
                                ['IP Address', acceptance.ip_address || '—'],
                            ].map(([label, value]) => (
                                <div key={label} className="agr-sig-block__row">
                                    <span>{label}</span>
                                    <strong
                                        style={{
                                            fontFamily:
                                                label === 'Agreement' || label === 'IP Address'
                                                    ? 'DM Mono, monospace'
                                                    : 'inherit',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {value}
                                    </strong>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>

                        {/* Full content */}
                        <div className="agr-modal__body agr-modal__body--scroll">
                            <AgreementContent content={version.content} />
                        </div>
                    </>
                )}

                <div className="agr-modal__foot">
                    <button className="agr-btn agr-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>
                        Close
                    </button>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// HISTORY TAB
// Shows the customer's full acceptance history (used inside CustomerDashboard
// under the "agreements" sidebar tab).
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function AgreementHistoryTab() {
    const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const [viewAcceptance, setViewAcceptance] = useState(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        getMyAgreementHistory()
            .then(({ data }) => setHistory(data.results || data))
            .catch(e => setError(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not load history.'))
            .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, []);

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="agr-history-loading">
                <Spinner />
                <span>Loading history…</span>
            </div>
        );
    }

    if (error) {
        return <div className="agr-error">⚠ {error}</div>;
    }

    if (history.length === 0) {
        return (
            <div className="agr-history-empty">
                <span style={{ fontSize: 36 }} aria-hidden="true">📄</span>
                <p>No agreement signatures yet.</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: 12, opacity: 0.6 }}>
                    Signed agreements will appear here after you confirm a booking.
                </p>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <>
            <div className="agr-history">
                <div className="agr-history__head">
                    <h3>Agreement Signature History</h3>
                    <p>{history.length} record{history.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="agr-history__list">
                    {history.map(acc => (
                        <div key={acc.id} className="agr-history__item">
                            <div className="agr-history__item-left">
                                <span className="agr-history__item-version">
                                    {acc.version_tag}
                                </span>
                                <span className="agr-history__item-title">
                                    {acc.version_title}
                                </span>
                                {acc.booking_ref && (
                                    <span className="agr-history__item-booking">
                                        Booking: <span>{acc.booking_ref}</span>
                                    </span>
                                )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="agr-history__item-right">
                                <span className="agr-history__item-date">
                                    {new Date(acc.accepted_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
                                        day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric',
                                    })}
                                </span>
                                <span className="agr-history__item-time">
                                    {new Date(acc.accepted_at).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', {
                                        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
                                    })}
                                </span>
                                <MethodBadge otpVerified={acc.otp_verified} />
                                <button
                                    className="agr-btn agr-btn--ghost agr-btn--sm"
                                    onClick={() => setViewAcceptance(acc)}
                                >
                                    View
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>

            {viewAcceptance && (
                <AgreementViewModal
                    acceptance={viewAcceptance}
                    onClose={() => setViewAcceptance(null)}
                />
            )}
        </>
    );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { registerCustomer, registerVendor } from '../../services/api';
import './AuthModal.css';

// ── Mini components ────────────────────────────────────────
const InputField = ({ label, icon, type = 'text', value, onChange, placeholder, required, autoComplete }) => {
    const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
    const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false);
    const isPw = type === 'password';
    return (
        <div className={`am-field${focused ? ' am-field--focused' : ''}${value ? ' am-field--filled' : ''}`}>
            {icon && <span className="am-field__icon">{icon}</span>}
            <div className="am-field__wrap">
                <label className="am-field__label">{label}</label>
                <input
                    className="am-field__input"
                    type={isPw && showPw ? 'text' : type}
                    value={value}
                    onChange={onChange}
                    placeholder={placeholder}
                    required={required}
                    autoComplete={autoComplete}
                    onFocus={() => setFocused(true)}
                    onBlur={() => setFocused(false)}
                />
            </div>
            {isPw && (
                <button type="button" className="am-field__toggle"
                    onClick={() => setShowPw(s => !s)}
                    tabIndex={-1}>
                    {showPw ? eyeOffIcon : eyeIcon}
                </button>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

// ── Main Modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function AuthModal({ onClose, onSuccess }) {
    const { login } = useAuth();
    const [view, setView] = useState('login'); // login | customer | vendor
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        email: '', password: '', password2: '', full_name: '', phone: '',
        business_name: '', gstin: '',
    });

    const backdropRef = useRef(null);
    const s = k => e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.value }));

    // Trap focus / ESC close
    useEffect(() => {
        const onKey = e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    }, [onClose]);

    // Reset error on tab change
    useEffect(() => { setError(''); setSuccess(''); }, [view]);

    const handleLogin = async e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setLoading(true); setError('');
        try {
            await login(form.email, form.password);
            setSuccess('Signed in!');
            setTimeout(() => { onSuccess?.(); onClose(); }, 500);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Invalid email or password.');
        } finally { setLoading(false); }
    };

    const handleCustomer = async e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (form.password !== form.password2) { setError('Passwords do not match.'); return; }
        setLoading(true); setError('');
        try {
            await registerCustomer({
                email: form.email, password: form.password, password2: form.password2,
                full_name: form.full_name, phone: form.phone,
            });
            await login(form.email, form.password);
            setSuccess('Account created!');
            setTimeout(() => { onSuccess?.(); onClose(); }, 500);
        } catch (err) {
            const d = err.response?.data;
            setError(typeof d === 'object' ? Object.values(d).flat().join(' ') : 'Registration failed.');
        } finally { setLoading(false); }
    };

    const handleVendor = async e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (form.password !== form.password2) { setError('Passwords do not match.'); return; }
        setLoading(true); setError('');
        try {
            await registerVendor({
                email: form.email, password: form.password, password2: form.password2,
                full_name: form.full_name, phone: form.phone,
                business_name: form.business_name, gstin: form.gstin,
            });
            await login(form.email, form.password);
            setSuccess('Vendor account created!');
            setTimeout(() => { onClose(); }, 600);
        } catch (err) {
            const d = err.response?.data;
            setError(typeof d === 'object' ? Object.values(d).flat().join(' ') : 'Registration failed.');
        } finally { setLoading(false); }
    };

    const PANEL_COPY = {
        login: { title: 'Welcome back.', sub: 'Sign in to manage your bookings, loyalty points, and profile.', cta: 'New here? Create a free account →', cta_view: 'customer' },
        customer: { title: 'Join RudhiDrive.', sub: 'Book certified vehicles from verified vendors across Maharashtra.', cta: 'Already have an account? Sign in →', cta_view: 'login' },
        vendor: { title: 'List your fleet.', sub: 'Reach thousands of customers and grow your rental business.', cta: 'Already a vendor? Sign in →', cta_view: 'login' },
    };
    const copy = PANEL_COPY[view];

    return (
        <div className="am-backdrop" ref={backdropRef}
            onMouseDown={e => e.target === backdropRef.current && onClose()}>
            <div className="am-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">

                {/* ── Left: Brand panel ── */}
                <div className="am-panel">
                    {/* Animated background */}
                    <div className="am-panel__bg">
                        <div className="am-panel__orb am-panel__orb--1" />
                        <div className="am-panel__orb am-panel__orb--2" />
                        <div className="am-panel__grid" />
                    </div>

                    <div className="am-panel__content">
                        <a href="/" className="am-panel__logo">
                            <span className="am-panel__logo-icon">⬡</span>
                            <span className="am-panel__logo-text">RudhiDrive</span>
                        </a>

                        <div className="am-panel__copy">
                            <h2 className="am-panel__title">{copy.title}</h2>
                            <p className="am-panel__sub">{copy.sub}</p>
                        </div>

                        {/* Feature pills */}
                        <div className="am-panel__pills">
                            {[
                                ['🛡️', 'Verified vendors'],
                                ['📱', 'OTP sign-offs'],
                                ['⭐', 'Loyalty rewards'],
                                ['🔄', 'One-way returns'],
                            ].map(([icon, label]) => (
                                <div key={label} className="am-panel__pill">
                                    <span>{icon}</span>{label}
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>

                        <button className="am-panel__switch" onClick={() => setView(copy.cta_view)}>
                            {copy.cta}
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* ── Right: Form panel ── */}
                <div className="am-form-panel">
                    <button className="am-close" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" width="14" height="14">
                            <path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>

                    {/* Tab switcher */}
                    <div className="am-tabs">
                        {[['login', 'Sign In'], ['customer', 'Customer'], ['vendor', 'Vendor']].map(([v, l]) => (
                            <button key={v} className={`am-tab${view === v ? ' am-tab--active' : ''}`}
                                onClick={() => setView(v)} type="button">{l}</button>
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    {/* Header */}
                    <div className="am-form-header">
                        <h3 className="am-form-title">
                            {view === 'login' ? 'Sign in to continue'
                                : view === 'customer' ? 'Create your account'
                                    : 'Register as vendor'}
                        </h3>
                    </div>

                    {/* Error / success */}
                    {error && <div className="am-alert am-alert--error">{errorIcon} {error}</div>}
                    {success && <div className="am-alert am-alert--success">{checkIcon} {success}</div>}

                    {/* ── Login form ── */}
                    {view === 'login' && (
                        <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="am-form" autoComplete="on">
                            <InputField label="Email address" icon={mailIcon} type="email"
                                value={form.email} onChange={s('email')}
                                placeholder="you@example.com" required autoComplete="email" />
                            <InputField label="Password" icon={lockIcon} type="password"
                                value={form.password} onChange={s('password')}
                                placeholder="••••••••" required autoComplete="current-password" />
                            <button type="submit" className="am-submit" disabled={loading}>
                                {loading ? <><span className="am-spinner" /> Signing in…</> : 'Sign In →'}
                            </button>
                            <p className="am-form-footer">
                                Don't have an account?{' '}
                                <button type="button" className="am-link" onClick={() => setView('customer')}>
                                    Create one free
                                </button>
                            </p>
                        </form>
                    )}

                    {/* ── Customer register ── */}
                    {view === 'customer' && (
                        <form onSubmit={handleCustomer} className="am-form" autoComplete="on">
                            <InputField label="Full Name" icon={userIcon} value={form.full_name}
                                onChange={s('full_name')} placeholder="Arjun Mehta" required autoComplete="name" />
                            <InputField label="Email address" icon={mailIcon} type="email"
                                value={form.email} onChange={s('email')}
                                placeholder="you@example.com" required autoComplete="email" />
                            <InputField label="Phone Number" icon={phoneIcon} type="tel"
                                value={form.phone} onChange={s('phone')}
                                placeholder="+91 98765 43210" required autoComplete="tel" />
                            <InputField label="Password" icon={lockIcon} type="password"
                                value={form.password} onChange={s('password')}
                                placeholder="Min. 8 characters" required autoComplete="new-password" />
                            <InputField label="Confirm Password" icon={lockIcon} type="password"
                                value={form.password2} onChange={s('password2')}
                                placeholder="Repeat password" required autoComplete="new-password" />
                            <button type="submit" className="am-submit" disabled={loading}>
                                {loading ? <><span className="am-spinner" /> Creating…</> : 'Create Account →'}
                            </button>
                            <p className="am-form-footer">
                                Already have an account?{' '}
                                <button type="button" className="am-link" onClick={() => setView('login')}>
                                    Sign in
                                </button>
                            </p>
                        </form>
                    )}

                    {/* ── Vendor register ── */}
                    {view === 'vendor' && (
                        <form onSubmit={handleVendor} className="am-form" autoComplete="on">
                            <InputField label="Owner Full Name" icon={userIcon} value={form.full_name}
                                onChange={s('full_name')} placeholder="Rahul Sharma" required autoComplete="name" />
                            <InputField label="Business Name" icon={buildingIcon} value={form.business_name}
                                onChange={s('business_name')} placeholder="Sharma Car Rentals" required />
                            <InputField label="Email address" icon={mailIcon} type="email"
                                value={form.email} onChange={s('email')}
                                placeholder="business@example.com" required autoComplete="email" />
                            <InputField label="Phone Number" icon={phoneIcon} type="tel"
                                value={form.phone} onChange={s('phone')}
                                placeholder="+91 98765 43210" required autoComplete="tel" />
                            <InputField label="GSTIN" icon={tagIcon} value={form.gstin}
                                onChange={s('gstin')} placeholder="22AAAAA0000A1Z5" />
                            <InputField label="Password" icon={lockIcon} type="password"
                                value={form.password} onChange={s('password')}
                                placeholder="Min. 8 characters" required autoComplete="new-password" />
                            <InputField label="Confirm Password" icon={lockIcon} type="password"
                                value={form.password2} onChange={s('password2')}
                                placeholder="Repeat password" required autoComplete="new-password" />
                            <button type="submit" className="am-submit" disabled={loading}>
                                {loading ? <><span className="am-spinner" /> Registering…</> : 'Register as Vendor →'}
                            </button>
                            <p className="am-form-footer">
                                Already registered?{' '}
                                <button type="button" className="am-link" onClick={() => setView('login')}>
                                    Sign in
                                </button>
                            </p>
                        </form>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
    getAdminList,
    getAdminVendors,
    getAllAssignments,
    getAssignmentHistory,
    assignVendorToAdmin,
    unassignVendor,
    bulkAssignVendors,
    getMyAdminProfile,
    updateMyAdminProfile,
} from '../../services/api';
import DataTable from './DataTable';
import './AssignmentsTab.css';

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtDate(d) {
    if (!d) return '—';
    return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
        day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric',
    });
}
function fmtDatetime(d) {
    if (!d) return '—';
    return new Date(d).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
        day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
    });
}

const VENDOR_STATUS_CLR = {
    approved:  { bg: '#D1FAE5', color: '#059669' },
    pending:   { bg: '#FEF3C7', color: '#D97706' },
    rejected:  { bg: '#FEE2E2', color: '#B91C1C' },
    suspended: { bg: '#FEE2E2', color: '#EF4444' },
    more_info: { bg: '#EDE9FE', color: '#7C3AED' },
};

function StatusBadge({ status, map }) {
    const s = map?.[status] || { bg: '#F3F4F6', color: '#6B7280' };
    return (
        <span className="asgn-badge" style={{ background: s.bg, color: s.color, borderColor: s.color + '40' }}>
            {status?.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
        </span>
    );
}

// ── Scope pill ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ScopePill({ scope }) {
    const isSuper = scope === 'superadmin';
    return (
        <span className={`asgn-scope-pill ${isSuper ? 'asgn-scope-pill--super' : 'asgn-scope-pill--assigned'}`}>
            {isSuper ? '👑 Super Admin' : '🎯 Assigned Admin'}
        </span>
    );
}

// ── Admin Card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AdminCard({ admin, assignments, vendors, onDrop, onAssign, onUnassign, isSelected, onSelect, selectedVendors }) {
    const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);
    const myVendorIds = new Set(
        assignments.filter(a => a.admin === admin.user_id || a.admin_email === admin.email).map(a => a.vendor)
    );
    const myVendors = vendors.filter(v => myVendorIds.has(v.user));

    const handleDrop = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setDragOver(false);
        const data = JSON.parse(e.dataTransfer.getData('application/json'));
        onDrop(data.vendorId, admin.user_id);
    };

    return (
        <div
            className={`asgn-admin-card ${dragOver ? 'asgn-admin-card--drag-over' : ''}`}
            onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragOver(true); }}
            onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)}
            onDrop={handleDrop}
        >
            {/* Card header */}
            <div className="asgn-admin-card__head">
                <div className="asgn-admin-card__avatar">
                    {(admin.full_name || admin.email || 'A')[0].toUpperCase()}
                </div>
                <div className="asgn-admin-card__info">
                    <strong>{admin.full_name || admin.email}</strong>
                    <span>{admin.email}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="asgn-admin-card__badges">
                    <ScopePill scope={admin.scope} />
                    <span className="asgn-vendor-count">
                        {myVendors.length} vendor{myVendors.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Bulk-assign button when vendors are selected */}
            {selectedVendors.length > 0 && (
                <button
                    className="asgn-bulk-assign-btn"
                    onClick={() => onAssign(selectedVendors, admin.user_id)}
                >
                    ＋ Assign {selectedVendors.length} selected vendor{selectedVendors.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} here
                </button>
            )}

            {/* Vendor chips */}
            <div className="asgn-vendor-chips">
                {myVendors.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="asgn-empty-chips">
                        {dragOver ? '📥 Drop vendor here' : 'No vendors assigned — drag one here'}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    myVendors.map(v => (
                        <div key={v.id} className="asgn-vendor-chip">
                            <span className="asgn-vendor-chip__name">{v.business_name}</span>
                            <StatusBadge status={v.status} map={VENDOR_STATUS_CLR} />
                            <button
                                className="asgn-vendor-chip__remove"
                                title="Remove assignment"
                                onClick={() => onUnassign(v.user)}
                            >✕</button>
                        </div>
                    ))
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Unassigned Vendor Row ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function UnassignedVendorRow({ vendor, admins, onAssign, isSelected, onToggleSelect }) {
    const [pickAdmin, setPickAdmin] = useState('');
    return (
        <div className={`asgn-unassigned-row ${isSelected ? 'asgn-unassigned-row--selected' : ''}`}>
            <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="asgn-checkbox"
                checked={isSelected}
                onChange={() => onToggleSelect(vendor.user)}
            />
            <div
                className="asgn-drag-handle"
                draggable
                onDragStart={e => {
                    e.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', JSON.stringify({ vendorId: vendor.user }));
                }}
                title="Drag to an admin card above"
            >
                ⠿
            </div>
            <div className="asgn-unassigned-row__info">
                <strong>{vendor.business_name}</strong>
                <span>{vendor.email} · {vendor.city_name || '—'}</span>
            </div>
            <StatusBadge status={vendor.status} map={VENDOR_STATUS_CLR} />
            <div className="asgn-quick-assign">
                <select
                    className="asgn-admin-select"
                    value={pickAdmin}
                    onChange={e => setPickAdmin(e.target.value)}
                >
                    <option value="">— Assign to admin —</option>
                    {admins.map(a => (
                        <option key={a.id} value={a.user_id}>{a.full_name || a.email}</option>
                    ))}
                </select>
                <button
                    className="asgn-assign-btn"
                    disabled={!pickAdmin}
                    onClick={() => { onAssign([vendor.user], parseInt(pickAdmin)); setPickAdmin(''); }}
                >
                    Assign
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── History Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function HistoryModal({ vendorName, history, onClose }) {
    return (
        <div className="asgn-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
            <div className="asgn-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                <div className="asgn-modal__head">
                    <div>
                        <h3>Assignment History</h3>
                        <p>{vendorName}</p>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={onClose}>✕ Close</button>
                </div>
                <div className="asgn-modal__body">
                    {history.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="asgn-modal__empty">No assignment history found.</p>
                    ) : history.map(h => (
                        <div key={h.id} className={`asgn-history-row ${h.is_active ? 'asgn-history-row--active' : ''}`}>
                            <div className="asgn-history-row__left">
                                <span className="asgn-history-admin">{h.admin_name || h.admin_email}</span>
                                {h.is_active && <span className="asgn-active-dot">● Active</span>}
                            </div>
                            <div className="asgn-history-row__right">
                                <span>Assigned: {fmtDatetime(h.assigned_at)}</span>
                                {h.deactivated_at && (
                                    <span style={{ color: '#EF4444' }}>Ended: {fmtDatetime(h.deactivated_at)}</span>
                                )}
                                {h.assigned_by_name && (
                                    <span style={{ color: '#9CA3AF' }}>By: {h.assigned_by_name}</span>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Admin Scope Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AdminScopeEditor({ admin, onSave, onClose }) {
    const [scope, setScope] = useState(admin.scope);
    const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(admin.display_name || '');
    const [notes, setNotes] = useState(admin.notes || '');
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

    const handleSave = async () => {
        setBusy(true);
        await onSave(admin.id, { scope, display_name: displayName, notes });
        setBusy(false);
        onClose();
    };

    return (
        <div className="asgn-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
            <div className="asgn-modal asgn-modal--sm" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                <div className="asgn-modal__head">
                    <div>
                        <h3>Edit Admin Scope</h3>
                        <p>{admin.full_name || admin.email}</p>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
                </div>
                <div className="asgn-modal__body" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
                    <div className="asgn-form-field">
                        <label>Scope</label>
                        <div className="asgn-scope-options">
                            {[['superadmin', '👑 Super Admin', 'Full platform access — sees all vendors, vehicles, bookings'],
                              ['assigned_admin', '🎯 Assigned Admin', 'Scoped access — only sees their assigned vendors']].map(([val, label, desc]) => (
                                <label key={val} className={`asgn-scope-option ${scope === val ? 'selected' : ''}`}>
                                    <input type="radio" name="scope" value={val} checked={scope === val} onChange={() => setScope(val)} />
                                    <div>
                                        <strong>{label}</strong>
                                        <span>{desc}</span>
                                    </div>
                                </label>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="asgn-form-field">
                        <label>Display Name</label>
                        <input value={displayName} onChange={e => setDisplayName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. South Region Admin" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="asgn-form-field">
                        <label>Notes</label>
                        <textarea rows={3} value={notes} onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="Internal notes about this admin's responsibilities…" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="asgn-modal__actions">
                        <button className="asgn-save-btn" onClick={handleSave} disabled={busy}>
                            {busy ? '…' : 'Save Changes'}
                        </button>
                        <button className="asgn-cancel-btn" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Main AssignmentsTab ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function AssignmentsTab({ myProfile }) {
    const isSuperAdmin = myProfile?.scope === 'superadmin';

    const [admins, setAdmins] = useState([]);
    const [vendors, setVendors] = useState([]);
    const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

    // UI state
    const [selectedVendors, setSelectedVendors] = useState([]);
    const [historyVendor, setHistoryVendor] = useState(null);
    const [historyData, setHistoryData] = useState([]);
    const [editingAdmin, setEditingAdmin] = useState(null);
    const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('matrix'); // 'matrix' | 'table'
    const [searchVendor, setSearchVendor] = useState('');

    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true); setError('');
        try {
            const [adminRes, vendorRes, assignRes] = await Promise.all([
                getAdminList(),
                getAdminVendors(),
                getAllAssignments(),
            ]);
            setAdmins(adminRes.data);
            setVendors(vendorRes.data.results || vendorRes.data);
            setAssignments(assignRes.data);
        } catch (e) {
            setError(e.response?.data?.detail || e.message || 'Failed to load assignment data.');
        }
        setLoading(false);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

    // Vendors with no active assignment
    const assignedVendorIds = new Set(assignments.filter(a => a.is_active).map(a => a.vendor));
    const unassignedVendors = vendors.filter(v => !assignedVendorIds.has(v.user));
    const filteredUnassigned = unassignedVendors.filter(v =>
        !searchVendor ||
        v.business_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchVendor.toLowerCase()) ||
        v.email?.toLowerCase().includes(searchVendor.toLowerCase())
    );

    // Handlers
    const handleAssign = async (vendorIds, adminId) => {
        if (vendorIds.length === 0 || !adminId) return;
        setBusy(true);
        try {
            if (vendorIds.length === 1) {
                await assignVendorToAdmin(vendorIds[0], adminId);
            } else {
                await bulkAssignVendors(vendorIds, adminId);
            }
            setSelectedVendors([]);
            await load();
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.error || 'Assignment failed.');
        }
        setBusy(false);
    };

    const handleUnassign = async (vendorId) => {
        if (!window.confirm('Remove this vendor assignment?')) return;
        setBusy(true);
        try {
            await unassignVendor(vendorId);
            await load();
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.error || 'Unassignment failed.');
        }
        setBusy(false);
    };

    const handleDrop = async (vendorId, adminId) => {
        await handleAssign([vendorId], adminId);
    };

    const handleShowHistory = async (vendor) => {
        setHistoryVendor(vendor);
        try {
            const res = await getAssignmentHistory(vendor.user);
            setHistoryData(res.data);
        } catch { setHistoryData([]); }
    };

    const handleSaveAdminScope = async (profileId, data) => {
        // PATCH /api/users/admin/admins/{id}/ — superadmin updates another admin's profile
        try {
            const { default: axios } = await import('axios');
            const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
            await axios.patch(`/api/users/admin/admins/${profileId}/`, data, {
                headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
            });
            await load();
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to update admin profile.');
        }
    };

    const toggleVendorSelect = (vendorUserId) => {
        setSelectedVendors(prev =>
            prev.includes(vendorUserId)
                ? prev.filter(id => id !== vendorUserId)
                : [...prev, vendorUserId]
        );
    };

    const selectAllUnassigned = () => {
        setSelectedVendors(filteredUnassigned.map(v => v.user));
    };

    // Table columns for assignment overview
    const assignmentColumns = [
        {
            key: 'vendor_business', label: 'Vendor', sortable: true, width: 200,
            render: (v, row) => (
                <div className="dt-cell-stack">
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__primary">{v}</span>
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__secondary">{row.vendor_email}</span>
                </div>
            ),
        },
        {
            key: 'admin_name', label: 'Managing Admin', sortable: true, width: 180,
            render: (v, row) => (
                <div className="dt-cell-stack">
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__primary">{v}</span>
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__secondary">{row.admin_email}</span>
                </div>
            ),
        },
        {
            key: 'assigned_at', label: 'Since', sortable: true, width: 120,
            render: v => fmtDate(v),
        },
        {
            key: 'assigned_by_name', label: 'Assigned By', sortable: true, width: 140,
            render: v => v || <span style={{ color: '#9CA3AF' }}>—</span>,
        },
        {
            key: 'is_active', label: 'Status', sortable: true, width: 90,
            render: v => (
                <span className={`asgn-badge ${v ? 'asgn-badge--active' : 'asgn-badge--inactive'}`}>
                    {v ? '● Active' : '○ Ended'}
                </span>
            ),
        },
    ];

    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
        // Assigned admin: read-only view of own vendors
        return (
            <div className="asgn-tab">
                <div className="asgn-tab__header">
                    <div>
                        <h2>My Assigned Vendors</h2>
                        <p>Vendors you are responsible for managing.</p>
                    </div>
                    <ScopePill scope="assigned_admin" />
                </div>
                {loading ? (
                    <div className="asgn-loading"><div className="asgn-spinner" />Loading…</div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="asgn-readonly-grid">
                        {vendors.filter(v => assignedVendorIds.has(v.user)).map(v => (
                            <div key={v.id} className="asgn-readonly-card">
                                <div className="asgn-readonly-card__name">{v.business_name}</div>
                                <div className="asgn-readonly-card__meta">
                                    <span>{v.email}</span>
                                    <span>{v.city_name || '—'}</span>
                                    <StatusBadge status={v.status} map={VENDOR_STATUS_CLR} />
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                        {vendors.length === 0 && (
                            <div className="asgn-empty">
                                <span>🎯</span>
                                <p>No vendors have been assigned to you yet. Contact a superadmin.</p>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }

    // Superadmin full management UI
    return (
        <div className="asgn-tab">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="asgn-tab__header">
                <div>
                    <h2>Vendor–Admin Assignments</h2>
                    <p>Assign vendors to admins. Each admin sees only their assigned vendors and related customers.</p>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                    <ScopePill scope="superadmin" />
                    <div className="asgn-view-toggle">
                        <button className={viewMode === 'matrix' ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setViewMode('matrix')}>
                            ⊞ Matrix
                        </button>
                        <button className={viewMode === 'table' ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setViewMode('table')}>
                            ≡ Table
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <button className="asgn-refresh-btn" onClick={load} disabled={busy}>↺ Refresh</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            {error && (
                <div className="asgn-error">⚠ {error} <button onClick={load}>Retry</button></div>
            )}
            {loading ? (
                <div className="asgn-loading"><div className="asgn-spinner" />Loading assignment data…</div>
            ) : (
                <>
                    {/* ── Summary strip ── */}
                    <div className="asgn-summary-strip">
                        {[
                            ['👥', 'Total Admins', admins.length, '#1D4ED8'],
                            ['🏪', 'Total Vendors', vendors.length, '#0DB89E'],
                            ['✅', 'Assigned', vendors.length - unassignedVendors.length, '#059669'],
                            ['⚠️', 'Unassigned', unassignedVendors.length, unassignedVendors.length > 0 ? '#D97706' : '#9CA3AF'],
                        ].map(([icon, label, val, color]) => (
                            <div key={label} className="asgn-summary-card">
                                <span className="asgn-summary-icon">{icon}</span>
                                <span className="asgn-summary-val" style={{ color }}>{val}</span>
                                <span className="asgn-summary-lbl">{label}</span>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    {viewMode === 'matrix' ? (
                        <>
                            {/* ── Admin cards matrix ── */}
                            <div className="asgn-section">
                                <div className="asgn-section__head">
                                    <h3>Admin Assignment Map</h3>
                                    <p>Drag vendors from below onto an admin card, or use the quick-assign dropdown.</p>
                                </div>
                                <div className="asgn-admin-grid">
                                    {admins.map(admin => (
                                        <AdminCard
                                            key={admin.id}
                                            admin={admin}
                                            assignments={assignments}
                                            vendors={vendors}
                                            onDrop={handleDrop}
                                            onAssign={handleAssign}
                                            onUnassign={handleUnassign}
                                            selectedVendors={selectedVendors}
                                            onSelect={() => {}}
                                        />
                                    ))}
                                    {admins.length === 0 && (
                                        <div className="asgn-empty">
                                            <span>👤</span>
                                            <p>No admin accounts found.</p>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* ── Unassigned vendors ── */}
                            {unassignedVendors.length > 0 && (
                                <div className="asgn-section">
                                    <div className="asgn-section__head">
                                        <div>
                                            <h3>⚠ Unassigned Vendors ({unassignedVendors.length})</h3>
                                            <p>These vendors have no managing admin. Assign them by dragging to a card above or using the dropdown.</p>
                                        </div>
                                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                                            {selectedVendors.length > 0 && (
                                                <span className="asgn-selected-count">
                                                    {selectedVendors.length} selected
                                                </span>
                                            )}
                                            <button className="asgn-select-all-btn" onClick={selectAllUnassigned}>
                                                ☑ Select All
                                            </button>
                                            {selectedVendors.length > 0 && (
                                                <button className="asgn-clear-sel-btn" onClick={() => setSelectedVendors([])}>
                                                    ✕ Clear
                                                </button>
                                            )}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="asgn-search-row">
                                        <input
                                            className="asgn-search-input"
                                            placeholder="Search unassigned vendors…"
                                            value={searchVendor}
                                            onChange={e => setSearchVendor(e.target.value)}
                                        />
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="asgn-unassigned-list">
                                        {filteredUnassigned.map(v => (
                                            <UnassignedVendorRow
                                                key={v.id}
                                                vendor={v}
                                                admins={admins}
                                                onAssign={handleAssign}
                                                isSelected={selectedVendors.includes(v.user)}
                                                onToggleSelect={toggleVendorSelect}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                        {filteredUnassigned.length === 0 && searchVendor && (
                                            <div style={{ padding: 20, textAlign: 'center', color: '#9CA3AF', fontSize: 13 }}>
                                                No unassigned vendors match "{searchVendor}".
                                            </div>
                                        )}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {/* ── Admin profiles ── */}
                            <div className="asgn-section">
                                <div className="asgn-section__head">
                                    <h3>Admin Accounts</h3>
                                    <p>Manage admin scopes — superadmin has full access; assigned admin sees only their vendors.</p>
                                </div>
                                <div className="asgn-admin-profiles-list">
                                    {admins.map(admin => (
                                        <div key={admin.id} className="asgn-admin-profile-row">
                                            <div className="asgn-admin-profile-row__avatar">
                                                {(admin.full_name || admin.email || 'A')[0].toUpperCase()}
                                            </div>
                                            <div className="asgn-admin-profile-row__info">
                                                <strong>{admin.full_name || admin.email}</strong>
                                                <span>{admin.email}</span>
                                                {admin.display_name && (
                                                    <span className="asgn-display-name">{admin.display_name}</span>
                                                )}
                                            </div>
                                            <ScopePill scope={admin.scope} />
                                            <span className="asgn-vendor-count-pill">
                                                {admin.assigned_vendor_count} vendors
                                            </span>
                                            <button
                                                className="asgn-edit-btn"
                                                onClick={() => setEditingAdmin(admin)}
                                            >
                                                ✏ Edit Scope
                                            </button>
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </>
                    ) : (
                        /* ── Table view ── */
                        <div className="asgn-section">
                            <DataTable
                                columns={assignmentColumns}
                                data={assignments}
                                searchable
                                searchKeys={['vendor_business', 'vendor_email', 'admin_name', 'admin_email']}
                                searchPlaceholder="Search by vendor or admin…"
                                filters={[{
                                    key: 'is_active',
                                    label: 'Status',
                                    options: [
                                        { value: '', label: 'All' },
                                        { value: 'true', label: 'Active' },
                                        { value: 'false', label: 'Ended' },
                                    ],
                                }]}
                                extraActions={[
                                    {
                                        label: '📋 History',
                                        className: 'dt-action-btn--secondary',
                                        onClick: (row) => handleShowHistory({ user: row.vendor, business_name: row.vendor_business }),
                                    },
                                    {
                                        label: '✕ Remove',
                                        className: 'dt-action-btn--danger',
                                        show: (row) => row.is_active,
                                        onClick: (row) => handleUnassign(row.vendor),
                                    },
                                ]}
                                emptyIcon="🔗"
                                emptyMessage="No assignments found."
                                pageSize={25}
                            />
                        </div>
                    )}
                </>
            )}

            {/* Modals */}
            {historyVendor && (
                <HistoryModal
                    vendorName={historyVendor.business_name || historyVendor.vendor_business}
                    history={historyData}
                    onClose={() => { setHistoryVendor(null); setHistoryData([]); }}
                />
            )}
            {editingAdmin && (
                <AdminScopeEditor
                    admin={editingAdmin}
                    onSave={handleSaveAdminScope}
                    onClose={() => setEditingAdmin(null)}
                />
            )}
        </div>
    );
}
