import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';

// ── Sort icon ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SortIcon({ direction }) {
    if (!direction) return (
        <svg width="10" height="12" viewBox="0 0 10 12" fill="none" style={{ opacity: 0.3, marginLeft: 4, flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <path d="M5 1L8 4H2L5 1Z" fill="currentColor" />
            <path d="M5 11L2 8H8L5 11Z" fill="currentColor" />
        </svg>
    );
    return (
        <svg width="10" height="12" viewBox="0 0 10 12" fill="none" style={{ marginLeft: 4, flexShrink: 0, color: 'var(--dt-acc)' }}>
            {direction === 'asc'
                ? <path d="M5 1L9 6H1L5 1Z" fill="currentColor" />
                : <path d="M5 11L1 6H9L5 11Z" fill="currentColor" />}
        </svg>
    );
}

// ── Filter Pill ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function FilterPill({ label, value, options, onChange, colorMap }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const ref = useRef(null);
    useEffect(() => {
        const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false); };
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
    }, []);
    const selected = options.find(o => o.value === value);
    const isActive = value !== '' && value != null;
    return (
        <div className="dt-filter-pill" ref={ref}>
            <button
                className={`dt-filter-pill__btn${isActive ? ' active' : ''}${open ? ' open' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setOpen(v => !v)}
            >
                <span className="dt-filter-pill__label">{label}</span>
                {isActive && selected && (
                    <span
                        className="dt-filter-pill__chip"
                        style={colorMap?.[selected.value]
                            ? { background: colorMap[selected.value].bg, color: colorMap[selected.value].color }
                            : undefined}
                    >
                        {selected.label}
                    </span>
                )}
                <span className={`dt-filter-pill__chevron${open ? ' flipped' : ''}`}>▾</span>
            </button>
            {open && (
                <div className="dt-filter-pill__menu">
                    {options.map(opt => (
                        <button
                            key={opt.value}
                            className={`dt-filter-pill__item${value === opt.value ? ' selected' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => { onChange(opt.value); setOpen(false); }}
                        >
                            {colorMap?.[opt.value] && (
                                <span className="dt-filter-pill__dot" style={{ background: colorMap[opt.value].color }} />
                            )}
                            <span>{opt.label}</span>
                            {value === opt.value && <span className="dt-filter-pill__check">✓</span>}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

/**
 * DataTable — Main component
 *
 * Props:
 *  columns: Array<{ key, label, sortable?, render?, width?, align? }>
 *  data: Array<object>
 *  searchable: bool (show search box)
 *  searchKeys: string[] (which keys to search across)
 *  searchPlaceholder: string
 *  filters: Array<{ key, label, options: [{value,label}], colorMap? }>
 *  onRowAction: (row) => void  — called on "View Details" click
 *  actionLabel: string (default "View Details")
 *  emptyIcon: string
 *  emptyMessage: string
 *  pageSize: number (default 20)
 *  loading: bool
 *  stickyHeader: bool
 *  rowClassName: (row) => string
 *  extraActions: Array<{ label, onClick, className?, show?: (row)=>bool }>
 */
export default function DataTable({
    columns = [],
    data = [],
    searchable = true,
    searchKeys = [],
    searchPlaceholder = 'Search…',
    filters = [],
    onRowAction,
    actionLabel = 'View Details',
    emptyIcon = '📭',
    emptyMessage = 'No data found.',
    pageSize = 20,
    loading = false,
    stickyHeader = true,
    rowClassName,
    extraActions = [],
}) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState('');
    const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState('asc');
    const [filterValues, setFilterValues] = useState(() =>
        Object.fromEntries(filters.map(f => [f.key, '']))
    );
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

    // Reset page when search/filter changes
    useEffect(() => { setPage(1); }, [search, JSON.stringify(filterValues)]);

    const handleSort = useCallback((key) => {
        setSortKey(prev => {
            if (prev === key) { setSortDir(d => d === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'); return key; }
            setSortDir('asc');
            return key;
        });
    }, []);

    const handleFilterChange = useCallback((key, value) => {
        setFilterValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
    }, []);

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = [...data];
        // Search
        if (search.trim() && searchKeys.length > 0) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter(row =>
                searchKeys.some(k => {
                    const val = k.split('.').reduce((o, p) => o?.[p], row);
                    return String(val ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                })
            );
        }
        // Filters
        for (const f of filters) {
            const val = filterValues[f.key];
            if (val === '' || val == null) continue;
            result = result.filter(row => {
                const rowVal = f.key.split('.').reduce((o, p) => o?.[p], row);
                return String(rowVal) === String(val);
            });
        }
        // Sort
        if (sortKey) {
            result.sort((a, b) => {
                const av = sortKey.split('.').reduce((o, p) => o?.[p], a) ?? '';
                const bv = sortKey.split('.').reduce((o, p) => o?.[p], b) ?? '';
                const cmp = typeof av === 'number' && typeof bv === 'number'
                    ? av - bv
                    : String(av).localeCompare(String(bv), undefined, { numeric: true });
                return sortDir === 'asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
            });
        }
        return result;
    }, [data, search, searchKeys, filterValues, filters, sortKey, sortDir]);

    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / pageSize));
    const paged = filtered.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize);

    const hasActiveFilters = Object.values(filterValues).some(v => v !== '');
    const clearAll = () => {
        setSearch('');
        setFilterValues(Object.fromEntries(filters.map(f => [f.key, ''])));
        setPage(1);
    };

    const showAction = onRowAction || extraActions.length > 0;
    const effectiveColumns = showAction
        ? [...columns, { key: '__actions__', label: 'Actions', sortable: false, width: extraActions.length > 0 ? 180 : 130, align: 'right' }]
        : columns;

    return (
        <div className="dt-wrapper">
            {/* Toolbar */}
            {(searchable || filters.length > 0) && (
                <div className="dt-toolbar">
                    {searchable && (
                        <div className="dt-search">
                            <svg className="dt-search__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none">
                                <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                                <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                            </svg>
                            <input
                                className="dt-search__input"
                                placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                                value={search}
                                onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                            />
                            {search && (
                                <button className="dt-search__clear" onClick={() => setSearch('')}>✕</button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="dt-filters">
                        {filters.map(f => (
                            <FilterPill
                                key={f.key}
                                label={f.label}
                                value={filterValues[f.key]}
                                options={f.options}
                                onChange={v => handleFilterChange(f.key, v)}
                                colorMap={f.colorMap}
                            />
                        ))}
                        {(search || hasActiveFilters) && (
                            <button className="dt-clear-all" onClick={clearAll}>
                                ✕ Clear all
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="dt-toolbar__count">
                        {filtered.length} of {data.length} row{data.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Table */}
            <div className="dt-scroll">
                <table className="dt-table">
                    <thead className={stickyHeader ? 'dt-thead--sticky' : ''}>
                        <tr>
                            {effectiveColumns.map(col => (
                                <th
                                    key={col.key}
                                    className={`dt-th${col.sortable !== false && col.key !== '__actions__' ? ' dt-th--sortable' : ''}${sortKey === col.key ? ' dt-th--sorted' : ''}`}
                                    style={{
                                        width: col.width,
                                        textAlign: col.align || 'left',
                                        ...(col.key === '__actions__' ? { textAlign: 'right' } : {}),
                                    }}
                                    onClick={col.sortable !== false && col.key !== '__actions__' ? () => handleSort(col.key) : undefined}
                                >
                                    <span className="dt-th__inner">
                                        {col.label}
                                        {col.sortable !== false && col.key !== '__actions__' && (
                                            <SortIcon direction={sortKey === col.key ? sortDir : null} />
                                        )}
                                    </span>
                                </th>
                            ))}
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {loading ? (
                            <tr>
                                <td colSpan={effectiveColumns.length} className="dt-td--loading">
                                    <div className="dt-spinner" />
                                    <span>Loading…</span>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        ) : paged.length === 0 ? (
                            <tr>
                                <td colSpan={effectiveColumns.length} className="dt-td--empty">
                                    <span className="dt-empty-icon">{emptyIcon}</span>
                                    <span>{emptyMessage}</span>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        ) : paged.map((row, idx) => (
                            <tr
                                key={row.id ?? idx}
                                className={`dt-tr${rowClassName ? ' ' + rowClassName(row) : ''}`}
                            >
                                {columns.map(col => (
                                    <td
                                        key={col.key}
                                        className="dt-td"
                                        style={{ textAlign: col.align || 'left' }}
                                    >
                                        {col.render
                                            ? col.render(row[col.key], row)
                                            : (row[col.key] ?? '—')}
                                    </td>
                                ))}
                                {showAction && (
                                    <td className="dt-td dt-td--actions">
                                        <div className="dt-actions-cell">
                                            {extraActions
                                                .filter(a => !a.show || a.show(row))
                                                .map((a, i) => (
                                                    <button
                                                        key={i}
                                                        className={`dt-action-btn ${a.className || 'dt-action-btn--secondary'}`}
                                                        onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); a.onClick(row); }}
                                                    >
                                                        {a.label}
                                                    </button>
                                                ))}
                                            {onRowAction && (
                                                <button
                                                    className="dt-action-btn dt-action-btn--primary"
                                                    onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onRowAction(row); }}
                                                >
                                                    {actionLabel} →
                                                </button>
                                            )}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                )}
                            </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination */}
            {totalPages > 1 && (
                <div className="dt-pagination">
                    <span className="dt-pagination__info">
                        Page {page} of {totalPages} · {filtered.length} results
                    </span>
                    <div className="dt-pagination__controls">
                        <button
                            className="dt-page-btn"
                            onClick={() => setPage(1)}
                            disabled={page === 1}
                        >«</button>
                        <button
                            className="dt-page-btn"
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                            disabled={page === 1}
                        >‹</button>
                        {Array.from({ length: Math.min(5, totalPages) }, (_, i) => {
                            const start = Math.max(1, Math.min(page - 2, totalPages - 4));
                            const p = start + i;
                            return p <= totalPages ? (
                                <button
                                    key={p}
                                    className={`dt-page-btn${page === p ? ' active' : ''}`}
                                    onClick={() => setPage(p)}
                                >{p}</button>
                            ) : null;
                        })}
                        <button
                            className="dt-page-btn"
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                            disabled={page === totalPages}
                        >›</button>
                        <button
                            className="dt-page-btn"
                            onClick={() => setPage(totalPages)}
                            disabled={page === totalPages}
                        >»</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

/* Scope selector */
.navbar__scope {

    background: var(--c-surface2);
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    border-radius: var(--r-full);
    padding: 5px 12px 5px 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--c-text2);
    cursor: pointer;

/* ── Sidebar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
export function Sidebar({ activeTab, onTabChange }) {
    const { user, logout } = useAuth();
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const role  = user?.role || 'customer';
    const items = SIDEBAR_ITEMS[role] || [];
    const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);

    const handleLogout = async () => {
        await logout();
        navigate('/');
    };

    const initials     = (user?.full_name || user?.email || 'U')
        .split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    const fullNameCaps = (user?.full_name || user?.email || 'USER').toUpperCase();

    return (
        <>
            <button
                className="sidebar__hamburger"
                onClick={() => setMobileOpen(v => !v)}
                aria-label="Toggle menu"
            >
                <span className={`sidebar__hamburger-icon${mobileOpen ? ' open' : ''}`} />
            </button>
            {mobileOpen && (
                <div className="sidebar__overlay" onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)} />
            )}
            <aside className={`sidebar${mobileOpen ? ' sidebar--open' : ''}`}>
                <Link
                    to={user
                        ? (user.role === 'admin'   ? '/admin'
                         : user.role === 'vendor'  ? '/vendor'
                         : '/customer')
                        : '/'}
                    className="sidebar__brand"
                >
                    ⬡
                </Link>
                <nav className="sidebar__nav">
                    {items.map(item => (
                        <button
                            key={item.id}
                            className={`sidebar__item${activeTab === item.id ? ' sidebar__item--active' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => { onTabChange(item.id); setMobileOpen(false); }}
                            data-tip={item.tip}
                        >
                            {item.icon}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </nav>
                <div className="sidebar__bottom">
                    <div
                        className="sidebar__avatar"
                        title={`${user?.full_name || 'Profile'} — Sign out`}
                        onClick={handleLogout}
                    >
                        <span className="avatar-initials">{initials}</span>
                        <span className="avatar-full">{fullNameCaps} LOGOUT</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </aside>
        </>
    );
}

/* ── Top Navbar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
export default function Navbar({ onLoginClick, breadcrumb, hideLogo = false }) {
    const { user, logout } = useAuth();
    const navigate  = useNavigate();
    const location  = useLocation();
    const [scrolled,          setScrolled]          = useState(false);
    const [dropdownOpen,      setDropdownOpen]      = useState(false);
    const [showBookingWidget, setShowBookingWidget] = useState(false);
    const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const fn = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
        window.addEventListener('scroll', fn);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', fn);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
            if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(e.target))
                setDropdownOpen(false);
        };
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => { setShowBookingWidget(false); }, [location.pathname]);

    /* ── Snowflake canvas effect ── */
    useEffect(() => {
        const navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar');
        if (!navbar || navbar.querySelector('.snow-canvas')) return;
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.className = 'snow-canvas';
        canvas.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;';
        navbar.prepend(canvas);
        const ctx   = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const COUNT = 60;
        let flakes  = [], raf;
        const resize = () => { canvas.width = navbar.offsetWidth; canvas.height = navbar.offsetHeight; };
        const init   = () => {
            flakes = Array.from({ length: COUNT }, () => ({
                x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
                y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
                r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
                speed: Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.2,
                drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
                opacity: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.08,
            }));
        };
        const draw = () => {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            for (const f of flakes) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${f.opacity})`;
                ctx.fill();
                f.y += f.speed; f.x += f.drift;
                if (f.y > canvas.height + f.r) { f.y = -f.r; f.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; }
                if (f.x > canvas.width  + f.r) f.x = -f.r;
                if (f.x < -f.r)                f.x = canvas.width + f.r;
            }
            raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
        };
        resize(); init(); draw();
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => { resize(); init(); });
        return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); canvas.remove(); };
    }, []);

    const handleLogout = async () => {
        await logout();
        setDropdownOpen(false);
        navigate('/');
    };

    const dashboardPath = user
        ? user.role === 'admin'  ? '/admin'
        : user.role === 'vendor' ? '/vendor'
        : '/customer'
        : null;

    const handleLogoClick = (e) => {
        if (user && dashboardPath) { e.preventDefault(); navigate(dashboardPath); }
    };

    return (
        <>
            <nav className={`navbar${scrolled ? ' navbar--scrolled' : ''}`}>
                {breadcrumb ? (
                    <div className="navbar__breadcrumb">
                        {breadcrumb.map((crumb, i) => (
                            <React.Fragment key={i}>
                                {i > 0 && <span className="navbar__breadcrumb-sep">/</span>}
                                {i < breadcrumb.length - 1
                                    ? <Link to={crumb.href || '#'}>{crumb.label}</Link>
                                    : <span className="navbar__breadcrumb-current">{crumb.label}</span>}
                            </React.Fragment>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <Link to="/" className="navbar__brand" onClick={handleLogoClick}>
                        {!hideLogo && <div className="navbar__brand-icon">⬡</div>}
                        <span className="navbar__brand-text">RudhiDrive</span>
                    </Link>
                )}

                <div className="navbar__right">
                    {user && <NotificationBell />}
                    {user ? (
                        <button
                            className="navbar__booking-btn"
                            onClick={() => setShowBookingWidget(v => !v)}
                            title="Book a car"
                        >
                            🚗 Booking
                        </button>
                    ) : (
                        <button
                            style={{ background:'var(--c-teal)', color:'#fff', border:'none', padding:'8px 20px', borderRadius:'var(--r-full)', fontSize:'13px', fontWeight:'600', cursor:'pointer', transition:'background 0.18s', fontFamily:'var(--font-body)' }}
                            onMouseOver={e => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--c-teal-dark)'}
                            onMouseOut={e  => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--c-teal)'}
                            onClick={onLoginClick}
                        >
                            Sign In
                        </button>
                    )}
                </div>
            </nav>

            {showBookingWidget && user && (
                <div
                    className="navbar__booking-overlay"
                    onClick={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setShowBookingWidget(false); }}
                >
                    <div className="navbar__booking-panel">
                        <div className="navbar__booking-panel-header">
                            <span>Book a Car</span>
                            <button className="navbar__booking-close" onClick={() => setShowBookingWidget(false)}>✕</button>
                        </div>
                        <SearchWidget onSearchComplete={() => setShowBookingWidget(false)} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </>
    );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useBooking } from '../../context/BookingContext';
import { getCities } from '../../services/api';
import './SearchWidget.css';

const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
const TOMORROW = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

export default function SearchWidget() {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const { update } = useBooking();
    const [cities, setCities] = useState([]);
    const [isDifferentReturn, setIsDifferentReturn] = useState(false);
    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        pickupCity: '',
        returnCity: '',
        pickupDate: TODAY,
        returnDate: TOMORROW,
        pickupTime: '10:00',
        returnTime: '10:00',
    });
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

    useEffect(() => {
        getCities()
            .then(({ data }) => setCities(data.results || data))
            .catch(() => setCities([]))
            .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, []);

    const set = (k) => (e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.value }));

    const handleSearch = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setError('');
        if (!form.pickupCity) { setError('Please select a pickup city.'); return; }
        if (isDifferentReturn && !form.returnCity) { setError('Please select a return city.'); return; }
        if (form.pickupDate > form.returnDate) { setError('Return date must be after pickup date.'); return; }

        const pickupCityObj = cities.find((c) => String(c.id) === String(form.pickupCity));
        const returnCityObj = isDifferentReturn
            ? cities.find((c) => String(c.id) === String(form.returnCity))
            : pickupCityObj;

        update({
            isDifferentReturn,
            pickupCity: pickupCityObj,
            returnCity: returnCityObj,
            pickupDate: form.pickupDate,
            returnDate: form.returnDate,
            pickupTime: form.pickupTime,
            returnTime: form.returnTime,
            selectedModel: null,
            selectedVehicle: null,
            pickupLocation: null,
            returnLocation: null,
            pricingBreakdown: null,
        });
        // New flow: go directly to car model selection
        navigate('/book/select-car');
    };

    const nights = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.round((new Date(form.returnDate) - new Date(form.pickupDate)) / 86400000)
    );

    return (
        <div className="search-widget">
            <div className="search-widget__header">
                <h2>Find Your Perfect Ride</h2>
                <p>Premium cars. Verified vendors. Seamless booking.</p>
            </div>

            <form className="search-widget__form" onSubmit={handleSearch}>
                <label className="search-widget__toggle">
                    <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={isDifferentReturn}
                        onChange={(e) => setIsDifferentReturn(e.target.checked)}
                    />
                    <span className="search-widget__toggle-track" />
                    <span className="search-widget__toggle-label">Return to a different location</span>
                </label>

                <div className="search-widget__fields">
                    <div className="search-field">
                        <label className="search-field__label">
                            <span className="search-field__icon">📍</span>
                            {isDifferentReturn ? 'Pick-up City' : 'Pick-up / Drop-off City'}
                        </label>
                        <select value={form.pickupCity} onChange={set('pickupCity')} required disabled={loading}>
                            <option value="">{loading ? 'Loading cities…' : 'Select city…'}</option>
                            {cities.map((c) => (
                                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}, {c.state}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    {isDifferentReturn && (
                        <div className="search-field">
                            <label className="search-field__label">
                                <span className="search-field__icon">🏁</span>Return City
                            </label>
                            <select value={form.returnCity} onChange={set('returnCity')} required={isDifferentReturn}>
                                <option value="">Select city…</option>
                                {cities.map((c) => (
                                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}, {c.state}</option>
                                ))}
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="search-field">
                        <label className="search-field__label">
                            <span className="search-field__icon">📅</span>Pick-up Date
                        </label>
                        <input type="date" value={form.pickupDate} onChange={set('pickupDate')} min={TODAY} required />
                    </div>

                    <div className="search-field">
                        <label className="search-field__label">
                            <span className="search-field__icon">📅</span>Return Date
                        </label>
                        <input type="date" value={form.returnDate} onChange={set('returnDate')} min={form.pickupDate} required />
                    </div>

                    <div className="search-field">
                        <label className="search-field__label">
                            <span className="search-field__icon">🕐</span>Pick-up Time
                        </label>
                        <input type="time" value={form.pickupTime} onChange={set('pickupTime')} />
                    </div>

                    <div className="search-field">
                        <label className="search-field__label">
                            <span className="search-field__icon">🕐</span>Return Time
                        </label>
                        <input type="time" value={form.returnTime} onChange={set('returnTime')} />
                    </div>
                </div>

                {nights > 0 && (
                    <div className="search-widget__duration">
                        <span>⏱</span> {nights} day{nights > 1 ? 's' : ''} rental
                    </div>
                )}

                {error && <div className="search-widget__error">{error}</div>}

                <button type="submit" className="search-widget__submit" disabled={loading}>
                    <span>Search Available Cars</span>
                    <span className="search-widget__submit-arrow">→</span>
                </button>
            </form>
        </div>
    );
}

=== PATH: D:\Work\car_rental_service\frontend\src\components\notifications\AdminSendNotificationForm.jsx ===
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
    adminSendNotification, getAdminUsers, getAdminVendors, getAdminList,
    getSegments,   // ← NEW import
} from '../../services/api';
import './Notifications.css';

export default function AdminSendNotificationForm({ onSent }) {
    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        target_type: 'all', user_id: '', role: 'customer', segment_id: '',
        title: '', message: '', link_url: '',
    });
    const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
    const [loadingUsers, setLoadingUsers] = useState(true);
    const [userSearch, setUserSearch] = useState('');
    const [options, setOptions] = useState([]);
    const [segments, setSegments] = useState([]);   // ← NEW state

    const set = (k) => (e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.value }));

    // Fetch recipient lists once, independent of any other tab's loaded state.
    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;
        (async () => {
            setLoadingUsers(true);
            try {
                const [customersRes, vendorsRes, adminsRes, segmentsRes] = await Promise.all([
                    getAdminUsers({ role: 'customer' }),
                    getAdminVendors(),
                    getAdminList(),
                    getSegments(),   // ← NEW fetch
                ]);
                if (cancelled) return;
                const customers = customersRes.data.results || customersRes.data || [];
                const vendors   = vendorsRes.data.results   || vendorsRes.data   || [];
                const admins    = adminsRes.data.results    || adminsRes.data    || [];
                setSegments(segmentsRes.data.results || segmentsRes.data || []);   // ← NEW

                const built = [
                    ...customers.map((u) => ({
                        id: u.id,
                        label: `${u.full_name || u.email} (customer)`,
                        search: `${u.full_name || ''} ${u.email || ''}`.toLowerCase(),
                    })),
                    ...vendors.map((v) => ({
                        id: v.user_id,
                        label: `${v.business_name || v.email} (vendor)`,
                        search: `${v.business_name || ''} ${v.email || ''}`.toLowerCase(),
                    })),
                    ...admins.map((a) => ({
                        id: a.user_id,
                        label: `${a.full_name || a.email} (admin)`,
                        search: `${a.full_name || ''} ${a.email || ''}`.toLowerCase(),
                    })),
                ].filter((o) => o.id != null);

                setOptions(built);
            } catch {
                setOptions([]);
                setSegments([]);
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) setLoadingUsers(false);
            }
        })();
        return () => { cancelled = true; };
    }, []);

    const filteredOptions = useMemo(() => {
        if (!userSearch.trim()) return options;
        const q = userSearch.toLowerCase();
        return options.filter((o) => o.search.includes(q));
    }, [options, userSearch]);

    const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (form.target_type === 'user' && !form.user_id) {
            alert('Please select a user to notify.');
            return;
        }
        if (form.target_type === 'segment' && !form.segment_id) {
            alert('Please select a segment to notify.');
            return;
        }
        setSending(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await adminSendNotification(form);
            alert(data.message);
            setForm((p) => ({ ...p, title: '', message: '', link_url: '' }));
            onSent && onSent();
        } catch (err) {
            alert(err.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(err.response.data) : 'Failed to send.');
        }
        setSending(false);
    };

    return (
        <form className="ntf ntf-send-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <span className="ntf-send-form__label">Send Notification</span>

            <div className="ntf-send-form__row">
                {/* ── UPDATED: added segment option ── */}
                <select value={form.target_type} onChange={set('target_type')}>
                    <option value="all">Everyone</option>
                    <option value="role">By Role</option>
                    <option value="segment">By Segment</option>
                    <option value="user">Specific User</option>
                </select>

                {form.target_type === 'role' && (
                    <select value={form.role} onChange={set('role')}>
                        <option value="customer">All Customers</option>
                        <option value="vendor">All Vendors</option>
                        <option value="admin">All Admins</option>
                    </select>
                )}

                {/* ── NEW: segment picker ── */}
                {form.target_type === 'segment' && (
                    <select value={form.segment_id} onChange={set('segment_id')} required style={{ minWidth: 220 }}>
                        <option value="">Select a segment…</option>
                        {segments.map((s) => (
                            <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                )}
            </div>

            {form.target_type === 'user' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                    <input
                        placeholder="Search by name or email…"
                        value={userSearch}
                        onChange={(e) => setUserSearch(e.target.value)}
                    />
                    <select
                        value={form.user_id}
                        onChange={set('user_id')}
                        required
                        size={Math.min(6, Math.max(3, filteredOptions.length))}
                    >
                        {loadingUsers ? (
                            <option value="" disabled>Loading users…</option>
                        ) : filteredOptions.length === 0 ? (
                            <option value="" disabled>No users match "{userSearch}"</option>
                        ) : (
                            filteredOptions.map((o) => (
                                <option key={o.id} value={o.id}>{o.label}</option>
                            ))
                        )}
                    </select>
                </div>
            )}

            <input placeholder="Title" value={form.title} onChange={set('title')} required />
            <textarea placeholder="Message" rows={3} value={form.message} onChange={set('message')} required />
            <input
                placeholder="Link URL (optional, e.g. /vendor?tab=bookings)"
                value={form.link_url}
                onChange={set('link_url')}
            />

            <button type="submit" className="ntf-send-form__submit" disabled={sending}>
                {sending ? 'Sending…' : 'Send Notification'}
            </button>
        </form>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// NotificationBell.jsx
// Lives in the top Navbar (navbar__right). Polls unread count every 20s
// ("real-time" via short polling — this stack has no websocket layer), shows
// a badge, and a dropdown with the most recent notifications.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
    getNotifications, getUnreadNotificationCount,
    markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead,
} from '../../services/api';
import './Notifications.css';

const POLL_MS = 20000;

export default function NotificationBell() {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
    const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [pulse, setPulse] = useState(false);
    const lastSeenIdRef = useRef(null);
    const wrapRef = useRef(null);

    const pollCount = useCallback(async () => {
        try {
            const { data } = await getUnreadNotificationCount();
            setUnreadCount(data.unread_count);
            if (lastSeenIdRef.current !== null && data.latest_id && data.latest_id !== lastSeenIdRef.current) {
                setPulse(true);
                setTimeout(() => setPulse(false), 1600);
            }
            lastSeenIdRef.current = data.latest_id;
        } catch { /* silent — background poll */ }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        pollCount();
        const t = setInterval(pollCount, POLL_MS);
        return () => clearInterval(t);
    }, [pollCount]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const onClickOutside = (e) => {
            if (wrapRef.current && !wrapRef.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false);
        };
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', onClickOutside);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClickOutside);
    }, []);

    const openDropdown = async () => {
        const willOpen = !open;
        setOpen(willOpen);
        if (willOpen) {
            setLoading(true);
            try {
                const { data } = await getNotifications();
                setItems((data.results || data).slice(0, 8));
            } catch { setItems([]); }
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    const handleClickItem = async (n) => {
        if (!n.is_read) {
            try { await markNotificationRead(n.id); } catch {}
            setItems((p) => p.map((x) => (x.id === n.id ? { ...x, is_read: true } : x)));
            setUnreadCount((c) => Math.max(0, c - 1));
        }
        setOpen(false);
        if (n.link_url) navigate(n.link_url);
    };

    const handleMarkAll = async () => {
        try {
            await markAllNotificationsRead();
            setItems((p) => p.map((x) => ({ ...x, is_read: true })));
            setUnreadCount(0);
        } catch {}
    };

    return (
        <div className="ntf" ref={wrapRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <button
                className={`ntf-bell${pulse ? ' ntf-bell--pulse' : ''}`}
                onClick={openDropdown}
                aria-label="Notifications"
                title="Notifications"
            >
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <path d="M18 8a6 6 0 1 0-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9" />
                    <path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0" />
                </svg>
                {unreadCount > 0 && (
                    <span className="ntf-bell__badge">{unreadCount > 9 ? '9+' : unreadCount}</span>
                )}
            </button>

            {open && (
                <div className="ntf-dropdown">
                    <div className="ntf-dropdown__head">
                        <strong>Notifications</strong>
                        <button className="ntf-dropdown__markall" onClick={handleMarkAll}>Mark all read</button>
                    </div>
                    {loading ? (
                        <div className="ntf-dropdown__loading">Loading…</div>
                    ) : items.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="ntf-dropdown__empty">No notifications yet.</div>
                    ) : (
                        items.map((n) => (
                            <button
                                key={n.id}
                                className={`ntf-dropdown__item${!n.is_read ? ' ntf-dropdown__item--unread' : ''}`}
                                onClick={() => handleClickItem(n)}
                            >
                                <div className="ntf-item__row">
                                    {!n.is_read && <span className="ntf-dot" />}
                                    <span className="ntf-item__title">{n.title}</span>
                                </div>
                                <p className="ntf-item__msg">{n.message}</p>
                                <span className="ntf-item__time">{new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                            </button>
                        ))
                    )}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// NotificationsPanel.jsx
// Full-page/tab list of a user's notifications — used inside the
// "Notifications" tab on Admin, Vendor, and Customer dashboards.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { getNotifications, markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead } from '../../services/api';
import './Notifications.css';

const TYPE_ICON = {
    vehicle_added: '🚗',
    vehicle_edit_pending: '✏️',
    vehicle_edit_decided: '✅',
    booking_created: '📅',
    admin_broadcast: '📢',
    system: '🔔',
};

export default function NotificationsPanel() {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
    const [filter, setFilter] = useState(''); // '' | 'unread'
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await getNotifications(filter === 'unread' ? { is_read: 'false' } : {});
            setItems(data.results || data);
        } catch { setItems([]); }
        setLoading(false);
    }, [filter]);

    useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

    const handleClick = async (n) => {
        if (!n.is_read) {
            try { await markNotificationRead(n.id); } catch {}
            setItems((p) => p.map((x) => (x.id === n.id ? { ...x, is_read: true } : x)));
        }
        if (n.link_url) navigate(n.link_url);
    };

    const handleMarkAll = async () => {
        try { await markAllNotificationsRead(); load(); } catch {}
    };

    return (
        <div className="ntf ntf-panel">
            <div className="ntf-panel__toolbar">
                <div className="ntf-panel__pills">
                    {[['', 'All'], ['unread', 'Unread']].map(([val, label]) => (
                        <button
                            key={val}
                            className={`ntf-pill${filter === val ? ' ntf-pill--active' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => setFilter(val)}
                        >
                            {label}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
                <button className="ntf-panel__markall" onClick={handleMarkAll}>Mark all read</button>
            </div>

            {loading ? (
                <div className="ntf-panel__empty">Loading…</div>
            ) : items.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="ntf-panel__empty">
                    <span className="ntf-panel__empty-icon">🔔</span>
                    No notifications{filter === 'unread' ? " — you're all caught up." : ' yet.'}
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="ntf-panel__list">
                    {items.map((n) => (
                        <button
                            key={n.id}
                            className={`ntf-card${!n.is_read ? ' ntf-card--unread' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => handleClick(n)}
                        >
                            <span className="ntf-card__icon">{TYPE_ICON[n.notification_type] || '🔔'}</span>
                            <div className="ntf-card__body">
                                <div className="ntf-card__head">
                                    <span className="ntf-card__title">{n.title}</span>
                                    {!n.is_read && <span className="ntf-dot" />}
                                </div>
                                <p className="ntf-card__msg">{n.message}</p>
                                <span className="ntf-card__meta">
                                    {new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                                    {n.created_by_name && ` · from ${n.created_by_name}`}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function FlyTo({ center }) {
    const map = useMap();
    useEffect(() => {
        if (center) map.flyTo(center, 13, { duration: 1.2 });
    }, [center, map]);
    return null;
}

=== PATH: D:\Work\car_rental_service\frontend\src\context\AuthContext.jsx ===
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { login as apiLogin, getMe, logout as apiLogout } from '../services/api';

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const redirectUser = (userData) => {
        if (!userData) return;

        if (userData.role === 'vendor') {
            navigate('/vendor');
        } else {
            navigate('/customer');
        }
    };

    const fetchMe = useCallback(async () => {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
        if (!token) { setLoading(false); return; }
        try {
            const { data } = await getMe();
            setUser(data);
            redirectUser(data);
        } catch {
            localStorage.clear();
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => { fetchMe(); }, [fetchMe]);

    const login = async (email, password) => {
        const { data } = await apiLogin(email, password);
        localStorage.setItem('access_token', data.access);
        localStorage.setItem('refresh_token', data.refresh);
        const me = await getMe();
        setUser(me.data);
        redirectUser(me.data);
        return me.data;
    };

    const logout = async () => {
        try {
            const refresh = localStorage.getItem('refresh_token');
            await apiLogout(refresh);
        } catch { }
        localStorage.clear();
        setUser(null);
        navigate('/');
    };

    return (
        <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, login, logout, fetchMe }}>
            {children}
        </AuthContext.Provider>
    );
}

export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

export function BookingProvider({ children }) {

    const update = (partial) => setBooking((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...partial }));

    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AdminAssignmentCard.jsx
// Drag-drop target card for a single admin. Shows assigned vendor chips
// with an unassign (✕) button on each chip.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { StatusBadge } from "./AdminShared";
import { VENDOR_STATUS_CLR, getVendorPK, getAdminPK } from "./adminConstants";

export default function AdminAssignmentCard({
    admin,
    assignments,
    vendors,
    onUnassign,
    onDrop,
}) {
    const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);

    const adminPK = getAdminPK(admin);

    // Build the set of vendor User PKs currently assigned to this admin
    const myVendorPKs = new Set(
        assignments
            .filter((a) => a.is_active && Number(a.admin) === adminPK)
            .map((a) => Number(a.vendor))
            .filter(Boolean),
    );

    const myVendors = vendors.filter((v) => {
        const pk = getVendorPK(v);
        return pk != null && myVendorPKs.has(pk);
    });

    return (
        <div
            onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setDragOver(true); }}
            onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)}
            onDrop={(e) => { setDragOver(false); onDrop(e, adminPK); }}
            style={{
                background:   dragOver ? "var(--teal-light)" : "var(--vs2)",
                border:       `2px dashed ${dragOver ? "var(--teal-primary)" : "var(--vbdr)"}`,
                borderRadius: 12,
                padding:      14,
                display:      "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                gap:          10,
                minHeight:    140,
                transition:   "all .18s",
                boxShadow:    dragOver ? "0 0 0 3px rgba(13,184,158,.15)" : "none",
            }}
        >
            {/* Card header */}
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 10 }}>
                <div style={{
                    width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 10, flexShrink: 0,
                    background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#DBEAFE,#BFDBFE)",
                    color: "#1D4ED8", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800,
                    display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
                    border: "1px solid #BFDBFE",
                }}>
                    {(admin.full_name || admin.email || "A")[0].toUpperCase()}
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, display: "block", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                        {admin.full_name || admin.email}
                    </strong>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vt2)" }}>{admin.email}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 4, alignItems: "flex-end", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    <span style={{
                        padding: "3px 9px", borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700,
                        ...(admin.scope === "superadmin"
                            ? { background: "#FEF3C7", color: "#92400E", border: "1px solid #FCD34D" }
                            : { background: "#EDE9FE", color: "#6D28D9", border: "1px solid #C4B5FD" }),
                    }}>
                        {admin.scope === "superadmin" ? "👑 Super" : "🎯 Assigned"}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: "var(--vm)", background: "var(--vs)", padding: "2px 7px", borderRadius: 999, border: "1px solid var(--vbdr)" }}>
                        {myVendors.length} vendor{myVendors.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Assigned vendor chips */}
            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6, minHeight: 30 }}>
                {myVendors.length === 0 ? (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vm)", fontStyle: "italic", padding: "8px 6px", width: "100%", textAlign: "center" }}>
                        {dragOver ? "📥 Drop vendor here" : "No vendors — drag one here"}
                    </span>
                ) : (
                    myVendors.map((vendor) => {
                        const vpk = getVendorPK(vendor);
                        return (
                            <div
                                key={vendor.id}
                                style={{
                                    display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6,
                                    padding: "4px 10px 4px 8px",
                                    background: "var(--vs)", border: "1px solid var(--vbdr)",
                                    borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--vt2)",
                                }}
                            >
                                <span style={{ maxWidth: 100, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                                    {vendor.business_name}
                                </span>
                                <StatusBadge status={vendor.status} colorMap={VENDOR_STATUS_CLR} size="sm" />
                                <button
                                    onClick={() => onUnassign(vpk)}
                                    style={{ background: "none", border: "none", color: "#EF4444", fontSize: 11, cursor: "pointer", padding: 0, lineHeight: 1, opacity: 0.7, fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif" }}
                                    title="Remove assignment"
                                >
                                    ✕
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        );
                    })
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Date / time formatters
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const fmtDate = (d) => {
    if (!d) return "—";
    return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
        day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric",
    });
};

export const fmtDatetime = (d) => {
    if (!d) return "—";
    return new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-IN", {
        day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric",
        hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit",
    });
};

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// KYC completeness checker
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function getKYCStatus(vendor) {
    const checks = {
        bank:     !!vendor.bank_account_no,
        city:     !!vendor.city_id,
        location: !!(vendor.latitude && vendor.longitude),
        document: !!vendor.kyc_document,
        identity: !!(vendor.aadhaar_number || vendor.pan_number),
    };
    const done  = Object.values(checks).filter(Boolean).length;
    const total = Object.keys(checks).length;
    return { checks, done, total, complete: done === total };
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Vendor PK extractor — handles all serializer shapes
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function getVendorPK(v) {
    if (v == null) return null;
    // Shape 1 (patched backend): explicit user_id field
    if (v.user_id != null) {
        const n = Number(v.user_id);
        if (!isNaN(n) && n > 0) return n;
    }
    // Shape 2: user as nested object  { id: 5, ... }
    if (v.user != null && typeof v.user === "object" && v.user.id != null) {
        const n = Number(v.user.id);
        if (!isNaN(n) && n > 0) return n;
    }
    // Shape 3: user as flat integer
    if (v.user != null && typeof v.user === "number" && v.user > 0) return v.user;
    return null;
}

export function getAdminPK(a) {
    if (a == null) return null;
    if (a.user_id != null) return Number(a.user_id) || null;
    if (a.id      != null) return Number(a.id)      || null;
    return null;
}

    notifications: "Notifications", personalization: "Personalization",

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function AdminDashboard() {
    const [tab, setTab] = useState("overview");

    // ── Admin profile / scope ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [myProfile, setMyProfile] = useState(null);

    // ── Per-tab data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [stats,        setStats]        = useState(null);
    const [analytics,    setAnalytics]    = useState(null);
    const [vendors,      setVendors]      = useState([]);
    const [vehicles,     setVehicles]     = useState([]);
    const [vehicleStats, setVehicleStats] = useState(null);
    const [vehicleFilter,setVehicleFilter]= useState("");
    const [bookings,     setBookings]     = useState([]);
    const [users,        setUsers]        = useState([]);
    const [configs,      setConfigs]      = useState([]);
    const [segments,     setSegments]     = useState([]);
    const [configCategories, setConfigCategories] = useState([]);
    const [locations,    setLocations]    = useState([]);
    const [cities,       setCities]       = useState([]);
    const [cityPairFees, setCityPairFees] = useState([]);
    const [promos,       setPromos]       = useState([]);
    const [returnPoints, setReturnPoints] = useState([]);
    const [handovers,    setHandovers]    = useState([]);
    const [logisticsStats, setLogisticsStats] = useState(null);
    const [network,      setNetwork]      = useState([]);
    const [agreements,   setAgreements]   = useState([]);
    const [acceptances,  setAcceptances]  = useState([]);
    const [reviewVendors,setReviewVendors]= useState([]);

    // ── UI state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [loading,     setLoading]     = useState(true);
    const [error,       setError]       = useState("");
    const [formLoading, setFormLoading] = useState(false);
    const [agreementFormLoading, setAgreementFormLoading] = useState(false);

    // ── Vehicle action state (passed into VehicleDetailModal) ─────────────────
    const [docNotes,         setDocNotes]         = useState({});
    const [certifyForms,     setCertifyForms]     = useState({});
    const [blacklistReasons, setBlacklistReasons] = useState({});

    // ── Modal state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [selectedVendor,  setSelectedVendor]  = useState(null);
    const [selectedVehicle, setSelectedVehicle] = useState(null);
    const [selectedBooking, setSelectedBooking] = useState(null);
    const [selectedUser,    setSelectedUser]    = useState(null);
    const [vehiclePhotoLightbox, setVehiclePhotoLightbox] = useState(null);

    // ── Config history modal state ───────────────────────────────────────────
    const [configHistorySetting, setConfigHistorySetting] = useState(null);
    const [configHistoryData,    setConfigHistoryData]    = useState([]);
    const [configHistoryLoading, setConfigHistoryLoading] = useState(false);

    const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
    const highlightRef = useRef(null);

    // ── Fetch admin profile on mount ──────────────────────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        getMyAdminProfile()
            .then((res) => setMyProfile(res.data))
            .catch(() => setMyProfile({ scope: "superadmin", assigned_vendor_count: null, display_name: "" }));
    }, []);

    // ── Tab data loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const loadTab = useCallback(async (t) => {
        if (t === "assignments") { setLoading(false); return; }
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");
        try {
            switch (t) {
                case "overview": {
                    const [s, a] = await Promise.all([getAdminStats(), getAdminAnalytics()]);
                    setStats(s.data); setAnalytics(a.data);
                    break;
                }
                case "vendors": {
                    const { data } = await getAdminVendors();
                    setVendors(data.results ?? data);
                    break;
                }
                case "vehicles": {
                    const [v, s] = await Promise.all([getAdminVehicles(vehicleFilter || ""), getAdminVehicleStats()]);
                    setVehicles(v.data.results ?? v.data); setVehicleStats(s.data);
                    break;
                }
                case "bookings": {
                    const { data } = await getAdminBookings();
                    setBookings(data.results ?? data);
                    break;
                }
                case "users": {
                    const { data } = await getAdminUsers({ role: "customer" });
                    setUsers(data.results ?? data);
                    break;
                }
                case "config": {
                    const [c, sg, cat] = await Promise.all([
                        getConfigSettings({ include_archived: 'true' }),
                        getSegmentConfigs(),
                        getConfigCategories(),
                    ]);
                    setConfigs(c.data.results ?? c.data);
                    setSegments(sg.data.results ?? sg.data);
                    setConfigCategories(cat.data.results ?? cat.data);
                    break;
                }
                case "locations": {
                    const [l, c, cp] = await Promise.all([getLocations(), getCities(), getCityPairFees()]);
                    setLocations(l.data.results ?? l.data);
                    setCities(c.data.results ?? c.data);
                    setCityPairFees(cp.data.results ?? cp.data);
                    break;
                }
                case "logistics": {
                    const [h, ls, nw, rp, c, v] = await Promise.all([
                        getAdminLogisticsOverview(), getAdminLogisticsStats(),
                        getAdminNetworkList(), getReturnPoints(), getCities(),
                        getAdminVendors(),
                    ]);
                    setHandovers(h.data.results ?? h.data); setLogisticsStats(ls.data);
                    setNetwork(nw.data.results ?? nw.data); setReturnPoints(rp.data.results ?? rp.data);
                    setCities(c.data.results ?? c.data);
                    setVendors(v.data.results ?? v.data);
                    break;
                }
                case "promos": {
                    const { data } = await getAdminPromos();
                    setPromos(data.results ?? data);
                    break;
                }
                case "agreements": {
                    const [av, ac] = await Promise.all([getAdminAgreementVersions(), getAdminAcceptances()]);
                    setAgreements(av.data.results ?? av.data); setAcceptances(ac.data.results ?? ac.data);
                    break;
                }
                case "reviews": {
                    const vRes = await getReviewVendors();
                    setReviewVendors(vRes.data.results ?? vRes.data);
                    break;
                }
                default: break;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            setError(`Failed to load ${t}: ${e.response?.data?.detail || e.message || "Unknown error"}`);
        }
        setLoading(false);
    }, [vehicleFilter]);

    useEffect(() => { loadTab(tab); }, [tab, loadTab]);
    useEffect(() => { if (tab === "vehicles") loadTab("vehicles"); }, [vehicleFilter]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const tabParam = searchParams.get("tab");
        if (tabParam && tabParam !== tab) setTab(tabParam);
        const highlight = searchParams.get("highlight");
        if (highlight) highlightRef.current = highlight;
    }, [searchParams]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (tab === "vehicles" && highlightRef.current && vehicles.length > 0) {
            const match = vehicles.find((v) => String(v.id) === String(highlightRef.current));
            if (match) setSelectedVehicle(match);
            highlightRef.current = null;
            const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
            next.delete("highlight");
            setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
        }
    }, [vehicles, tab]);

    // ── Vendor actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleVendorAction = async (id, action, note = "") => {
        const statusMap = { approve: "approved", reject: "rejected", suspend: "suspended", reinstate: "approved", more_info: "more_info" };
        try {
            await adminVendorAction(id, action, note);
            const newStatus = statusMap[action];
            const update = (v) => v.id === id ? { ...v, status: newStatus || v.status, admin_note: note } : v;
            setVendors((p) => p.map(update));
            setSelectedVendor((prev) => prev?.id === id ? update(prev) : prev);
        } catch (e) { alert(e.response?.data?.error || "Action failed."); }
    };

    // ── Vehicle actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleDocReview = async (docId, action) => {
        try {
            await reviewDoc(docId, action, docNotes[docId] || "");
            const updater = (docs) => (docs || []).map((d) => d.id === docId ? { ...d, status: action } : d);
            setVehicles((p) => p.map((v) => ({ ...v, documents: updater(v.documents) })));
            setSelectedVehicle((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, documents: updater(prev.documents) } : prev);
            setDocNotes((p) => ({ ...p, [docId]: "" }));
        } catch { alert("Review failed."); }
    };

    const handleCertify = async (vehicleId) => {
        const f = certifyForms[vehicleId] || {};
        if (!f.cert_date || !f.odometer_at_cert) { alert("Cert date and odometer required."); return; }
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append("cert_date", f.cert_date);
        fd.append("odometer_at_cert", f.odometer_at_cert);
        if (f.file) fd.append("file", f.file);
        try { await certifyVehicle(vehicleId, fd); await loadTab("vehicles"); alert("Vehicle certified → LIVE!"); }
        catch (e) { alert(e.response?.data?.error || "Certification failed."); }
    };

    const handleBlacklist = async (vehicleId) => {
        const reason = blacklistReasons[vehicleId];
        if (!reason) { alert("Enter a reason."); return; }
        try {
            await blacklistVehicle(vehicleId, reason);
            const update = (v) => v.id === vehicleId ? { ...v, status: "INACTIVE", is_blacklisted: true } : v;
            setVehicles((p) => p.map(update));
            setSelectedVehicle((prev) => prev ? update(prev) : prev);
        } catch { alert("Blacklist failed."); }
    };

    const handleSetVehicleStatus = async (vehicleId, newStatus, note = "") => {
        try {
            const { data } = await setVehicleStatus(vehicleId, newStatus, note);
            const update = (v) => v.id === vehicleId ? { ...v, status: data.new_status } : v;
            setVehicles((p) => p.map(update));
            setSelectedVehicle((prev) => prev ? update(prev) : prev);
        } catch (e) { alert(e.response?.data?.error || "Status change failed."); }
    };

    const handleVahanCheck = async (vehicleId) => {
        try { const { data } = await vahanCheck(vehicleId); alert(`VAHAN: ${data.vahan_result?.message || "Completed"}.`); await loadTab("vehicles"); }
        catch { alert("VAHAN check failed."); }
    };

    const handleApproveVehicleEdit = async (vehicleId) => {
    try {
        const { data } = await approveVehicleEdit(vehicleId);
        await loadTab("vehicles");
        setSelectedVehicle((prev) => (prev?.id === vehicleId ? data.vehicle : prev));
        alert(data.message);
    } catch { alert("Failed to approve changes."); }
};

const handleRejectVehicleEdit = async (vehicleId) => {
    const reason = window.prompt("Reason for rejecting these changes (optional):", "") ?? "";
    try {
        await rejectVehicleEdit(vehicleId, reason);
        await loadTab("vehicles");
        setSelectedVehicle((prev) =>
            prev?.id === vehicleId
                ? { ...prev, needs_review: false, pending_changes: {}, pending_changes_readable: [] }
                : prev
        );
    } catch { alert("Failed to reject changes."); }
};

const handleCompleteReverification = async (vehicleId) => {
    try {
        const { data } = await completeReverification(vehicleId);
        await loadTab("vehicles");
        setSelectedVehicle((prev) =>
            prev?.id === vehicleId ? { ...prev, needs_reverification: false, needs_review: false } : prev
        );
        alert(data.message);
    } catch { alert("Failed to record re-verification."); }
};

    // ── Config actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleConfigSave = async (s, changeReason = "") => {
        try {
            await updateConfigSetting(s.id, s.value, changeReason);
            alert("Saved.");
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.error || e.response?.data?.value?.[0] || "Save failed.");
        }
    };

    const handleSegmentSave = async (seg) => {
        try {
            await updateSegmentConfig(seg.id, {
                security_deposit: seg.security_deposit,
                min_driver_age: seg.min_driver_age,
                min_rental_days: seg.min_rental_days,
                platform_commission_override: seg.platform_commission_override,
                is_active: seg.is_active,
            });
            alert("Segment saved.");
        } catch { alert("Save failed."); }
    };

    const handleAddConfigSetting = async (v) => {
        setFormLoading(true);
        try {
            await createConfigSetting(v);
            await loadTab("config");
        } catch (e) {
            alert(JSON.stringify(e.response?.data || "Failed to create setting."));
        }
        setFormLoading(false);
    };

    const handleArchiveConfigSetting = async (id, reason = '') => {
        try {
            const { data } = await archiveConfigSetting(id, reason);
            await loadTab("config");
            alert(data.message);
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.detail || "Couldn't archive this setting.");
        }
    };

    const handleRestoreConfigSetting = async (id) => {
        try {
            await restoreConfigSetting(id);
            await loadTab("config");
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.detail || "Couldn't restore this setting.");
        }
    };

    const handleDeleteConfigSetting = async (id) => {
        if (!window.confirm("Permanently delete this setting? This cannot be undone.")) return;
        try {
            await deleteConfigSetting(id);
            setConfigs((p) => p.filter((c) => c.id !== id));
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.detail || "Couldn't delete this setting.");
        }
    };

    const handleViewConfigHistory = async (setting) => {
        setConfigHistorySetting(setting);
        setConfigHistoryLoading(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await getConfigHistory(setting.id);
            setConfigHistoryData(data);
        } catch {
            setConfigHistoryData([]);
        }
        setConfigHistoryLoading(false);
    };

    // ── Location actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleAddCity          = async (v) => { setFormLoading(true); try { await createCity(v); await loadTab("locations"); } catch (e) { alert(JSON.stringify(e.response?.data || "Failed.")); } setFormLoading(false); };
    const handleDeleteCity       = async (id) => { if (!window.confirm("Delete?")) return; try { await deleteCity(id); setCities((p) => p.filter((c) => c.id !== id)); } catch { alert("Failed."); } };
    const handleDeleteLocation   = async (id) => { if (!window.confirm("Delete?")) return; try { await deleteLocation(id); setLocations((p) => p.filter((l) => l.id !== id)); } catch { alert("Failed."); } };
    const handleAddCityPairFee   = async (v) => { setFormLoading(true); try { await createCityPairFee(v); await loadTab("locations"); } catch { alert("Failed."); } setFormLoading(false); };
    const handleDeleteCityPairFee= async (id) => { if (!window.confirm("Delete?")) return; try { await deleteCityPairFee(id); setCityPairFees((p) => p.filter((f) => f.id !== id)); } catch { alert("Failed."); } };

    const handleDeletePromo = async (id) => { if (!window.confirm("Delete?")) return; try { await deletePromo(id); setPromos((p) => p.filter((x) => x.id !== id)); } catch { alert("Failed."); } };

    const handleAddReturnPoint = async (v) => { setFormLoading(true); try { await createReturnPoint(v); const r = await getReturnPoints(); setReturnPoints(r.data.results ?? r.data); } catch (e) { alert(JSON.stringify(e.response?.data || "Failed.")); } setFormLoading(false); };

    const handleCreateAgreement = async (formData) => {

        try { await createAgreementVersion(formData); await loadTab("agreements"); setAgreementFormLoading(false); return true; }
        catch (e) { alert(JSON.stringify(e.response?.data || "Failed.")); setAgreementFormLoading(false); return false; }

        catch (e) { alert(e.response?.data?.error || "Failed."); setAgreementFormLoading(false); return false; }

                    blacklistReasons={blacklistReasons} setBlacklistReasons={setBlacklistReasons}
