// AdminShared.jsx
// Tiny reusable UI primitives: StatusBadge, SectionCard, InlineForm,
// StarDisplay, ScopeIndicator.  No API calls here — pure presentation.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState } from "react";

// ── Status badge ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function StatusBadge({ status, colorMap, size = "md" }) {
    const s = colorMap?.[status] || { bg: "#F3F4F6", color: "#6B7280" };
    return (
        <span
            className={`admin-status-badge admin-status-badge--${size}`}
            style={{ color: s.color, background: s.bg, border: `1px solid ${s.color}30` }}
        >
            {status?.replace(/_/g, " ")}
        </span>
    );
}

// ── Section card wrapper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function SectionCard({ title, subtitle, children, action }) {
    return (
        <div className="admin-section-card">
            <div className="admin-section-card__header">
                <div>
                    <h3>{title}</h3>
                    {subtitle && <p>{subtitle}</p>}
                </div>
                {action}
            </div>
            {children}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Inline add-record form ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function InlineForm({ fields, onSubmit, submitLabel = "+ Add", loading }) {
    const [vals, setVals] = useState(() =>
        Object.fromEntries(fields.map((f) => [f.key, f.default ?? ""])),
    );
    const reset = () =>
        setVals(Object.fromEntries(fields.map((f) => [f.key, f.default ?? ""])));

    return (
        <form
            className="admin-inline-form"
            onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); onSubmit(vals); reset(); }}
        >
            {fields.map((f) => (
                <div key={f.key} className="admin-form-field">
                    <label>{f.label}</label>
                    {f.type === "select" ? (
                        <select
                            value={vals[f.key]}
                            required={f.required}
                            onChange={(e) => setVals((p) => ({ ...p, [f.key]: e.target.value }))}
                        >
                            <option value="">Select {f.label}</option>
                            {f.options?.map((o) => (
                                <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    ) : (
                        <input
                            type={f.type || "text"}
                            value={vals[f.key]}
                            step={f.step}
                            placeholder={f.placeholder}
                            required={f.required}
                            onChange={(e) => setVals((p) => ({ ...p, [f.key]: e.target.value }))}
                        />
                    )}
                </div>
            ))}
            <button type="submit" className="admin-form-submit" disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? "…" : submitLabel}
            </button>
        </form>
    );
}

// ── Star rating display ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function StarDisplay({ value, size = 14 }) {
    return (
        <span style={{ display: "inline-flex", gap: 1 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
                <span key={n} style={{ fontSize: size, color: n <= value ? "#E8A020" : "#E5E7EB", lineHeight: 1 }}>
                    ★
                </span>
            ))}
        </span>
    );
}

// ── Scope indicator (hero banner badge) ──────────────────────────────────────
export function ScopeIndicator({ profile }) {
    if (!profile) return null;
    const isSuper = profile.scope === "superadmin";
    return (
        <div className="admin-scope-indicator">
            {isSuper ? (
                <span className="admin-scope-indicator--super">
                    👑 Super Admin — Full Platform Access
                </span>
            ) : (
                <span className="admin-scope-indicator--assigned">
                    🎯 Assigned Admin
                    {profile.assigned_vendor_count != null && (
                        <> · {profile.assigned_vendor_count} vendor{profile.assigned_vendor_count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}</>
                    )}
                    {profile.display_name ? ` · ${profile.display_name}` : ""}
                </span>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MediaComponents.jsx
// PhotoLightbox  — full-screen image carousel (keyboard navigable)
// KYCDocumentCell — shows a KYC file as thumbnail / PDF link / generic link
// DocPreviewRow   — inline doc preview with status badge
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";

// ── Photo lightbox ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function PhotoLightbox({ photos, initialIndex = 0, onClose }) {
    const [idx, setIdx] = useState(initialIndex);

    useEffect(() => {
        const h = (e) => {
            if (e.key === "Escape")      onClose();
            if (e.key === "ArrowRight")  setIdx((i) => Math.min(i + 1, photos.length - 1));
            if (e.key === "ArrowLeft")   setIdx((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
        };
        window.addEventListener("keydown", h);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", h);
    }, [photos.length, onClose]);

    const src   = photos[idx]?.image || photos[idx]?.url || photos[idx];
    const label = photos[idx]?.angle || photos[idx]?.label || "";

    return (
        <div
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 9999, background: "rgba(0,0,0,.9)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16 }}
        >
            <button
                onClick={onClose}
                style={{ position: "absolute", top: 20, right: 24, background: "rgba(255,255,255,.12)", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)", color: "#fff", borderRadius: 8, padding: "6px 16px", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: "pointer" }}
            >
                ✕ Close
            </button>
            <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 16 }}>
                <button
                    onClick={() => setIdx((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0))}
                    disabled={idx === 0}
                    style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,.12)", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)", color: "#fff", borderRadius: 8, padding: "10px 18px", fontSize: 20, cursor: idx === 0 ? "not-allowed" : "pointer", opacity: idx === 0 ? 0.3 : 1 }}
                >‹</button>
                <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                    <img src={src} alt={label} style={{ maxWidth: "min(80vw,960px)", maxHeight: "72vh", objectFit: "contain", borderRadius: 12 }} />
                    {label && (
                        <div style={{ marginTop: 10, fontSize: 12, color: "rgba(255,255,255,.6)", textTransform: "capitalize" }}>
                            {label} · {idx + 1}/{photos.length}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
                <button
                    onClick={() => setIdx((i) => Math.min(i + 1, photos.length - 1))}
                    disabled={idx === photos.length - 1}
                    style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,.12)", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)", color: "#fff", borderRadius: 8, padding: "10px 18px", fontSize: 20, cursor: idx === photos.length - 1 ? "not-allowed" : "pointer", opacity: idx === photos.length - 1 ? 0.3 : 1 }}
                >›</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── KYC document cell ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function KYCDocumentCell({ url }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    if (!url)
        return <span style={{ color: "#EF4444", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600 }}>Not uploaded</span>;

    const isImg = /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i.test(url);
    const isPDF = url.toLowerCase().includes(".pdf");

    return (
        <>
            {isImg ? (
                <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 4, alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
                    <div
                        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
                        style={{ cursor: "pointer", borderRadius: 6, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid var(--vbdr)", display: "inline-block" }}
                    >
                        <img src={url} alt="KYC" style={{ width: 72, height: 52, objectFit: "cover", display: "block" }} />
                    </div>
                    <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--teal-primary)", textDecoration: "underline" }}>
                        Open ↗
                    </a>
                </div>
            ) : isPDF ? (
                <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="admin-doc-link">
                    <span>📄</span><span>PDF</span>
                </a>
            ) : (
                <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="admin-doc-link">
                    <span>📎</span><span>File</span>
                </a>
            )}
            {open && (
                <PhotoLightbox photos={[{ image: url, label: "KYC Document" }]} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />
            )}
        </>
    );
}

// ── Doc preview row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function DocPreviewRow({ doc }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    if (!doc?.file) return null;

    const isImg = /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i.test(doc.file);
    const isPDF = doc.file.toLowerCase().includes(".pdf");
    const dc =
        doc.status === "approved" ? { bg: "#D1FAE5", color: "#059669" } :
        doc.status === "rejected" ? { bg: "#FEE2E2", color: "#EF4444" } :
                                    { bg: "#FEF3C7", color: "#D97706" };

    return (
        <>
            {open && isImg && (
                <PhotoLightbox photos={[{ image: doc.file, label: doc.doc_type }]} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />
            )}
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 7 }}>
                {isImg ? (
                    <div onClick={() => setOpen(true)} style={{ cursor: "pointer", borderRadius: 5, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid var(--vbdr)", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        <img src={doc.file} alt={doc.doc_type} style={{ width: 48, height: 36, objectFit: "cover", display: "block" }} />
                    </div>
                ) : isPDF ? (
                    <a href={doc.file} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--teal-primary)", background: "#E6F7F5", padding: "2px 7px", borderRadius: 4, fontWeight: 600, textDecoration: "none" }}>
                        📄 PDF
                    </a>
                ) : (
                    <a href={doc.file} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--teal-primary)" }}>View</a>
                )}
                <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700, padding: "1px 5px", borderRadius: 3, background: dc.bg, color: dc.color }}>
                    {doc.status}
                </span>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

// VehicleDetailModal.jsx
// Full vehicle review sheet: pipeline progress, document checklist,
// photo strip, status change, certification, VAHAN check, blacklist.
//
// NEW: pending-edit approval panel. When a vendor submits changes to an
// already-reviewed vehicle, the backend stages them (pending_changes) and
// sets needs_review=True instead of applying them. This panel shows the
// old → new diff and lets the admin Approve & Apply or Reject.
// Also shows a re-verification panel when odometer distance crosses the
// configured threshold.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React from "react";
import { StatusBadge } from "../AdminShared";
import { DocPreviewRow } from "../MediaComponents";
import {
    VEHICLE_STATUS_CLR,
    REQUIRED_DOCS,
    PIPELINE_STEPS,
    fmtDatetime,
} from "../adminConstants";

export default function VehicleDetailModal({
    vehicle: v,
    onClose,
    docNotes,
    setDocNotes,
    certifyForms,
    setCertifyForms,
    blacklistReasons,
    setBlacklistReasons,
    onDocReview,
    onCertify,
    onBlacklist,
    onSetStatus,
    onVahanCheck,
    onApproveEdit,
    onRejectEdit,
    onCompleteReverification,
    setVehiclePhotoLightbox,
}) {
    const docMap     = Object.fromEntries((v.documents || []).map((d) => [d.doc_type, d]));
    const requiredOk = ["rc", "insurance", "puc"].every((k) => docMap[k]?.status === "approved");
    const photoCount = (v.photos || []).length;
    const currentStep = PIPELINE_STEPS.find((p) => p.status === v.status)?.step ?? 0;

    return (
        <div className="admin-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
            <div className="admin-modal" style={{ maxWidth: 1000 }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>

                {/* Head */}
                <div className="admin-modal__head">
                    <div>
                        <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 800 }}>
                            {v.year} {v.make} {v.model}
                        </h2>
                        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginTop: 6, flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center" }}>
                            <span className="vcard-v2__plate">{v.plate_number}</span>
                            <StatusBadge status={v.status} colorMap={VEHICLE_STATUS_CLR} />
                            {v.is_blacklisted && <span className="admin-blacklisted-badge">🚫 Blacklisted</span>}
                            {v.is_certified   && <span className="admin-certified-badge">✅ Certified</span>}
                            {v.needs_review && (
                                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, padding: "3px 9px", borderRadius: 999, background: "#FEF3C7", color: "#D97706", border: "1px solid #FCD34D" }}>
                                    ✏️ Vendor Changes Pending
                                </span>
                            )}
                            {v.needs_reverification && (
                                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, padding: "3px 9px", borderRadius: 999, background: "#FEE2E2", color: "#EF4444", border: "1px solid #FCA5A5" }}>
                                    🔁 Re-verification Due
                                </span>
                            )}
                            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vm)" }}>
                                {v.vendor?.vendor_profile?.business_name || v.vendor?.email} · {v.city?.name}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: "none", border: "1px solid var(--vbdr)", borderRadius: 8, padding: "6px 14px", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 13, color: "var(--vm)", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        ✕ Close
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* Pipeline */}
                {v.status !== "INACTIVE" && (
                    <div className="vcard-pipeline" style={{ padding: "10px 20px", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--vbdr)" }}>
                        {PIPELINE_STEPS.map((step, idx) => {
                            const done   = step.step < currentStep;
                            const active = step.step === currentStep;
                            return (
                                <React.Fragment key={step.status}>
                                    <div className={`vcard-pipeline__step ${done ? "done" : active ? "active" : "future"}`}>
                                        <div className="vcard-pipeline__dot">{done ? "✓" : step.step}</div>
                                        <span>{step.label}</span>
                                    </div>
                                    {idx < PIPELINE_STEPS.length - 1 && (
                                        <div className={`vcard-pipeline__line ${done ? "done" : ""}`} />
                                    )}
                                </React.Fragment>
                            );
                        })}
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* ── Pending vendor edit / re-verification panels ── */}
                {(v.needs_review || v.needs_reverification) && (
                    <div style={{ padding: "14px 20px", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--vbdr)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10 }}>

                        {v.needs_review && (

                                                <strong>{c.label}</strong>
                                                <span>
                                                    <s style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>{c.old_value ?? "—"}</s>

                        {v.needs_reverification && (

                                <div className="vcard-action-block__hd">🔁 Odometer Re-verification Due</div>
                                <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#7F1D1D", margin: "4px 0 8px" }}>
                                    Current odometer: {v.current_odometer?.toLocaleString("en-IN") ?? "—"} km ·
                                    {" "}Last verified: {v.last_verified_odometer?.toLocaleString("en-IN") ?? "—"} km
                                </p>

                                </button>

                )}

                    {/* Documents column */}
                    <div className="vcard-v2__docs-col">
                        <div className="vcard-v2__col-hd">
                            <span>📄 Documents</span>
                            <span className="vcard-v2__col-sub">
                                {(v.documents || []).filter((d) => d.status === "approved").length}/{(v.documents || []).length} approved

function MobileAcceptanceCard({ a }) {

                    </span>
                </div>

                </span>

function MobileAcceptanceList({ acceptances, agreements }) {
    const [search,    setSearch]    = useState("");
    const [versionId, setVersionId] = useState("");

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let r = acceptances;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            r = r.filter(a =>
                (a.user_name    || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (a.user_email   || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (a.booking_ref  || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (a.version_tag  || "").toLowerCase().includes(q)
            );
        }
        if (versionId) r = r.filter(a => String(a.agreement_version_id) === versionId);
        return r;
    }, [acceptances, search, versionId]);

    return (
        <div className="adm-mob-list">
            <div className="adm-mob-search-wrap">
                <svg className="adm-mob-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5"/>
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
                </svg>
                <input className="adm-mob-search" type="search" placeholder="Search by user, booking, version…"
                    value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}/>
            </div>
            {/* Version filter pills */}
            <div className="adm-mob-pills">
                <button className={`adm-mob-pill${versionId === "" ? " adm-mob-pill--active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setVersionId("")}>All</button>
                {agreements.map(v => (
                    <button key={v.id}
                        className={`adm-mob-pill${versionId === String(v.id) ? " adm-mob-pill--active" : ""}`}
                        onClick={() => setVersionId(String(v.id))}>
                        {v.version_tag}
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {(search || versionId) && (
                <p className="adm-mob-count">{filtered.length} of {acceptances.length} acceptances</p>
            )}
            {filtered.length === 0
                ? <div className="admin-empty" style={{ padding: "40px 24px" }}><span>📋</span><p>No acceptances match.</p></div>
                : <div className="adm-mob-cards">{filtered.map((a, i) => <MobileAcceptanceCard key={a.id ?? i} a={a}/>)}</div>
            }
        </div>
    );
}

                            <label>Content * (Markdown)</label>
                            <textarea rows={10} value={form.content} required onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,content:e.target.value}))} style={textareaStyle}/>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ display:"flex", gap:8 }}>
                            <button type="submit" className="admin-form-submit" disabled={agreementFormLoading}>{agreementFormLoading?"…":"+ Create Draft"}</button>
                            <button type="button" className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost" onClick={()=>setShowCreate(false)}>Cancel</button>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                )}

                {/* Edit form */}
                {editingVersion && (
                    <form onSubmit={handleUpdate} style={{ background:"#FFFBEB", border:"1px solid #FCD34D", borderRadius:12, padding:"18px 20px", display:"flex", flexDirection:"column", gap:12, marginBottom:16 }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize:11, fontWeight:700, textTransform:"uppercase", color:"#D97706" }}>Editing {editingVersion.version_tag}</div>
                        <div className="admin-form-field">
                            <label>Title</label>
                            <input type="text" value={editingVersion.title} onChange={e=>setEditingVersion(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))}/>
                        </div>
                        <div className="admin-form-field">
                            <label>Summary</label>
                            <input type="text" value={editingVersion.summary||""} onChange={e=>setEditingVersion(p=>({...p,summary:e.target.value}))}/>
                        </div>
                        <div className="admin-form-field">
                            <label>Content</label>
                            <textarea rows={10} value={editingVersion.content} onChange={e=>setEditingVersion(p=>({...p,content:e.target.value}))} style={textareaStyle}/>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ display:"flex", gap:8 }}>
                            <button type="submit" className="admin-form-submit" disabled={agreementFormLoading}>{agreementFormLoading?"…":"Save Changes"}</button>
                            <button type="button" className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost" onClick={()=>setEditingVersion(null)}>Cancel</button>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                )}

                {/* Version list — unchanged */}
                <div className="admin-card-list">
                    {agreements.map(v => (
                        <div key={v.id} style={{ background:v.is_active?"#E6F7F5":"#F8FAFB", border:`1px solid ${v.is_active?"rgba(13,184,158,.35)":"#E8EDF2"}`, borderRadius:12, padding:"14px 18px", display:"flex", alignItems:"center", gap:16, flexWrap:"wrap" }}>
                            <div style={{ flex:1 }}>
                                <div style={{ display:"flex", alignItems:"center", gap:10, marginBottom:4, flexWrap:"wrap" }}>
                                    <span style={{ fontFamily:"DM Mono,monospace", fontSize:14, fontWeight:700, color:v.is_active?"#0A9E87":"#111827" }}>{v.version_tag}</span>
                                    {v.is_active && <span style={{ background:"#0DB89E", color:"#fff", fontSize:9, fontWeight:800, padding:"2px 8px", borderRadius:999 }}>LIVE</span>}
                                    <span style={{ background:v.acceptance_count>0?"#DBEAFE":"#F3F4F6", color:v.acceptance_count>0?"#1D4ED8":"#6B7280", fontSize:10, fontWeight:700, padding:"2px 8px", borderRadius:999 }}>
                                        {v.acceptance_count} signed
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <div style={{ fontSize:13, fontWeight:600 }}>{v.title}</div>
                                {v.summary && <div style={{ fontSize:12, color:"#6B7280", maxWidth:480, overflow:"hidden", textOverflow:"ellipsis", whiteSpace:"nowrap" }}>{v.summary}</div>}
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ display:"flex", gap:6 }}>
                                {!v.is_active && <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--success" onClick={()=>onActivateAgreement(v.id,v.version_tag)}>✓ Activate</button>}
                                <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost" onClick={()=>{ setEditingVersion({...v}); setShowCreate(false); }}>✏ Edit</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                    {agreements.length===0 && <div style={{ textAlign:"center", padding:"30px 0", color:"var(--vm)", fontSize:13 }}>No agreement versions yet.</div>}
                </div>
            </SectionCard>

            {/* Acceptance audit log */}
            <SectionCard title="Acceptance Audit Log" subtitle="Immutable record of every customer who signed.">
                <div className="adm-desktop">
                    <DataTable columns={acceptanceCols} data={acceptances} searchable
                        searchKeys={["user_name","user_email","booking_ref","version_tag"]}
                        searchPlaceholder="Search by user, booking ref, version…"
                        filters={[{
                            key:"agreement_version_id", label:"Version",
                            options:[{value:"",label:"All Versions"},...agreements.map(v=>({value:String(v.id),label:`${v.version_tag} (${v.acceptance_count})`}))],
                        }]}
                        emptyIcon="📋" emptyMessage="No acceptances found." pageSize={25}/>
                </div>
                <div className="adm-mobile">
                    <MobileAcceptanceList acceptances={acceptances} agreements={agreements}/>
                </div>
            </SectionCard>
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AssignmentsTab.jsx
// Superadmin: full vendor-admin assignment management (matrix + table view).
// Assigned admin: read-only list of their assigned vendors.
//
// Three assignment methods:
//   1. Per-row dropdown  → assignVendorToAdmin()
//   2. Checkbox bulk     → bulkAssignVendors()
//   3. Drag-and-drop     → assignVendorToAdmin()
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
    getAdminList,
    getAdminVendors,
    getAllAssignments,
    assignVendorToAdmin,
    bulkAssignVendors,
    unassignVendor,
    getAssignmentHistory,
} from "../../../services/api";
import DataTable from "../../../components/common/DataTable";
import AdminAssignmentCard from "../AdminAssignmentCard";
import { StatusBadge } from "../AdminShared";
import {
    VENDOR_STATUS_CLR,
    fmtDate,
    fmtDatetime,
    getVendorPK,
    getAdminPK,
} from "../adminConstants";

export default function AssignmentsTab({ myProfile }) {
    const isSuperAdmin = myProfile?.scope === "superadmin";

    // ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [admins,      setAdmins]      = useState([]);
    const [vendors,     setVendors]     = useState([]);
    const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState([]);
    const [loading,     setLoading]     = useState(true);
    const [busy,        setBusy]        = useState(false);
    const [error,       setError]       = useState("");

    // ── Selection — plain object { [vendorPK]: true } avoids Set/React pitfalls
    const [selectedMap,  setSelectedMap]  = useState({});
    const [bulkAdminPK,  setBulkAdminPK]  = useState("");
    const [pickAdminMap, setPickAdminMap] = useState({});  // { [vendorPK]: adminPK string }

    // ── UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [searchQ,    setSearchQ]    = useState("");
    const [historyV,   setHistoryV]   = useState(null);
    const [historyData,setHistoryData]= useState([]);
    const [viewMode,   setViewMode]   = useState("matrix");

    const selectedCount = Object.keys(selectedMap).length;

    // ── Load ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");
        try {
            const [aRes, vRes, asRes] = await Promise.all([
                getAdminList(),
                getAdminVendors(),
                getAllAssignments(),
            ]);
            setAdmins(aRes.data);
            setVendors(vRes.data.results ?? vRes.data);
            setAssignments(asRes.data);
            setSelectedMap({});
            setBulkAdminPK("");
        } catch (e) {
            setError(e.response?.data?.detail || e.message || "Failed to load.");
        }
        setLoading(false);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

    // ── Derived ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const assignedPKs = new Set(
        assignments
            .filter((a) => a.is_active)
            .map((a) => Number(a.vendor))
            .filter(Boolean),
    );

    const unassigned = vendors.filter((v) => {
        const pk = getVendorPK(v);
        if (pk == null) return true;   // fail-open: show as unassigned if PK unknown
        return !assignedPKs.has(pk);
    });

    const filteredUnassigned = unassigned.filter(
        (v) =>
            !searchQ ||
            v.business_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQ.toLowerCase()) ||
            (v.email ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQ.toLowerCase()),
    );

    // ── Checkbox helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const toggleVendor = (vpk) => {
        if (vpk == null) return;
        const key = String(vpk);
        setSelectedMap((prev) => {
            const next = { ...prev };
            next[key] ? delete next[key] : (next[key] = true);
            return next;
        });
    };

    const selectAll = () => {
        const next = {};
        filteredUnassigned.forEach((v) => {
            const pk = getVendorPK(v);
            if (pk != null) next[String(pk)] = true;
        });
        setSelectedMap(next);
    };

    const clearSelection = () => { setSelectedMap({}); setBulkAdminPK(""); };

    const isSelected = (v) => {
        const pk = getVendorPK(v);
        return pk != null && Boolean(selectedMap[String(pk)]);
    };

    // ── Per-row dropdown helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    const getPickAdmin  = (v)       => pickAdminMap[String(getVendorPK(v))] ?? "";
    const setPickAdmin  = (v, val)  => setPickAdminMap((p) => ({ ...p, [String(getVendorPK(v))]: val }));
    const clearPickAdmin = (v)      => setPickAdminMap((p) => { const n = { ...p }; delete n[String(getVendorPK(v))]; return n; });

    // ── API actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleAssign = async (vendorPKs, adminPK) => {
        const validPKs = vendorPKs.filter((pk) => pk != null && !isNaN(pk) && pk > 0);
        if (!validPKs.length || !adminPK) return;
        setBusy(true);
        try {
            if (validPKs.length === 1) await assignVendorToAdmin(validPKs[0], adminPK);
            else                       await bulkAssignVendors(validPKs, adminPK);
            clearSelection();
            await load();
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.error || e.response?.data?.detail || "Assignment failed.");
        }
        setBusy(false);
    };

    const handleUnassign = async (vpk) => {
        if (!window.confirm("Remove this vendor assignment?")) return;
        setBusy(true);
        try {
            await unassignVendor(vpk);
            await load();
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data?.error || "Failed.");
        }
        setBusy(false);
    };

    const handleDrop = (e, adminPK) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        try {
            const { vendorPK } = JSON.parse(e.dataTransfer.getData("application/json"));
            if (vendorPK && adminPK) handleAssign([Number(vendorPK)], adminPK);
        } catch { /* ignore bad drag data */ }
    };

    const showHistory = async (v) => {
        setHistoryV(v);
        try {
            const r = await getAssignmentHistory(getVendorPK(v));
            setHistoryData(r.data);
        } catch { setHistoryData([]); }
    };

    // ── Table view columns ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const asgCols = [
        {
            key: "vendor_business", label: "Vendor", sortable: true, width: 200,
            render: (v, row) => (
                <div className="dt-cell-stack">
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__primary">{v || "—"}</span>
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__secondary">{row.vendor_email}</span>
                </div>
            ),
        },
        {
            key: "admin_name", label: "Admin", sortable: true, width: 180,
            render: (v, row) => (
                <div className="dt-cell-stack">
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__primary">{v || "—"}</span>
                    <span className="dt-cell-stack__secondary">{row.admin_email}</span>
                </div>
            ),
        },
        { key: "assigned_at",      label: "Since",  sortable: true, width: 120, render: (v) => fmtDate(v)    },
        { key: "assigned_by_name", label: "By",     sortable: true, width: 130, render: (v) => v || "—"      },
        {
            key: "is_active", label: "Status", sortable: true, width: 90,
            render: (v) => (
                <span className="admin-status-badge admin-status-badge--sm" style={
                    v ? { background: "#D1FAE5", color: "#059669", border: "1px solid #6EE7B740" }
                      : { background: "#F3F4F6", color: "#9CA3AF", border: "1px solid #E5E7EB"  }
                }>
                    {v ? "● Active" : "○ Ended"}
                </span>
            ),
        },
    ];

    // ── Non-superadmin view (read-only) ───────────────────────────────────────
    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
        return (
            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16 }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}>
                    <div>
                        <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 4px", fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700 }}>My Assigned Vendors</h3>
                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12, color: "var(--vm)" }}>Vendors you are responsible for managing.</p>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ padding: "4px 12px", borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, background: "#EDE9FE", color: "#6D28D9", border: "1px solid #C4B5FD" }}>
                        🎯 Assigned Admin
                    </span>
                </div>
                {loading ? (
                    <div className="admin-loading"><div className="admin-loading__spinner" />Loading…</div>
                ) : (
                    <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr))", gap: 10 }}>
                        {vendors.filter((v) => assignedPKs.has(getVendorPK(v))).map((v) => (
                            <div key={v.id} style={{ background: "var(--vs)", border: "1px solid var(--vbdr)", borderRadius: 12, padding: "14px 16px" }}>
                                <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>{v.business_name}</div>
                                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vt2)", marginTop: 4 }}>{v.email}</div>
                                <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}><StatusBadge status={v.status} colorMap={VENDOR_STATUS_CLR} /></div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                        {vendors.filter((v) => assignedPKs.has(getVendorPK(v))).length === 0 && (
                            <div style={{ gridColumn: "1/-1", textAlign: "center", padding: 40, color: "var(--vm)", fontSize: 13 }}>
                                No vendors assigned yet. Contact a superadmin.
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }

    // ── Superadmin view ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    return (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 18 }}>

            {/* Header */}
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12 }}>
                <div>
                    <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 4px", fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700 }}>Vendor–Admin Assignments</h3>
                    <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12, color: "var(--vm)" }}>
                        ① Tick checkboxes → bulk-assign bar &nbsp;·&nbsp; ② Drag onto admin card &nbsp;·&nbsp; ③ Per-row dropdown
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                    <span style={{ padding: "4px 12px", borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#FFFBEB,#FEF3C7)", color: "#92400E", border: "1px solid #FCD34D" }}>

"1px solid var(--vbdr2)" : "none", background: viewMode === m ? "var(--teal-primary)" : "var(--vs2)", color: viewMode === m ? "#fff" : "var(--vm)" }}>
                                {lbl}
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={load} disabled={busy} style={{ padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, border: "1px solid var(--vbdr2)", background: "var(--vs2)", color: "var(--vt2)", cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif" }}>
                        ↺ Refresh
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            {error && (
                <div style={{ background: "#FEE2E2", border: "1px solid #FCA5A5", color: "#B91C1C", padding: "10px 16px", borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 13 }}>⚠ {error}</div>
            )}

            {/* KPI strip */}
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                {[
                    ["👥", "Admins",     admins.length,                      "#1D4ED8"],

            {loading ? (
                <div className="admin-loading"><div className="admin-loading__spinner" />Loading assignment data…</div>

                            </div>

                            {admins.map((admin) => (

                                    key={admin.id}
                                    admin={admin}
                                    assignments={assignments}
                                    vendors={vendors}
                                    onUnassign={handleUnassign}

                            {admins.length === 0 && (

                    {unassigned.length > 0 && (

                            <div className="admin-section-card__header">
                                <div>
                                    <h3>⚠ Unassigned Vendors ({unassigned.length})</h3>
                                    <p>Tick checkboxes to bulk-assign, drag onto a card above, or use the per-row dropdown.</p>
                                </div>
                                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 7, alignItems: "center" }}>
                                    {selectedCount > 0 && (
                                        <>
                                            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: "var(--teal-primary)", background: "var(--teal-light)", padding: "4px 10px", borderRadius: 999, border: "1px solid rgba(13,184,158,.3)", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                                                {selectedCount} selected
                                            </span>
                                            <button onClick={clearSelection} style={{ padding: "5px 10px", borderRadius: 7, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, border: "1px solid var(--vbdr2)", background: "var(--vs2)", color: "var(--vt2)", cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                                                ✕ Clear
                                            </button>
                                        </>
                                    )}
                                    <button onClick={selectAll} style={{ padding: "5px 10px", borderRadius: 7, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, border: "1px solid var(--vbdr2)", background: "var(--vs2)", color: "var(--vt2)", cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                                        ☑ Select All
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Search */}
                            <input
                                placeholder="Search unassigned vendors…"
                                value={searchQ}
                                onChange={(e) => setSearchQ(e.target.value)}
                                style={{ background: "var(--vs2)", border: "1px solid var(--vbdr2)", borderRadius: 8, color: "var(--vt)", padding: "7px 12px", fontSize: 12, outline: "none", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif", maxWidth: 320, transition: "border-color .14s" }}
                            />

                            {/* Bulk-assign toolbar — visible when ≥1 vendor selected */}
                            {selectedCount > 0 && (
                                <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap", background: "var(--teal-light)", border: "1px solid rgba(13,184,158,.35)", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 14px" }}>
                                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: "var(--teal-dark)", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                                        📦 {selectedCount} vendor{selectedCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""} selected
                                    </span>
                                    <select
                                        value={bulkAdminPK}
                                        onChange={(e) => setBulkAdminPK(e.target.value)}
                                        style={{ background: "var(--vs)", border: "1px solid var(--vbdr2)", borderRadius: 8, color: "var(--vt)", padding: "6px 10px", fontSize: 12, outline: "none", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif", flex: 1, minWidth: 180, cursor: "pointer" }}
                                    >
                                        <option value="">— Assign all selected to… —</option>
                                        {admins.map((a) => (
                                            <option key={a.id} value={String(getAdminPK(a))}>
                                                {a.full_name || a.email}
                                            </option>
                                        ))}
                                    </select>
                                    <button
                                        disabled={!bulkAdminPK || busy}
                                        onClick={() => {
                                            const pks = Object.keys(selectedMap).map(Number).filter((pk) => !isNaN(pk) && pk > 0);
                                            handleAssign(pks, Number(bulkAdminPK));
                                        }}
                                        style={{ background: bulkAdminPK ? "var(--teal-primary)" : "#9CA3AF", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, padding: "7px 16px", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, cursor: bulkAdminPK ? "pointer" : "not-allowed", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif", whiteSpace: "nowrap", transition: "background .14s" }}
                                    >
                                        {busy ? "…" : `Assign ${selectedCount} →`}
                                    </button>
                                    <button onClick={clearSelection} style={{ padding: "6px 11px", borderRadius: 7, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, border: "1px solid rgba(13,184,158,.4)", background: "transparent", color: "var(--teal-dark)", cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "Inter,sans-serif", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                                        ✕ Deselect
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {/* Vendor rows */}
                            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 4, maxHeight: 420, overflowY: "auto" }}>
                                {filteredUnassigned.map((v) => {
                                    const vpk  = getVendorPK(v);
                                    const sel  = isSelected(v);
                                    const pick = getPickAdmin(v);
                                    return (
                                        <div
                                            key={v.id}
                                            style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, padding: "10px 12px", background: sel ? "var(--teal-light)" : "var(--vs)", border: `1px solid ${sel ? "var(--teal-primary)" : "var(--vbdr)"}`, borderRadius: 10, flexWrap: "wrap", transition: "all .14s" }}
                                        >
                                            {/* Method 2: checkbox */}
                                            <input
                                                type="checkbox"
                                                checked={sel}
                                                onChange={() => toggleVendor(vpk)}
                                                style={{ width: 15, height: 15, accentColor: "var(--teal-primary)", flexShrink: 0, cursor: "pointer" }}
                                            />

                                            {/* Method 3: drag handle */}

function MobileBookingCard({ booking: b, onSelect }) {
    const amount = parseFloat(b.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString("en-IN");
    return (

                </div>
            )}

                <span className="adm-mob-card__meta">
                    {b.pickup_date || "—"}
                    {b.rental_days ? ` · ${b.rental_days}d` : ""}

function MobileBookingList({ bookings, onSelect }) {
    const [search,  setSearch]  = useState("");
    const [status,  setStatus]  = useState("");

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let r = bookings;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            r = r.filter(b =>
                (b.booking_ref    || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (b.customer_name  || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (b.vehicle_display|| "").toLowerCase().includes(q)
            );
        }
        if (status) r = r.filter(b => b.status === status);
        return r;
    }, [bookings, search, status]);

    return (
        <div className="adm-mob-list">
            <div className="adm-mob-search-wrap">
                <svg className="adm-mob-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5"/>
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
                </svg>
                <input className="adm-mob-search" type="search" placeholder="Search bookings…"
                    value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-pills">
                {STATUS_OPTIONS.map(o => (
                    <button key={o.value}
                        className={`adm-mob-pill${status === o.value ? " adm-mob-pill--active" : ""}`}
                        onClick={() => setStatus(o.value)}>{o.label}</button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {(search || status) && (
                <p className="adm-mob-count">{filtered.length} of {bookings.length} bookings</p>
            )}
            {filtered.length === 0
                ? <div className="admin-empty" style={{padding:"40px 24px"}}><span>📋</span><p>No bookings match.</p></div>
                : <div className="adm-mob-cards">{filtered.map((b,i) => <MobileBookingCard key={b.id??i} booking={b} onSelect={onSelect}/>)}</div>
            }
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// tabs/ConfigTab.jsx
// Designed for non-technical admins: no internal "key" is ever shown or typed.
// Value Type is a plain-language choice with live examples. Deletion is a
// reversible Archive step; permanent delete only unlocks after archiving.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { SectionCard } from "../AdminShared";

// Friendly type choices shown to admins. "json" is deliberately excluded —
// it's for internal system settings only and isn't something an admin
// should hand-author.
const TYPE_CHOICES = [
    { value: "percentage", label: "Percentage",  hint: "A rate out of 100, like a tax or commission.", example: "e.g. 18 means 18%" },
    { value: "number",     label: "Amount",       hint: "A plain number — money, a count, or hours.",   example: "e.g. 300 or 48" },
    { value: "boolean",    label: "Yes / No",     hint: "A simple on/off switch.",                       example: "e.g. enabled or disabled" },
    { value: "text",       label: "Text",         hint: "Free-form words, like a label or message.",     example: "e.g. \"Welcome!\"" },
];

function typeLabel(value_type) {
    return TYPE_CHOICES.find((t) => t.value === value_type)?.label || value_type;
}

// ── Type-aware value input, used both in the create form and inline edit ──
function ValueInput({ valueType, value, onChange, autoFocus }) {
    if (valueType === "boolean") {
        const isYes = String(value).toLowerCase() === "true" || value === true;
        return (
            <select
                className="admin-search-input"
                style={{ width: 140 }}
                value={isYes ? "true" : "false"}
                onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
                autoFocus={autoFocus}
            >
                <option value="true">Yes / Enabled</option>
                <option value="false">No / Disabled</option>
            </select>
        );
    }
    if (valueType === "percentage") {
        return (
            <div style={{ position: "relative", display: "inline-block" }}>
                <input
                    type="number"
                    value={value}
                    onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: 100, paddingRight: 22 }}
                    autoFocus={autoFocus}
                />
                <span style={{ position: "absolute", right: 8, top: "50%", transform: "translateY(-50%)", fontSize: 12, color: "var(--vm)", pointerEvents: "none" }}>%</span>
            </div>
        );
    }
    if (valueType === "number") {
        return <input type="number" value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 120 }} autoFocus={autoFocus} />;
    }
    return <input type="text" value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 180 }} autoFocus={autoFocus} />;
}

// ── Guided "New Setting" form ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function NewSettingForm({ categories, onSubmit, onCancel, loading, serverError }) {
    const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState("");
    const [categoryId,  setCategoryId]  = useState("");
    const [valueType,   setValueType]   = useState("number");
    const [value,       setValue]       = useState("");
    const [description, setDescription] = useState("");

    const selectedCategory = categories.find((c) => String(c.id) === String(categoryId));
    const selectedType     = TYPE_CHOICES.find((t) => t.value === valueType);

    const handleSubmit = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onSubmit({
            display_name: displayName,
            category: categoryId,
            value_type: valueType,
            value: valueType === "boolean" ? (value === "true" ? "true" : "false") : value,
            description,
        });
    };

    return (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ background: "#F8FAFB", border: "1px solid #E8EDF2", borderRadius: 12, padding: "20px 22px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px", color: "#0DB89E" }}>
                New Setting
            </div>

            {serverError && (
                <div style={{ background: "#FEE2E2", border: "1px solid #FCA5A5", color: "#B91C1C", padding: "10px 14px", borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 13 }}>
                    {serverError}
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Step 1: Name it */}
            <div className="admin-form-field">
                <label>What is this setting called?</label>
                <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Late Return Fee Per Hour"
                    value={displayName}
                    onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)}
                    required
                />
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vm)", marginTop: 4 }}>
                    Use a clear, everyday name — this is exactly what you and other admins will see and search for later.
                </span>
            </div>

            {/* Step 2: Where does it live */}
            <div className="admin-form-field">
                <label>Which area does it belong to?</label>
                <select value={categoryId} onChange={(e) => setCategoryId(e.target.value)} required>
                    <option value="">Choose a category…</option>
                    {categories.map((c) => (
                        <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>
                    ))}
                </select>
                {selectedCategory?.description && (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vm)", marginTop: 4 }}>{selectedCategory.description}</span>
                )}
            </div>

            {/* Step 3: What kind of value */}
            <div className="admin-form-field">
                <label>What kind of value is this?</label>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                    {TYPE_CHOICES.map((t) => (
                        <button
                            key={t.value}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => { setValueType(t.value); setValue(t.value === "boolean" ? "true" : ""); }}
                            className={`admin-btn admin-btn--sm ${valueType === t.value ? "admin-btn--primary" : "admin-btn--ghost"}`}
                        >
                            {t.label}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
                {selectedType && (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vm)", marginTop: 4 }}>
                        {selectedType.hint} ({selectedType.example})
                    </span>
                )}
            </div>

            {/* Step 4: The value itself */}
            <div className="admin-form-field">
                <label>What should the value be right now?</label>
                <ValueInput valueType={valueType} value={value} onChange={setValue} />
            </div>

            {/* Step 5: Optional description */}
            <div className="admin-form-field">
                <label>Notes for other admins (optional)</label>
                <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Explain what this setting controls, so it's clear months from now"
                    value={description}
                    onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                />
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
                <button type="submit" className="admin-form-submit" disabled={loading}>
                    {loading ? "Creating…" : "+ Create Setting"}
                </button>
                <button type="button" className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost" onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    );
}

export default function ConfigTab({
    configs, segments, categories,
    setConfigs, setSegments,
    onConfigSave, onSegmentSave,
    onAddConfig, onArchiveConfig, onRestoreConfig, onDeleteConfig,
    onViewHistory,
    formLoading,

    const [catSlug,      setCatSlug]      = useState("");
    const [reasons,      setReasons]      = useState({});
    const [showAdd,      setShowAdd]      = useState(false);
    const [createError,  setCreateError]  = useState("");
    const [showArchived, setShowArchived] = useState(false);
    const [original] = useState(() => Object.fromEntries(configs.map((c) => [c.id, c.value])));

    const activeConfigs   = configs.filter((c) => c.is_active);
    const archivedConfigs = configs.filter((c) => !c.is_active);

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let r = activeConfigs;
        if (catSlug) r = r.filter((c) => c.category_name === catSlug);
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            r = r.filter((c) => c.display_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (c.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(q));
        }
        return r;
    }, [activeConfigs, search, catSlug]);

    const dirtyCount = activeConfigs.filter((c) => original[c.id] !== undefined && c.value !== original[c.id]).length;

    const handleValueChange = (id, value) =>
        setConfigs((p) => p.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, value } : x)));

    const handleSave = async (c) => {
        await onConfigSave(c, reasons[c.id] || "");
        original[c.id] = c.value;
        setReasons((p) => ({ ...p, [c.id]: "" }));
    };

    const handleCreate = async (payload) => {
        setCreateError("");
        try {
            await onAddConfig(payload);
            setShowAdd(false);
        } catch (e) {
            const msg = e?.response?.data?.display_name?.[0] || e?.response?.data?.detail || "Couldn't create this setting.";
            setCreateError(msg);
        }
    };

    return (

                subtitle="Live settings — changes affect all future bookings immediately."
                action={
                    <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--primary" onClick={() => { setShowAdd((v) => !v); setCreateError(""); }}>
                        {showAdd ? "✕ Cancel" : "+ New Setting"}
                    </button>
                }
            >
                <div className="admin-config-notice">

                    {dirtyCount > 0 && (
                        <strong style={{ marginLeft: 8, color: "#D97706" }}>
                            {dirtyCount} unsaved change{dirtyCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                        </strong>
                    )}
                </div>

                {showAdd && (
                    <NewSettingForm
                        categories={categories}
                        onSubmit={handleCreate}
                        onCancel={() => setShowAdd(false)}
                        loading={formLoading}
                        serverError={createError}
                    />
                )}

                <div className="cd-filter-bar" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                    <input
                        className="admin-search-input"
                        placeholder="Search settings by name…"
                        value={search}
                        onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                        style={{ width: 240 }}
                    />
                    <div className="adm-mob-pills" style={{ overflow: "visible", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                        <button className={`adm-mob-pill${catSlug === "" ? " adm-mob-pill--active" : ""}`} onClick={() => setCatSlug("")}>All</button>
                        {categories.map((c) => (
                            <button
                                key={c.id}
                                className={`adm-mob-pill${catSlug === c.name ? " adm-mob-pill--active" : ""}`}
                                onClick={() => setCatSlug((p) => (p === c.name ? "" : c.name))}
                                title={c.description}
                            >{c.name}</button>
                        ))}

                        return (
                            <div key={c.id} className="admin-config-row" style={isDirty ? { borderColor: "#FCD34D", background: "#FFFBEB" } : undefined}>
                                <div className="admin-config-info">
                                    <strong>
                                        {c.display_name}
                                        {c.is_system && (
                                            <span title="Required by platform logic — value can be edited, but this setting can never be removed." style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, color: "#1D4ED8", background: "#DBEAFE", padding: "2px 7px", borderRadius: 999 }}>
                                                🔒 CORE SETTING
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                        {isDirty && (
                                            <span style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, color: "#D97706", background: "#FEF3C7", padding: "2px 7px", borderRadius: 999 }}>
                                                MODIFIED
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                    </strong>
                                    <span>{c.description}</span>
                                    <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--vm)", marginTop: 2 }}>
                                        {c.category_name} · {typeLabel(c.value_type)}
                                    </span>
                                    {isDirty && (
                                        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#92400E", marginTop: 2 }}>
                                            <s style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>{original[c.id]}</s> → <strong>{c.value}</strong>
                                        </span>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                                <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6, alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
                                    {c.is_editable ? (
                                        <>
                                            <div className="admin-config-edit" style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
                                                <ValueInput valueType={c.value_type} value={c.value} onChange={(v) => handleValueChange(c.id, v)} />

                                                    className="admin-note-input"
                                                    placeholder="Reason for change (optional)…"
                                                    style={{ width: 150 }}
                                                    value={reasons[c.id] || ""}
                                                    onChange={(e) => setReasons((p) => ({ ...p, [c.id]: e.target.value }))}
                                                />
                                                <button
                                                    className={`admin-btn admin-btn--sm ${isDirty ? "admin-btn--success" : "admin-btn--ghost"}`}
                                                    onClick={() => handleSave(c)}
                                                    disabled={!isDirty}
                                                >
                                                    Save
                                                </button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6 }}>
                                                <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost admin-btn--sm" onClick={() => onViewHistory(c)}>📋 History</button>
                                                {!c.is_system && (
                                                    <button
                                                        className="admin-btn admin-btn--danger admin-btn--sm"
                                                        onClick={() => onArchiveConfig(c.id)}
                                                        title="Archive — you can restore it later"
                                                    >

                                                    </button>
                                                )}
                                            </div>
                                        </>
                                    ) : (

                                        </>

                    subtitle="Archived settings are hidden from normal use but not gone. Restore them anytime, or delete permanently once you're sure."

                                <div key={c.id} className="admin-config-row" style={{ opacity: 0.75 }}>
                                    <div className="admin-config-info">
                                        <strong>{c.display_name}</strong>
                                        <span>{c.description}</span>
                                        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--vm)" }}>Last value: {c.value}</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6 }}>
                                        <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--success admin-btn--sm" onClick={() => onRestoreConfig(c.id)}>↺ Restore</button>
                                        <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--danger admin-btn--sm" onClick={() => onDeleteConfig(c.id)}>✕ Delete Permanently</button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </SectionCard>
            )}

                                <strong>{seg.display_name}</strong>
                                <label style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 5, fontSize: 11, color: "var(--vm)", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                                    <input
                                        type="checkbox"

                                        onChange={(e) => setSegments((p) => p.map((x) => (x.id === seg.id ? { ...x, is_active: e.target.checked } : x)))}
                                    /> Active
                                </label>
                            </div>
                            <div className="admin-segment-card__fields">
                                {[
                                    ["Security Deposit (₹)", "security_deposit"],
                                    ["Min Driver Age",        "min_driver_age"],
                                    ["Min Rental Days",       "min_rental_days"],
                                ].map(([lbl, field]) => (
                                    <div key={field} className="admin-form-field">
                                        <label>{lbl}</label>
                                        <input
                                            type="number"
                                            value={seg[field]}
                                            onChange={(e) => setSegments((p) => p.map((x) => (x.id === seg.id ? { ...x, [field]: e.target.value } : x)))}
                                        />
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                                <div className="admin-form-field">
                                    <label>Commission Override (%)</label>
                                    <input
                                        type="number"
                                        step="0.01"
                                        placeholder="Uses global rate if blank"
                                        value={seg.platform_commission_override ?? ""}
                                        onChange={(e) =>
                                            setSegments((p) => p.map((x) => (x.id === seg.id
                                                ? { ...x, platform_commission_override: e.target.value === "" ? null : e.target.value }
                                                : x)))
                                        }
                                    />
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--success admin-btn--sm admin-segment-save" onClick={() => onSegmentSave(seg)}>
                                Save Changes
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </SectionCard>
        </div>
    );

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import DataTable from "../../../components/common/DataTable";
import { SectionCard, InlineForm, StatusBadge } from "../AdminShared";
import { HANDOVER_STATUS_CLR } from "../adminConstants";
import ParkingPricingPanel from "./ParkingPricingPanel";

const H_STATUS_OPTIONS = [
    { value:"",          label:"All"       },
    { value:"EXPECTED",  label:"Expected"  },
    { value:"RECEIVED",  label:"Received"  },
    { value:"HELD",      label:"Held"      },
    { value:"SUBLISTED", label:"Sublisted" },
];

function MobileHandoverCard({ handover: h }) {
    const sc = HANDOVER_STATUS_CLR[h.status] || {bg:"#F3F4F6",color:"#6B7280"};
    return (
        <div className="adm-mob-card adm-mob-card--static">
            <div className="adm-mob-card__head">
                <span className="adm-mob-card__primary" style={{fontWeight:700}}>{h.vehicle_display||"—"}</span>
                <span className="admin-status-badge admin-status-badge--sm"
                    style={{color:sc.color,background:sc.bg,border:`1px solid ${sc.color}30`}}>{h.status}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-card__row">
                <span className="adm-mob-card__ref" style={{fontFamily:"JetBrains Mono,monospace",fontSize:11}}>{h.booking_ref||"—"}</span>
                {h.originating_vendor_name && (
                    <span className="adm-mob-card__secondary">from {h.originating_vendor_name}</span>
                )}
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-card__footer">
                <span className="adm-mob-card__meta">
                    {h.return_point_name ? `📍 ${h.return_point_name}` : ""}
                    {h.days_held ? ` · ${h.days_held}d held` : ""}
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function MobileHandoverList({ handovers }) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let r = handovers;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            r = r.filter(h=>
                (h.vehicle_display          ||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)||
                (h.booking_ref              ||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)||
                (h.originating_vendor_name  ||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)
            );
        }
        if (status) r = r.filter(h=>h.status===status);
        return r;
    }, [handovers, search, status]);

    return (
        <div className="adm-mob-list">
            <div className="adm-mob-search-wrap">
                <svg className="adm-mob-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5"/>
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
                </svg>
                <input className="adm-mob-search" type="search" placeholder="Search handovers…"
                    value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)}/>
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-pills">
                {H_STATUS_OPTIONS.map(o=>(
                    <button key={o.value}
                        className={`adm-mob-pill${status===o.value?" adm-mob-pill--active":""}`}
                        onClick={()=>setStatus(o.value)}>{o.label}</button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {(search||status) && <p className="adm-mob-count">{filtered.length} of {handovers.length} handovers</p>}
            {filtered.length===0
                ? <div className="admin-empty" style={{padding:"40px 24px"}}><span>🔄</span><p>No handovers match.</p></div>
                : <div className="adm-mob-cards">{filtered.map((h,i)=><MobileHandoverCard key={h.id??i} handover={h}/>)}</div>
            }
        </div>
    );
}

const handoverColumns = [
    { key:"vehicle_display",         label:"Vehicle",      sortable:true, width:180, render:(v)=>v||"—" },
    { key:"booking_ref",             label:"Booking",      sortable:true, width:130, render:(v)=><span className="dt-mono">{v||"—"}</span> },

    { key:"return_point_name",       label:"Return Point", sortable:true, width:140, render:(v)=>v?`📍 ${v}`:"—" },
    { key:"status",                  label:"Status",       sortable:true, width:110, render:(v)=><StatusBadge status={v} colorMap={HANDOVER_STATUS_CLR}/> },
    { key:"days_held",               label:"Days Held",    sortable:true, width:90, align:"center",
      render:(v)=>v?<span style={{color:v>3?"#D97706":"inherit"}}>{v}d</span>:"—" },
];

            </SectionCard>

                        ]}
                        data={network} searchable={false} emptyIcon="🤝" emptyMessage="No network vendors." pageSize={10}/>
                )}

            {/* Handovers — DataTable on desktop, cards on mobile */}

                                    <div className="admin-trend-bar-track">
                                        <div className="admin-trend-bar" style={{ height: `${pct}%` }} />
                                    </div>
                                    <span>{m.month?.slice(5)}</span>
                                    <span className="admin-trend-count">{m.count}</span>
                                </div>
                            );
                        })}
                    </div>
                </SectionCard>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export default function ParkingPricingPanel({ cities, vendors }) {
    const [rates, setRates] = useState([]);
    const [overrides, setOverrides] = useState([]);
    const [editingRateId, setEditingRateId] = useState(null);
    const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState("");

    const load = useCallback(() => {
        getCityParkingRates().then(({ data }) => setRates(data.results || data));
        getVendorCommissionOverrides().then(({ data }) => setOverrides(data.results || data));
    }, []);
    useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

    const citiesWithoutRate = cities.filter(c => !rates.some(r => r.city === c.id));

    const handleSetRate = async (values) => {
        try {
            await createCityParkingRate({ city: values.city, amount: values.amount });
            load();
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(e.response.data) : "Failed to set rate.");
        }
    };

        try {
            await updateCityParkingRate(id, { amount: editValue });
            setEditingRateId(null);
            load();

            alert(e.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(e.response.data) : "Failed to update rate.");
        }

        try {
            await createVendorCommissionOverride({
                vendor: values.vendor, city: values.city,
                vendor_share_pct: values.vendor_share_pct, reason: values.reason || "",
            });
            load();
        } catch (e) {
            alert(e.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(e.response.data) : "Failed to add override.");
        }
    };

    return (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16 }}>

            <div className="admin-config-notice">
                <strong>Parking pricing is set exclusively by admin.</strong> Vendors can opt in to offer
