                between vendor and platform are controlled entirely here.
            </div>

            {/* ── City Parking Rates ── */}
            <SectionCard
                title="City Parking Rates"
                subtitle="The fixed price charged for a one-way drop-off in each city. Every vendor offering parking in that city is paid based on this same base amount."
            >
                {citiesWithoutRate.length > 0 && (
                    <InlineForm
                        fields={[
                            { key: "city", label: "City", type: "select", required: true,
                              options: citiesWithoutRate.map(c => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name })) },
                            { key: "amount", label: "Parking Rate (₹)", type: "number", required: true, step: "0.01" },
                        ]}
                        onSubmit={handleSetRate}
                        submitLabel="+ Set Rate"
                    />
                )}
                <div className="admin-data-table" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                    <div className="admin-data-table__header"><span>City</span><span>Rate</span><span>Status</span><span></span></div>
                    {rates.length === 0 && <div className="admin-table-empty">No city parking rates set yet.</div>}
                    {rates.map((r) => (
                        <div key={r.id} className="admin-data-table__row">
                            <span><strong>{r.city_name}</strong></span>
                            <span>
                                {editingRateId === r.id ? (
                                    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center" }}>
                                        <input
                                            type="number" value={editValue}
                                            onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
                                            style={{ width: 90, padding: "4px 8px", borderRadius: 6, border: "1px solid var(--vbdr2)" }}
                                        />

                                        <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost admin-btn--xs" onClick={() => setEditingRateId(null)}>✕</button>
                                    </div>
                                ) : (
                                    <span className="admin-currency">₹{parseFloat(r.amount).toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>

                                )}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
    getSegments, createSegment, deleteSegment, previewSegment,
    getTargetingRules, createTargetingRule, updateTargetingRule, deleteTargetingRule, runRuleNow,
    getRuleExecutionLogs, runScheduledSweep,
} from '../../../services/api';
import { SectionCard } from '../AdminShared';

const FIELD_OPTIONS = [
    'total_bookings', 'completed_bookings', 'cancelled_bookings',
    'days_since_signup', 'days_since_last_booking', 'days_since_last_completed_booking',
    'total_spend', 'avg_booking_value', 'loyalty_points', 'loyalty_tier',
    'kyc_complete', 'has_pending_payment', 'has_active_or_pending_booking',
    'reviews_written', 'is_first_time_customer', 'is_repeat_customer', 'favorite_segment',
];
const OP_OPTIONS = [
    ['eq', 'equals'], ['neq', 'not equals'], ['gt', '>'], ['gte', '>='],
    ['lt', '<'], ['lte', '<='], ['in', 'in list'], ['not_in', 'not in list'],
    ['contains', 'contains'], ['is_true', 'is true'], ['is_false', 'is false'],
];

function ConditionBuilder({ conditions, setConditions }) {
    const add = () => setConditions([...conditions, { field: FIELD_OPTIONS[0], op: 'eq', value: '' }]);
    const update = (i, patch) => setConditions(conditions.map((c, idx) => idx === i ? { ...c, ...patch } : c));
    const remove = (i) => setConditions(conditions.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i));

    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
            {conditions.map((c, i) => (
                <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    <select value={c.field} onChange={e => update(i, { field: e.target.value })}>
                        {FIELD_OPTIONS.map(f => <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
                    </select>
                    <select value={c.op} onChange={e => update(i, { op: e.target.value })}>
                        {OP_OPTIONS.map(([v, l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
                    </select>
                    {!['is_true', 'is_false'].includes(c.op) && (
                        <input
                            placeholder="value"
                            value={c.value ?? ''}
                            onChange={e => update(i, { value: e.target.value })}
                            style={{ width: 100 }}
                        />
                    )}
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => remove(i)} style={{ color: '#EF4444' }}>✕</button>
                </div>
            ))}
            <button type="button" className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost admin-btn--sm" onClick={add} style={{ width: 'fit-content' }}>
                + Add condition
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}

function SegmentPanel({ segments, onRefresh }) {
    const [name, setName] = useState('');
    const [conditions, setConditions] = useState([{ field: 'total_bookings', op: 'eq', value: 0 }]);
    const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);

    // SegmentPanel
    const handleCreate = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        try {
            await createSegment({ name, conditions });
            setName('');
            setConditions([{ field: 'total_bookings', op: 'eq', value: 0 }]);
            onRefresh();
        } catch (err) {
            alert(err.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(err.response.data) : 'Failed to create segment.');
        }
    };

    const handlePreview = async (id) => {
        const { data } = await previewSegment(id);
        setPreview({ id, ...data });
    };

    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreate} style={{ background: '#F8FAFB', border: '1px solid #E8EDF2', borderRadius: 12, padding: 16, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
                <input placeholder="Segment name (e.g. 'At-Risk Customer')" value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} required />
                <ConditionBuilder conditions={conditions} setConditions={setConditions} />
                <button type="submit" className="admin-btn admin-btn--primary" style={{ width: 'fit-content' }}>+ Create Segment</button>
            </form>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                {segments.map((s) => (
                    <div key={s.id} style={{ border: '1px solid #E8EDF2', borderRadius: 10, padding: '10px 14px' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                            <strong>{s.name}</strong>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
                                <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost admin-btn--sm" onClick={() => handlePreview(s.id)}>Preview</button>
                                <button className="admin-btn admin-btn--danger admin-btn--sm" onClick={() => deleteSegment(s.id).then(onRefresh)}>Delete</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#9CA3AF', marginTop: 4 }}>
                            {(s.conditions || []).map(c => `${c.field} ${c.op} ${c.value ?? ''}`).join(' AND ')}
                        </div>
                        {preview?.id === s.id && (
                            <div style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 12, background: '#E6F7F5', borderRadius: 8, padding: '8px 10px' }}>
                                <strong>{preview.total_matching}</strong> users currently match.
                                {preview.sample.length > 0 && (
                                    <div style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>{preview.sample.slice(0, 5).map(u => u.email).join(', ')}{preview.sample.length > 5 ? '…' : ''}</div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function RulePanel({ segments, rules, onRefresh }) {
    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        name: '', segment: '', trigger_type: 'scheduled', event_name: '',
        action_type: 'notification', cooldown_days: 30, priority: 100,
        title: '', message: '', link_url: '', points: 100,
    });
    const set = k => e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.value }));

    // RulePanel
    const handleCreate = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const action_config = form.action_type === 'notification'
            ? { title: form.title, message: form.message, link_url: form.link_url }
            : form.action_type === 'loyalty_bonus'
            ? { points: Number(form.points) }
            : { code_prefix: 'PROMO', discount_type: 'percentage', discount_value: 10, valid_days: 14,
                notify_title: form.title, notify_message: form.message };
        try {
            await createTargetingRule({
                name: form.name, segment: form.segment, trigger_type: form.trigger_type,
                event_name: form.trigger_type === 'event' ? form.event_name : '',
                action_type: form.action_type, action_config,
                cooldown_days: Number(form.cooldown_days), priority: Number(form.priority),
            });
            onRefresh();
        } catch (err) {
            alert(err.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(err.response.data) : 'Failed to create rule.');
        }
    };

    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreate} style={{ background: '#F8FAFB', border: '1px solid #E8EDF2', borderRadius: 12, padding: 16, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
                <input placeholder="Rule name" value={form.name} onChange={set('name')} required />
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    <select value={form.segment} onChange={set('segment')} required>
                        <option value="">Select segment…</option>
                        {segments.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</option>)}
                    </select>
                    <select value={form.trigger_type} onChange={set('trigger_type')}>
                        <option value="scheduled">Scheduled (nightly)</option>
                        <option value="event">Event-driven</option>
                    </select>
                    {form.trigger_type === 'event' && (
                        <select value={form.event_name} onChange={set('event_name')} required>
                            <option value="">Which event?</option>
                            {['signup', 'booking_completed', 'booking_cancelled', 'payment_pending', 'review_submitted'].map(ev => (
                                <option key={ev} value={ev}>{ev}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    )}
                    <select value={form.action_type} onChange={set('action_type')}>
                        <option value="notification">Send Notification</option>
                        <option value="promo_code">Grant Promo Code</option>
                        <option value="loyalty_bonus">Credit Loyalty Points</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                {form.action_type !== 'loyalty_bonus' ? (
                    <>
                        <input placeholder="Title" value={form.title} onChange={set('title')} required />
                        <textarea placeholder="Message (supports {{first_name}}, {{loyalty_points}}, {{code}})" value={form.message} onChange={set('message')} rows={2} required />
                        {form.action_type === 'notification' && (
                            <input placeholder="Link URL (optional)" value={form.link_url} onChange={set('link_url')} />
                        )}
                    </>
                ) : (
                    <input type="number" placeholder="Points to credit" value={form.points} onChange={set('points')} />
                )}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                    <input type="number" placeholder="Cooldown (days)" value={form.cooldown_days} onChange={set('cooldown_days')} style={{ width: 140 }} />
                    <input type="number" placeholder="Priority" value={form.priority} onChange={set('priority')} style={{ width: 100 }} />
                </div>
                <button type="submit" className="admin-btn admin-btn--primary" style={{ width: 'fit-content' }}>+ Create Rule</button>
            </form>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>

                    <div key={r.id} style={{ border: '1px solid #E8EDF2', borderRadius: 10, padding: '10px 14px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>

                            </div>

            </div>

const RATING_OPTS = [
    {value:"",label:"All Ratings"},
    ...[5,4,3,2,1].map(n=>({value:String(n),label:`${n} ★`}))
];

function MobileReviewList({ reviews, onSelect }) {
    const [search,  setSearch]  = useState("");
    const [rating,  setRating]  = useState("");

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let r = reviews;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            r = r.filter(rv=>
                (rv.customer_name  ||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)||
                (rv.vehicle_display||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)||
                (rv.review_text    ||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)
            );
        }
        if (rating) r = r.filter(rv=>String(rv.vendor_rating)===rating);
        return r;
    }, [reviews, search, rating]);

    return (
        <div className="adm-mob-list">
            <div className="adm-mob-search-wrap">
                <svg className="adm-mob-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5"/>
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
                </svg>
                <input className="adm-mob-search" type="search" placeholder="Search reviews…"
                    value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)}/>
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-pills">
                {RATING_OPTS.map(o=>(
                    <button key={o.value}
                        className={`adm-mob-pill${rating===o.value?" adm-mob-pill--active":""}`}
                        onClick={()=>setRating(o.value)}>{o.label}</button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {(search||rating) && <p className="adm-mob-count">{filtered.length} of {reviews.length} reviews</p>}
            {filtered.length===0
                ? <div className="admin-empty" style={{padding:"40px 24px"}}><span>💬</span><p>No reviews match.</p></div>
                : <div className="adm-mob-cards">{filtered.map((r,i)=><MobileReviewCard key={r.id??i} review={r} onSelect={onSelect}/>)}</div>
            }
        </div>
    );
}

export default function ReviewsTab({ reviewVendors, initialVendorId="" }) {
    const [selectedVendorId, setSelectedVendorId] = useState(initialVendorId);
    const [ordering,         setOrdering]         = useState("recency");
    const [reviews,          setReviews]          = useState([]);
    const [reviewsLoading,   setReviewsLoading]   = useState(false);
    const [selectedReview,   setSelectedReview]   = useState(null);

    const loadReviews = async (vendorId, ord) => {
        if (!vendorId) return;
        setReviewsLoading(true);
        try { const {data} = await fetchVendorReviews(vendorId,ord); setReviews(data.results??data); }
        catch { setReviews([]); }
        finally { setReviewsLoading(false); }
    };

    const handleVendorChange = async (e) => {
        const id = e.target.value; setSelectedVendorId(id); await loadReviews(id,ordering);
    };
    const handleOrderingChange = async (ord) => {
        setOrdering(ord); await loadReviews(selectedVendorId,ord);
    };

    return (
        <div className="admin-section">
            {selectedReview && <ReviewDetailModal review={selectedReview} onClose={()=>setSelectedReview(null)}/>}

            <div className="cd-filter-bar cd-filter-bar--dropdown" style={{gap:12}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:4}}>
                    <label style={{fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px",color:"var(--vm)"}}>Vendor</label>
                    <select className="admin-search-input" style={{width:260,height:36,cursor:"pointer"}}
                        value={selectedVendorId} onChange={handleVendorChange}>
                        <option value="">— Select a vendor —</option>
                        {reviewVendors.map(v=>(
                            <option key={v.id} value={v.user??v.user_id}>
                                {v.business_name}{v.rating>0?` (★ ${v.rating})`:""}
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:4}}>
                    <label style={{fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px",color:"var(--vm)"}}>Sort</label>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                        {[["recency","🕐 Newest"],["rating","★ Rating"]].map(([val,lbl])=>(
                            <button key={val} className={`admin-btn admin-btn--sm ${ordering===val?"admin-btn--primary":"admin-btn--ghost"}`}
                                onClick={()=>handleOrderingChange(val)}>{lbl}</button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {!selectedVendorId ? (
                <div className="admin-empty"><span>⭐</span><p>Select a vendor above to view their customer reviews.</p></div>
            ) : reviewsLoading ? (
                <div className="admin-loading"><div className="admin-loading__spinner"/>Loading reviews…</div>
            ) : (
                <>
                    <div className="adm-desktop">
                        <DataTable columns={columns} data={reviews} searchable
                            searchKeys={["customer_name","vehicle_display","review_text"]}
                            searchPlaceholder="Search reviews…"
                            filters={[{key:"vendor_rating",label:"Rating",options:RATING_OPTS}]}
                            onRowAction={row=>setSelectedReview(row)} actionLabel="View Review"
                            emptyIcon="💬" emptyMessage="No reviews for this vendor." pageSize={20}/>
                    </div>
                    <div className="adm-mobile">
                        <MobileReviewList reviews={reviews} onSelect={setSelectedReview}/>
                    </div>
                </>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// tabs/VendorsTab.jsx  — Desktop: DataTable.  Mobile: tappable cards.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import DataTable from "../../../components/common/DataTable";
import { StatusBadge } from "../AdminShared";
import { VENDOR_STATUS_CLR, fmtDate, getKYCStatus } from "../adminConstants";

const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
    { value:"",          label:"All Statuses" },
    { value:"pending",   label:"Pending"      },
    { value:"approved",  label:"Approved"     },
    { value:"more_info", label:"More Info"    },
    { value:"rejected",  label:"Rejected"     },
    { value:"suspended", label:"Suspended"    },
];

function MobileVendorCard({ vendor: v, onSelect }) {
    const kyc = getKYCStatus(v);
    const sc  = VENDOR_STATUS_CLR[v.status] || { bg:"#F3F4F6", color:"#6B7280" };
    return (
        <button className="adm-mob-card" onClick={() => onSelect(v)} aria-label={`View ${v.business_name}`}>
            <div className="adm-mob-card__head">
                <span className="adm-mob-card__primary" style={{fontWeight:700}}>{v.business_name}</span>
                <span className="admin-status-badge admin-status-badge--sm"
                    style={{color:sc.color,background:sc.bg,border:`1px solid ${sc.color}30`}}>
                    {v.status?.replace(/_/g," ")}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-card__row">
                <span className="adm-mob-card__secondary">{v.email}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-card__footer">
                <span className="adm-mob-card__meta">
                    {v.city_name || "—"}
                    {" · KYC "}
                    <span style={{color: kyc.complete ? "#059669" : "#D97706", fontWeight:700}}>
                        {kyc.done}/{kyc.total}{kyc.complete ? " ✓" : " ⚠"}
                    </span>
                    {v.rating > 0 ? ` · ⭐ ${v.rating}` : ""}
                </span>
                <span className="adm-mob-card__chevron">›</span>
            </div>
        </button>
    );
}

function MobileVendorList({ vendors, onSelect }) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let r = vendors;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            r = r.filter(v =>
                (v.business_name||"").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (v.email        ||"").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (v.city_name    ||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)
            );
        }
        if (status) r = r.filter(v => v.status === status);
        return r;
    }, [vendors, search, status]);

    return (
        <div className="adm-mob-list">
            <div className="adm-mob-search-wrap">
                <svg className="adm-mob-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5"/>
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
                </svg>
                <input className="adm-mob-search" type="search" placeholder="Search vendors…"
                    value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}/>
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mob-pills">
                {STATUS_OPTIONS.map(o => (
                    <button key={o.value}
                        className={`adm-mob-pill${status===o.value?" adm-mob-pill--active":""}`}
                        onClick={() => setStatus(o.value)}>{o.label}</button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {(search||status) && <p className="adm-mob-count">{filtered.length} of {vendors.length} vendors</p>}
            {filtered.length === 0
                ? <div className="admin-empty" style={{padding:"40px 24px"}}><span>🏪</span><p>No vendors match.</p></div>
                : <div className="adm-mob-cards">{filtered.map((v,i)=><MobileVendorCard key={v.id??i} vendor={v} onSelect={onSelect}/>)}</div>
            }
        </div>
    );
}

const columns = [
    { key:"business_name", label:"Business", sortable:true, width:220,
      render:(v,row)=>(<div className="dt-cell-stack"><span className="dt-cell-stack__primary">{v}</span><span className="dt-cell-stack__secondary">{row.email}</span></div>) },
    { key:"city_name", label:"City",   sortable:true, width:110, render:(v)=>v||"—" },
    { key:"status",    label:"Status", sortable:true, width:120, render:(v)=><StatusBadge status={v} colorMap={VENDOR_STATUS_CLR}/> },
    { key:"kyc", label:"KYC", sortable:false, width:90,
      render:(_,row)=>{ const k=getKYCStatus(row); return <span style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,color:k.complete?"#059669":"#D97706"}}>{k.done}/{k.total} {k.complete?"✓":"⚠"}</span>; } },
    { key:"rating",     label:"Rating", sortable:true, width:80,  render:(v)=>v>0?`⭐ ${v}`:"—" },
    { key:"created_at", label:"Joined", sortable:true, width:110, render:(v)=>fmtDate(v) },
];

export default function VendorsTab({ vendors, onSelectVendor }) {
    return (
        <div className="admin-section">
            <div className="adm-desktop">
                <DataTable columns={columns} data={vendors} searchable
                    searchKeys={["business_name","email","phone","city_name"]}
                    searchPlaceholder="Search vendors by name, email, phone, city…"
                    filters={[{key:"status",label:"Status",colorMap:VENDOR_STATUS_CLR,options:STATUS_OPTIONS}]}
                    onRowAction={onSelectVendor} actionLabel="View Details"
                    emptyIcon="🏪" emptyMessage="No vendors found." pageSize={25}/>
            </div>
            <div className="adm-mobile">
                <MobileVendorList vendors={vendors} onSelect={onSelectVendor}/>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AddonsComponents.jsx
// Three sub-components used exclusively by AddonsPage:
//   • AddonGrid    — toggle cards for each add-on
//   • PromoSection — promo code input + apply button
//   • PriceSummary — sticky right-column price breakdown sidebar
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React from 'react';
import { ADDON_CATALOG } from './bookingConstants';

// ── AddonGrid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/**
 * Renders all add-on toggle cards.
 * @param {string[]}  addons        - currently selected addon keys
 * @param {Function}  onToggle      - called with the addon key to toggle
 * @param {object}    addonPrices   - { [key]: priceString } from pricing API
 */
export function AddonGrid({ addons, onToggle, addonPrices }) {
    return (
        <div className="addons-section">
            <h3>Optional Add-ons</h3>
            <p className="addons-section__subtitle">
                Prices are calculated per day and added to your total automatically.
            </p>
            <div className="addons-grid">
                {ADDON_CATALOG.map(a => {
                    const isSelected = addons.includes(a.key);
                    const apiPrice   = addonPrices?.[a.key];
                    return (
                        <button
                            key={a.key}
                            className={`addon-card${isSelected ? ' selected' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => onToggle(a.key)}
                        >
                            <div className="addon-card__icon">{a.icon}</div>
                            <div className="addon-card__info">
                                <strong>{a.label}</strong>
                                <span>{a.desc}</span>
                                {apiPrice && (
                                    <span className="addon-card__api-price">
                                        ₹{parseFloat(apiPrice).toLocaleString('en-IN')}/day
                                    </span>
                                )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="addon-card__check">{isSelected ? '✓' : '+'}</div>
                        </button>
                    );
                })}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── PromoSection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/**
 * @param {string}   promoCode      - controlled input value
 * @param {Function} onCodeChange   - called with new string value
 * @param {Function} onApply        - called when Apply is clicked
 * @param {boolean}  loading
 * @param {string}   message        - feedback message ('' = hidden)
 */
export function PromoSection({ promoCode, onCodeChange, onApply, loading, message }) {
    return (
        <div className="promo-section">
            <h3>Promo Code</h3>
            <div className="promo-section__row">
                <input
                    type="text"
                    value={promoCode}
                    onChange={e => onCodeChange(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                    placeholder="Enter promo code"
                    disabled={loading}
                />
                <button onClick={onApply} disabled={loading || !promoCode.trim()}>
                    {loading ? '…' : 'Apply'}
                </button>
            </div>
            {message && (
                <p className={`promo-msg ${message.startsWith('✅') ? 'promo-msg--success' : 'promo-msg--error'}`}>
                    {message}
                </p>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── PriceSummary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/**
 * Sticky right-column price breakdown.
 *
 * @param {object}   pricing         - API response from calculatePrice
 * @param {boolean}  loadingPrice
 * @param {string}   priceError
 * @param {number}   nights
 * @param {object}   vehicle         - selectedVehicle from BookingContext
 * @param {string[]} addons          - selected addon keys
 * @param {number}   promoDiscount   - discount amount (0 if none)
 * @param {boolean}  isLoggedIn
 * @param {boolean}  ctaDisabled
 * @param {Function} onCTA           - called when the main CTA is clicked
 */
export function PriceSummary({
    pricing, loadingPrice, priceError, nights, vehicle, addons,
    promoDiscount, isLoggedIn, ctaDisabled, onCTA,
}) {
    const belowMinRental = pricing?.min_rental_days > 1 && nights < pricing.min_rental_days;

    return (
        <div className="price-summary">
            <h3>Price Breakdown</h3>

            {priceError && <div className="price-summary__error">{priceError}</div>}

            {belowMinRental && (
                <div className="price-summary__error">
                    ⚠ This vehicle type requires a minimum rental of {pricing.min_rental_days} days.
                    Please go back and adjust your dates.
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="price-summary__breakdown">
                {loadingPrice ? (
                    <div className="price-summary__loading"><div className="wz-spinner" /> Recalculating…</div>
                ) : pricing ? (
                    <>
                        <div className="price-summary__line">
                            <span>Base rental</span>
                            <span>₹{parseFloat(pricing.base_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="price-summary__line price-summary__line--sub">
                            <span>{nights} day{nights > 1 ? 's' : ''} × ₹{parseInt(vehicle.daily_rate).toLocaleString('en-IN')}/day</span>
                        </div>

                        {parseFloat(pricing.addon_amount || 0) > 0 && (
                            <div className="price-summary__line">
                                <span>Add-ons ({addons.length})</span>
                                <span>₹{parseFloat(pricing.addon_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {parseFloat(pricing.one_way_fee || 0) > 0 && (
                            <div className="price-summary__line">
                                <span>One-way fee</span>
                                <span>₹{parseFloat(pricing.one_way_fee).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {parseFloat(pricing.gst_amount || 0) > 0 && (
                            <div className="price-summary__line">
                                {/* ← was hardcoded "GST (18%)" — now reflects the live gst_rate setting */}
                                <span>GST ({Math.round(parseFloat(pricing.gst_rate ?? 0.18) * 100)}%)</span>
                                <span>₹{parseFloat(pricing.gst_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {promoDiscount > 0 && (
                            <div className="price-summary__line price-summary__line--discount">
                                <span>Promo discount</span>
                                <span>−₹{promoDiscount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        <div className="price-summary__line price-summary__line--total">
                            <span>Grand Total</span>
                            <span>₹{(parseFloat(pricing.grand_total) - (promoDiscount || 0)).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="price-summary__deposit">
                            🔒 Refundable security deposit: ₹{parseFloat(pricing.security_deposit).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                            <small> — collected separately, returned after vehicle return</small>
                        </div>

                        {pricing.vendor_opening_time && (
                            <div className="price-summary__hours">
                                🕐 Vendor hours: {pricing.vendor_opening_time} – {pricing.vendor_closing_time}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </>
                ) : null}
            </div>

            {!isLoggedIn && (
                <div className="price-summary__login-prompt">
                    <span>🔐</span>
                    <p>Sign in to confirm your booking</p>
                </div>
            )}

            <button className="price-summary__cta" onClick={onCTA} disabled={ctaDisabled || belowMinRental}>
                {isLoggedIn ? 'Confirm Booking →' : 'Sign In to Continue →'}
            </button>

            <div className="price-summary__reassurance">
                {/* ← was hardcoded "48h" — now reflects cancellation_free_hours */}
                <span>✓ Free cancellation {pricing?.cancellation_free_hours ?? 48}h before pickup</span>
                <span>✓ Transparent GST-inclusive pricing</span>
                <span>✓ Secure Razorpay payment</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AddonsPage.jsx  (Step 3/4 — Add-ons & Pricing)
// Route: /book/addons
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate }                from 'react-router-dom';
import { useBooking }                 from '../../context/BookingContext';
import { useAuth }                    from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { calculatePrice, validatePromo } from '../../services/api';
import { WizardShell, WizardProgress, buildSteps, useAuthModal } from './BookingShared';
import { calcNights, segIcon }        from './bookingConstants';
import { AddonGrid, PromoSection, PriceSummary } from './AddonsComponents';
import './AddonsPage.css';
import '../BookingWizard.css';

export default function AddonsPage() {
    const navigate             = useNavigate();
    const { booking, update }  = useBooking();
    const { user }             = useAuth();
    const { openAuth, AuthModalEl } = useAuthModal(() => navigate('/book/confirm'));

    const [pricing,       setPricing]       = useState(null);
    const [loadingPrice,  setLoadingPrice]  = useState(false);
    const [priceError,    setPriceError]    = useState('');
    const [promoCode,     setPromoCode]     = useState('');
    const [promoMsg,      setPromoMsg]      = useState('');
    const [promoLoading,  setPromoLoading]  = useState(false);
    const [addons,        setAddons]        = useState([]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!booking.selectedVehicle) navigate('/');
    }, [booking.selectedVehicle, navigate]);

    const v      = booking.selectedVehicle;
    const nights = calcNights(booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate);

    // Recalculate price whenever addons change
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!v) return;
        const fetchPrice = async () => {
            setLoadingPrice(true); setPriceError('');
            try {
                const { data } = await calculatePrice({
                    vehicle_id:  v.id,
                    pickup_date: booking.pickupDate,
                    return_date: booking.returnDate,
                    pickup_time: booking.pickupTime  || null,
                    return_time: booking.returnTime  || null,
                    addons,
                    one_way_fee: booking.oneWayFee   || 0,
                });
                setPricing(data);
                update({ pricingBreakdown: data, selectedAddons: addons });
            } catch {
                setPriceError('Could not calculate price. Please check your connection.');
                setPricing(null);
            } finally { setLoadingPrice(false); }
        };
        fetchPrice();
    }, [addons, v?.id, booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate, booking.oneWayFee]); // eslint-disable-line

    if (!v) return null;

    // ── Addon toggle — enforces insurance mutual exclusion ────────────────────
    const toggleAddon = key => {
        if (key === 'insurance_basic' && addons.includes('insurance_comprehensive')) {
            setAddons(p => p.filter(k => k !== 'insurance_comprehensive').concat(key));
            return;
        }
        if (key === 'insurance_comprehensive' && addons.includes('insurance_basic')) {
            setAddons(p => p.filter(k => k !== 'insurance_basic').concat(key));
            return;
        }
        setAddons(prev => prev.includes(key) ? prev.filter(k => k !== key) : [...prev, key]);
    };

    // ── Promo ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleApplyPromo = async () => {
        if (!promoCode.trim()) return;
        setPromoLoading(true); setPromoMsg('');
        try {
            const { data } = await validatePromo(promoCode.trim(), v.id);
            setPromoMsg(`✅ Promo applied! Discount: ₹${data.discount_amount || data.discount_value}`);
            update({ promoCode: promoCode.trim(), promoDiscount: data.discount_amount || 0 });
        } catch (err) {
            setPromoMsg(`❌ ${err.response?.data?.error || 'Invalid or expired promo code.'}`);
        } finally { setPromoLoading(false); }
    };

    // ── CTA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleConfirm = () => {
        if (!user) { openAuth(); return; }
        navigate('/book/confirm');
    };

    const steps = buildSteps('addons', booking.isDifferentReturn);

    return (
        <WizardShell onLoginClick={openAuth} className="addons-page">
            <WizardProgress steps={steps} />

            <div className="addons-page__layout">
                {/* ── Left column ── */}
                <div className="addons-page__left">

                    {/* Vehicle recap */}
                    <div className="addons-recap">
                        <div className="addons-recap__icon">{segIcon(v.segment)}</div>
                        <div className="addons-recap__details">
                            <h2>{v.year} {v.make} {v.model}</h2>
                            <div className="addons-recap__meta">
                                ⛽ {v.fuel_type} · ⚙️ {v.transmission} · 💺 {v.capacity} seats
                            </div>
                            <div className="addons-recap__vendor">
                                🏪 {v.vendor_profile?.business_name || 'Selected Vendor'} ·{' '}
                                <span className="addons-recap__rate">
                                    ₹{parseInt(v.daily_rate).toLocaleString('en-IN')}/day
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button className="addons-recap__change" onClick={() => navigate('/book/select-vendor')}>
                            ← Change
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    {/* Trip recap strip */}
                    <div className="addons-trip-recap">
                        <div className="addons-trip-recap__item">
                            <span>📍 Pickup</span>
                            <strong>
                                {booking.pickupLocation?.name}, {booking.pickupCity?.name}
                            </strong>
                        </div>
                        {booking.isDifferentReturn && booking.returnLocation && (
                            <div className="addons-trip-recap__item">
                                <span>🏁 Return</span>
                                <strong>
                                    {booking.returnLocation.name}, {booking.returnCity?.name}
                                </strong>
                            </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="addons-trip-recap__item">
                            <span>📅 From</span>
                            <strong>
                                {booking.pickupDate}{booking.pickupTime ? ` @ ${booking.pickupTime}` : ''}
                            </strong>
                        </div>
                        <div className="addons-trip-recap__item">
                            <span>📅 To</span>
                            <strong>
                                {booking.returnDate}{booking.returnTime ? ` @ ${booking.returnTime}` : ''}
                            </strong>
                        </div>
                        <div className="addons-trip-recap__item">
                            <span>⏱ Duration</span>
                            <strong>{nights} day{nights > 1 ? 's' : ''}</strong>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Add-ons grid */}
                    <AddonGrid
                        addons={addons}
                        onToggle={toggleAddon}
                        addonPrices={pricing?.addon_breakdown}
                    />

                    {/* Promo */}
                    <PromoSection
                        promoCode={promoCode}
                        onCodeChange={setPromoCode}
                        onApply={handleApplyPromo}
                        loading={promoLoading}
                        message={promoMsg}
                    />
                </div>

                {/* ── Right column: price summary ── */}
                <aside className="addons-page__summary">
                    <PriceSummary
                        pricing={pricing}
                        loadingPrice={loadingPrice}
                        priceError={priceError}
                        nights={nights}
                        vehicle={v}
                        addons={addons}
                        promoDiscount={booking.promoDiscount || 0}
                        isLoggedIn={!!user}
                        ctaDisabled={loadingPrice || !pricing || (pricing?.min_rental_days > 1 && nights < pricing.min_rental_days)}
                        onCTA={handleConfirm}
                    />
                </aside>
            </div>

            {AuthModalEl}
        </WizardShell>
    );
}

// ── Nights calculator ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const calcNights = (pickupDate, returnDate) =>
    Math.max(1, Math.round(
        (new Date(returnDate) - new Date(pickupDate)) / 86400000
    ));

// ── Leaflet icon fix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const fixLeafletIcons = (L) => {
    delete L.Icon.Default.prototype._getIconUrl;
    L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions({
        iconRetinaUrl: 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-icon-2x.png',
        iconUrl:       'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-icon.png',
        shadowUrl:     'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-shadow.png',
    });
};

    });

// ── Vehicle coordinate helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getVehicleCoords = (vehicle, cityCenter, idx) => {
    if (vehicle.vendor_profile?.latitude && vehicle.vendor_profile?.longitude) {
        return [
            parseFloat(vehicle.vendor_profile.latitude),
            parseFloat(vehicle.vendor_profile.longitude),
        ];
    }
    const spread = 0.018;
    const angle  = (idx / 6) * 2 * Math.PI;
    return [
        cityCenter[0] + spread * Math.cos(angle),
        cityCenter[1] + spread * Math.sin(angle),
    ];
};

// ── Model grouping helper (kept for backwards-compat; no longer used in Step 1) ──
export function groupByModel(vehicles) {
    const map = {};
    vehicles.forEach(v => {
        const key = `${v.make}__${v.model}`;
        if (!map[key]) {
            map[key] = {
                make: v.make, model: v.model, segment: v.segment,
                fuel_types:    new Set(),
                transmissions: new Set(),
                capacity:      v.capacity,
                minRate:       parseFloat(v.daily_rate),
                maxRate:       parseFloat(v.daily_rate),
                count:         0,
                certified_count: 0,
                photos:        v.photos || [],
                vehicles:      [],
            };
        }
        const g = map[key];
        g.fuel_types.add(v.fuel_type);
        g.transmissions.add(v.transmission);
        g.minRate           = Math.min(g.minRate, parseFloat(v.daily_rate));
        g.maxRate           = Math.max(g.maxRate, parseFloat(v.daily_rate));
        g.count            += 1;
        if (v.is_certified)  g.certified_count += 1;
        if (!g.photos.length && v.photos?.length) g.photos = v.photos;
        g.vehicles.push(v);
    });
    return Object.values(map);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// BookingShared.jsx// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Navbar    from '../../components/common/Navbar';
import AuthModal from '../../components/auth/AuthModal';

// ── WizardProgress ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function WizardProgress({ steps }) {
    return (
        <div className="wizard-progress">
            {steps.map((step, i) => (
                <div
                    key={step.label}
                    className={`wizard-progress__step${
                        step.state === 'active' ? ' active' : step.state === 'done' ? ' done' : ''
                    }`}
                >
                    <span>{step.state === 'done' ? '✓' : i + 1}</span>
                    {step.label}
                </div>
            ))}
        </div>
    );
}

/**
 * Builds the step progress array for the wizard.
 *
 * @param {'car'|'vendor'|'return'|'addons'|'confirm'} activeStep
 * @param {boolean} isDifferentReturn
 */
export function buildSteps(activeStep, isDifferentReturn) {
    const order = isDifferentReturn
        ? ['car', 'vendor', 'return', 'addons', 'confirm']
        : ['car', 'vendor', 'addons', 'confirm'];

    const LABELS = {
        car:     'Choose Type',     // ← UPDATED: was 'Select Car'
        vendor:  'Choose Vehicle',  // ← UPDATED: was 'Choose Vendor' — now vehicle-centric
        return:  'Return Vendor',
        addons:  'Add-ons & Pay',
        confirm: 'Confirm & Pay',
    };

    const activeIdx = order.indexOf(activeStep);
    return order.map((key, i) => ({
        label: LABELS[key],
        state: i < activeIdx ? 'done' : i === activeIdx ? 'active' : 'future',
    }));
}

// ── WizardShell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function WizardShell({ children, onLoginClick, className = 'wizard-page' }) {
    return (
        <div className={className}>
            <Navbar onLoginClick={onLoginClick} />
            <div className="wizard-page__inner">
                {children}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── useAuthModal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function useAuthModal(onSuccess) {
    const [showAuth, setShowAuth] = useState(false);

    const AuthModalEl = showAuth
        ? <AuthModal onClose={() => setShowAuth(false)} onSuccess={onSuccess} />
        : null;

    return {
        showAuth,
        openAuth:  () => setShowAuth(true),
        closeAuth: () => setShowAuth(false),
        AuthModalEl,
    };
}

// ── FlyTo (Leaflet helper) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function FlyTo({ center }) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line
    const { useMap } = require('react-leaflet');
    const map = useMap();
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (center) map.flyTo(center, 13, { duration: 1 });
    }, [center, map]);
    return null;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// CarModelSelectPage.jsx  (Step 1 — Select Car)
// Route: /book/select-car
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useBooking } from '../../context/BookingContext';
import { searchVehicles } from '../../services/api';
import { WizardShell, WizardProgress, buildSteps, useAuthModal } from './BookingShared';
import { groupByModel, calcNights } from './bookingConstants';
import ModelCard from './ModelCard';
import './CarModelSelectPage.css';
import '../BookingWizard.css';

export default function CarModelSelectPage() {
    const navigate             = useNavigate();
    const { booking, update }  = useBooking();
    const { openAuth, AuthModalEl } = useAuthModal();

    const [allVehicles, setAllVehicles] = useState([]);
    const [loading,     setLoading]     = useState(true);
    const [error,       setError]       = useState('');
    const [searchText,  setSearchText]  = useState('');
    const [filters,     setFilters]     = useState({
        segment: '', fuel_type: '', transmission: '',
        certified_only: false, sort: 'price_asc',
    });

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!booking.pickupCity || !booking.pickupDate) navigate('/');
    }, [booking.pickupCity, booking.pickupDate, navigate]);

    const nights = calcNights(booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate);

    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true); setError('');
        try {
            const { data } = await searchVehicles({
                city:         booking.pickupCity.id,
                pickup_date:  booking.pickupDate,
                return_date:  booking.returnDate,
                ...(filters.segment       && { segment:       filters.segment }),
                ...(filters.fuel_type     && { fuel_type:     filters.fuel_type }),
                ...(filters.transmission  && { transmission:  filters.transmission }),
                ...(filters.certified_only && { certified_only: 'true' }),
            });
            setAllVehicles(data.results || data);
        } catch {
            setError('Could not load vehicles. Check your connection or try again.');
            setAllVehicles([]);
        } finally { setLoading(false); }
    }, [booking.pickupCity, booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate, filters]);

    useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

    const setFilter = k => e =>
        setFilters(p => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.type === 'checkbox' ? e.target.checked : e.target.value }));

    const grouped  = groupByModel(allVehicles);
    const filtered = grouped
        .filter(g => !searchText || `${g.make} ${g.model}`.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()))
        .sort((a, b) => {
            if (filters.sort === 'price_asc')    return a.minRate - b.minRate;
            if (filters.sort === 'price_desc')   return b.minRate - a.minRate;
            if (filters.sort === 'availability') return b.count - a.count;
            return 0;
        });

    const handleSelectModel = group => {
        update({ selectedModel: group, selectedVehicle: null, pickupLocation: null, returnLocation: null });
        navigate('/book/select-vendor');
    };

    const steps = buildSteps('car', booking.isDifferentReturn);

    return (
        <WizardShell onLoginClick={openAuth} className="cmp-page">
            <WizardProgress steps={steps} />

            {/* Trip strip */}
            <div className="cmp__trip-strip">
                <div className="cmp__trip-item">
                    <span>📍 City</span>
                    <strong>{booking.pickupCity?.name}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="cmp__trip-item">
                    <span>📅 Dates</span>
                    <strong>{booking.pickupDate} → {booking.returnDate}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="cmp__trip-item">
                    <span>⏱ Duration</span>
                    <strong>{nights} day{nights > 1 ? 's' : ''}</strong>
                </div>
                {booking.isDifferentReturn && (
                    <div className="cmp__trip-item">
                        <span>🏁 Return to</span>
                        <strong>{booking.returnCity?.name}</strong>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>

            <div className="cmp__layout">
                {/* ── Sidebar filters ── */}
                <aside className="cmp__sidebar">
                    <h3>Filter Cars</h3>
                    <div className="cmp__search-box">
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Search make or model…"
                            value={searchText}
                            onChange={e => setSearchText(e.target.value)}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {[
                        ['Category',     'segment',      [['', 'All Types'], ['hatchback', 'Hatchback'], ['sedan', 'Sedan'], ['suv', 'SUV'], ['luxury', 'Luxury'], ['van', 'Van'], ['truck', 'Truck']]],
                        ['Fuel Type',    'fuel_type',    [['', 'Any Fuel'], ['petrol', 'Petrol'], ['diesel', 'Diesel'], ['electric', 'Electric'], ['hybrid', 'Hybrid'], ['cng', 'CNG']]],
                        ['Transmission', 'transmission', [['', 'Any'], ['manual', 'Manual'], ['automatic', 'Automatic']]],
                        ['Sort By',      'sort',         [['price_asc', 'Price: Low → High'], ['price_desc', 'Price: High → Low'], ['availability', 'Most Available']]],
                    ].map(([label, key, opts]) => (
                        <div key={key} className="cmp__filter-group">
                            <label>{label}</label>
                            <select value={filters[key]} onChange={setFilter(key)}>
                                {opts.map(([val, txt]) => <option key={val} value={val}>{txt}</option>)}
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    ))}

                    <label className="cmp__certified-toggle">
                        <input type="checkbox" checked={filters.certified_only} onChange={setFilter('certified_only')} />
                        <span className="cmp__certified-toggle-track" />
                        <span>Certified only 🏅</span>
                    </label>
                </aside>

                {/* ── Results ── */}
                <div className="cmp__results">
                    <div className="cmp__results-header">
                        {loading ? (
                            <h2>Searching available cars…</h2>
                        ) : error ? (
                            <div className="cmp__error">
                                <p>{error}</p>
                                <button onClick={load}>↺ Retry</button>
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <h2>{filtered.length} car model{filtered.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} available</h2>
                        )}
                        <p className="cmp__results-sub">
                            in {booking.pickupCity?.name} · {booking.pickupDate} to {booking.returnDate}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    {loading ? (
                        <div className="cmp__skeletons">
                            {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => (
                                <div key={i} className="cmp__skeleton wz-skeleton" style={{ height: 320 }} />
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    ) : filtered.length === 0 && !error ? (
                        <div className="cmp__empty">
                            <div>🔍</div>
                            <h3>No cars match your filters</h3>
                            <p>Try removing some filters or selecting different dates.</p>
                            <button onClick={() => setFilters({ segment: '', fuel_type: '', transmission: '', certified_only: false, sort: 'price_asc' })}>
                                Clear Filters
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="cmp__grid">
                            {filtered.map(g => (
                                <ModelCard
                                    key={`${g.make}-${g.model}`}
                                    group={g}
                                    nights={nights}
                                    onSelect={handleSelectModel}
                                />
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>

            {AuthModalEl}
        </WizardShell>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ConfirmBookingPage.jsx  (Step 4/5 — Confirm & Pay)
// Route: /book/confirm  (RequireAuth)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate }                from 'react-router-dom';
import { useBooking }                 from '../../context/BookingContext';
import { useAuth }                    from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { createBooking, dummyPayment } from '../../services/api';
import Navbar                         from '../../components/common/Navbar';
import { WizardProgress, buildSteps } from './BookingShared';
import { calcNights }                 from './bookingConstants';
import { BookingReviewCard, PaymentSummary } from './ConfirmComponents';
import './ConfirmBookingPage.css';
import '../BookingWizard.css';

export default function ConfirmBookingPage() {
    const navigate             = useNavigate();
    const { booking, reset }   = useBooking();
    const { user }             = useAuth();

    const [loading,        setLoading]        = useState(false);
    const [error,          setError]          = useState('');
    const [success,        setSuccess]        = useState(null);
    const [paymentType,    setPaymentType]    = useState('advance');
    const [paymentMethod,  setPaymentMethod]  = useState('online');

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!booking.selectedVehicle || !user) navigate('/');
    }, [booking.selectedVehicle, user, navigate]);

    if (!booking.selectedVehicle || !user) return null;

    const v      = booking.selectedVehicle;
    const p      = booking.pricingBreakdown;
    const nights = calcNights(booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate);

    const grandTotal     = p ? parseFloat(p.grand_total) : 0;
    const advanceAmount  = Math.round(grandTotal * 30 / 100);
    const remainingAmount = grandTotal - advanceAmount;
    const payableNow     = paymentType === 'full' ? grandTotal : advanceAmount;

    // ── Confirm + pay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleBookingWithPayment = async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError('');
        try {
            // 1. Create booking (PENDING)
            const { data } = await createBooking({
                vehicle_id:       v.id,
                pickup_date:      booking.pickupDate,
                return_date:      booking.returnDate,
                pickup_time:      booking.pickupTime      || null,
                return_time:      booking.returnTime      || null,
                pickup_location:  booking.pickupLocation?.id,
                return_location:  booking.returnLocation?.id || null,
                addons:           booking.selectedAddons  || [],
                one_way_fee:      booking.oneWayFee       || 0,
                promo_code:       booking.promoCode       || undefined,
            });

            // 2. Process payment immediately
            const paymentData = await dummyPayment(data.booking_id, {
                payment_type: paymentType,
                method:       paymentMethod,
            });

            setSuccess({ ...data, payment: paymentData.data });
            reset();
        } catch (err) {
            const d = err.response?.data;
            setError(
                typeof d === 'object'
                    ? Object.values(d).flat().join(' ')
                    : 'Booking or payment failed. Please try again.'
            );
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    // ── Success screen ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (success) {
        return (
            <div className="confirm-page">
                <Navbar />
                <div className="confirm-page__inner">
                    <div className="confirm-success">
                        <div className="confirm-success__icon">🎉</div>
                        <h1>Booking &amp; Payment Complete!</h1>
                        <p>Your rental has been successfully booked and your payment has been processed.</p>
                        <div className="confirm-success__ref">
                            Booking Reference: {success.booking_ref}
                        </div>
                        <div className="confirm-success__payment">
                            <p>Payment Details:</p>
                            <p>Amount Paid: ₹{success.payment.amount_paid}</p>
                            <p>Payment Method: {success.payment.payment_type} via {success.payment.method}</p>
                            {success.payment.remaining_amount > 0 && (
                                <p className="confirm-success__remaining">
                                    Remaining Balance: ₹{success.payment.remaining_amount}
                                    <small> (Payable before or at drop-off)</small>
                                </p>
                            )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="confirm-success__note">
                            A confirmation email has been sent to <strong>{user.email}</strong>.
                            Please carry your driving licence at pickup.
                        </div>
                        <button
                            className="confirm-success__dashboard"
                            onClick={() => navigate('/customer')}
                        >
                            View My Bookings →
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // ── Main confirm page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const steps = buildSteps('confirm', booking.isDifferentReturn);

    return (
        <div className="confirm-page">
            <Navbar />
            <div className="confirm-page__inner">
                <WizardProgress steps={steps} />

                <h1 className="confirm-page__title">Review &amp; Complete Payment</h1>

                <div className="confirm-page__layout">
                    {/* Left — booking details */}
                    <BookingReviewCard
                        booking={booking}
                        vehicle={v}
                        user={user}
                        nights={nights}
                        pricing={p}
                    />

                    {/* Right — payment */}
                    <PaymentSummary
                        pricing={p}
                        grandTotal={grandTotal}
                        advanceAmount={advanceAmount}
                        remainingAmount={remainingAmount}
                        paymentType={paymentType}
                        setPaymentType={setPaymentType}
                        paymentMethod={paymentMethod}
                        setPaymentMethod={setPaymentMethod}
                        payableNow={payableNow}
                        loading={loading}
                        error={error}
                        onConfirm={handleBookingWithPayment}
                    />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

                        <span className="model-card__rate-unit">/day</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="model-card__total">
                        ₹{totalMin}{g.minRate !== g.maxRate ? `–₹${totalMax}` : ''} for {nights} day{nights > 1 ? 's' : ''}

// ReturnVendorPage.jsx  (Step 3 — Return Vendor, one-way trips only)
// Route: /book/return-vendor
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate }     from 'react-router-dom';
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Popup, useMap } from 'react-leaflet';
import L                   from 'leaflet';
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
import { useBooking }      from '../../context/BookingContext';
import { WizardShell, WizardProgress, buildSteps } from './BookingShared';
import { fixLeafletIcons, makePinIcon, getCityCenter } from './bookingConstants';
import './VendorSelectPage.css';
import '../BookingWizard.css';

fixLeafletIcons(L);

function FlyTo({ center }) {
    const map = useMap();
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (center) map.flyTo(center, 13, { duration: 1 });
    }, [center, map]);
    return null;
}

export default function ReturnVendorPage() {
    const navigate            = useNavigate();
    const { booking, update } = useBooking();
    const [selectedReturn, setSelectedReturn] = useState(null);
    const [error,          setError]          = useState('');

    if (!booking.selectedVehicle || !booking.isDifferentReturn) {
        navigate('/');
        return null;
    }

    const returnCityName = booking.returnCity?.name || 'Return City';
    const cityCenter     = getCityCenter(returnCityName);

    // Place each return-vendor vehicle at a spread around the city centre
    const returnVendors = (booking.selectedModel?.vehicles || []).map((v, idx) => {
        const angle = (idx / 6) * 2 * Math.PI;
        return {
            ...v,
            lat: cityCenter[0] + 0.018 * Math.cos(angle),
            lng: cityCenter[1] + 0.018 * Math.sin(angle),
        };
    });

    const handleSelect = v => { setSelectedReturn(v); setError(''); };

    const handleNext = () => {
        if (!selectedReturn) { setError('Please select a return vendor.'); return; }
        update({
            returnLocation: {
                id:   selectedReturn.id,
                name: selectedReturn.vendor_profile?.business_name || 'Return Vendor',
            },
            returnVendor: selectedReturn.vendor_profile,
        });
        navigate('/book/addons');
    };

    const steps = buildSteps('return', true);

    return (
        <WizardShell className="vsp-page">
            <WizardProgress steps={steps} />

            {/* Recap */}
            <div className="vsp__model-recap">
                <div className="vsp__model-recap-icon">🏁</div>
                <div>
                    <h2>Select Return Vendor in {returnCityName}</h2>
                    <p>
                        Where will you drop off the{' '}
                        {booking.selectedModel?.make} {booking.selectedModel?.model}?
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="vsp__map-layout">
                {/* Map */}
                <div className="vsp__map-container">
                    <MapContainer center={cityCenter} zoom={13} style={{ height: '100%', width: '100%' }}>
                        <TileLayer
                            attribution='&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'
                            url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
                        />
                        <FlyTo center={cityCenter} />
                        {returnVendors.map(v => (
                            <Marker
                                key={v.id}
                                position={[v.lat, v.lng]}
                                icon={makePinIcon(L, selectedReturn?.id === v.id, '🏁')}
                                eventHandlers={{ click: () => handleSelect(v) }}
                            >
                                <Popup>
                                    <div className="vsp__popup">
                                        <strong>{v.vendor_profile?.business_name || 'Vendor'}</strong>
                                        <button onClick={() => handleSelect(v)}>Select</button>
                                    </div>
                                </Popup>
                            </Marker>
                        ))}
                    </MapContainer>
                </div>

                {/* Vendor list */}
                <div className="vsp__vendor-list">
                    <h3>Network Vendors in {returnCityName}</h3>
                    {returnVendors.map(v => (
                        <button
                            key={v.id}
                            className={`vsp__vendor-card${selectedReturn?.id === v.id ? ' selected' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => handleSelect(v)}
                        >
                            <div className="vsp__vendor-card__info">
                                <strong>{v.vendor_profile?.business_name || 'Vendor'}</strong>
                                <div className="vsp__vendor-card__meta">
                                    {v.vendor_profile?.rating && <span>⭐ {v.vendor_profile.rating}</span>}
                                    {v.is_certified && <span className="vsp__cert">🏅 Certified</span>}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            {selectedReturn?.id === v.id && (
                                <div className="vsp__vendor-card__check">✓</div>
                            )}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>

            {error && <div className="wizard-error">{error}</div>}

            {selectedReturn && (
                <div className="vsp__selected-summary">
                    ✓ Return vendor: <strong>{selectedReturn.vendor_profile?.business_name}</strong>
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="wizard-page__actions">
                <button className="wizard-btn--back" onClick={() => navigate('/book/select-vendor')}>
                    ← Back
                </button>
                <button className="wizard-btn--next" onClick={handleNext} disabled={!selectedReturn}>
                    Choose Add-ons →
                </button>
            </div>
        </WizardShell>
    );
}
