// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SegmentSelectPage.jsx  (Step 1 — Choose Vehicle Segment)
// Route: /book/select-car
//
// REPLACES CarModelSelectPage.jsx.
// Instead of showing individual car models, this page shows the available
// vehicle SEGMENTS (Hatchback, Sedan, SUV, etc.) for the chosen city/dates,
// with vehicle counts, vendor counts, and price ranges.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate }              from 'react-router-dom';
import { useBooking }               from '../../context/BookingContext';
import { getAvailableSegments }     from '../../services/api';
import { WizardShell, WizardProgress, buildSteps, useAuthModal } from './BookingShared';
import { calcNights }               from './bookingConstants';
import './SegmentSelectPage.css';
import '../BookingWizard.css';

export default function SegmentSelectPage() {
    const navigate             = useNavigate();
    const { booking, update }  = useBooking();
    const { openAuth, AuthModalEl } = useAuthModal();

    const [segments,  setSegments]  = useState([]);
    const [loading,   setLoading]   = useState(true);
    const [error,     setError]     = useState('');

    // Guard: must have selected a city + dates on the home page
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!booking.pickupCity || !booking.pickupDate) navigate('/');
    }, [booking.pickupCity, booking.pickupDate, navigate]);

    const nights = calcNights(booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate);

    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true); setError('');
        try {
            const { data } = await getAvailableSegments({
                city:         booking.pickupCity.id,
                pickup_date:  booking.pickupDate,
                return_date:  booking.returnDate,
            });
            setSegments(data.segments || []);
        } catch {
            setError('Could not load available vehicles. Check your connection or try again.');
            setSegments([]);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, [booking.pickupCity, booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate]);

    useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

    // When a segment tile is clicked, store it and proceed to vendor/vehicle search
    const handleSelectSegment = (seg) => {
        update({
            selectedSegment:  seg.segment,       // e.g. 'suv'
            selectedModel:    null,               // clear previous model
            selectedVehicle:  null,
            pickupLocation:   null,
            returnLocation:   null,
        });
        navigate('/book/select-vendor');
    };

    const steps = buildSteps('car', booking.isDifferentReturn);

    return (
        <WizardShell onLoginClick={openAuth} className="ssp-page">
            <WizardProgress steps={steps} />

            {/* Trip summary strip */}
            <div className="ssp__trip-strip">
                <div className="ssp__trip-item">
                    <span>📍 City</span>
                    <strong>{booking.pickupCity?.name}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="ssp__trip-item">
                    <span>📅 From</span>
                    <strong>{booking.pickupDate}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="ssp__trip-item">
                    <span>📅 To</span>
                    <strong>{booking.returnDate}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="ssp__trip-item">
                    <span>⏱ Duration</span>
                    <strong>{nights} day{nights > 1 ? 's' : ''}</strong>
                </div>
                {booking.isDifferentReturn && (
                    <div className="ssp__trip-item">
                        <span>🏁 Return to</span>
                        <strong>{booking.returnCity?.name}</strong>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>

            {/* Page header */}
            <div className="ssp__header">
                <h2>What type of car are you looking for?</h2>
                <p>
                    {loading
                        ? 'Finding available vehicles…'
                        : `${segments.length} category${segments.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} available in ${booking.pickupCity?.name}`
                    }
                </p>
            </div>

            {/* Grid */}
            {loading ? (
                <div className="ssp__skeletons">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map(i => (
                        <div key={i} className="ssp__skeleton wz-skeleton" />
                    ))}
                </div>
            ) : error ? (
                <div className="ssp__error">
                    <p>{error}</p>
                    <button onClick={load}>↺ Retry</button>
                </div>
            ) : segments.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="ssp__empty">
                    <div>🔍</div>
                    <h3>No vehicles available</h3>
                    <p>No cars found for these dates. Try different dates or another city.</p>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="ssp__grid">
                    {segments.map(seg => (
                        <SegmentCard
                            key={seg.segment}
                            seg={seg}
                            nights={nights}
                            onSelect={handleSelectSegment}
                        />
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}

            {AuthModalEl}
        </WizardShell>
    );
}

// ── SegmentCard ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SegmentCard({ seg, nights, onSelect }) {
    const minTotal = (parseFloat(seg.min_rate) * nights).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    });

    return (
        <button className="seg-card" onClick={() => onSelect(seg)}>
            {/* Head row: icon + certified badge */}
            <div className="seg-card__head">
                <span className="seg-card__icon">{seg.icon}</span>
                {seg.certified_count > 0 && (
                    <span className="seg-card__cert">🏅 {seg.certified_count} Certified</span>
                )}
            </div>

            {/* Label + description */}
            <div className="seg-card__label">{seg.label}</div>
            <div className="seg-card__desc">{seg.desc}</div>

            {/* Stats */}
            <div className="seg-card__stats">
                <div className="seg-card__stat">
                    <span className="seg-card__stat-val">{seg.vehicle_count}</span>
                    <span className="seg-card__stat-lbl">Car{seg.vehicle_count !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="seg-card__stat">
                    <span className="seg-card__stat-val">{seg.vendor_count}</span>
                    <span className="seg-card__stat-lbl">Vendor{seg.vendor_count !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Price band */}
            <div className="seg-card__price">
                <span className="seg-card__price-from">* starting from</span>
                <span className="seg-card__price-val">
                    ₹{parseInt(seg.min_rate).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                </span>
                <span className="seg-card__price-unit">/day</span>
                <span className="seg-card__price-range">
                    · ₹{minTotal} for {nights} day{nights > 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </span>
            </div>

            {/* CTA */}
            <div className="seg-card__cta">
                <span>Browse {seg.label}s</span>
                <span>→</span>
            </div>
        </button>
    );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// VendorSelectPage.jsx  (Step 2 — Browse Vehicles & Choose Vendor)
// Route: /book/select-vendor
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate }                from 'react-router-dom';
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Popup, useMap } from 'react-leaflet';
import L                              from 'leaflet';
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
import { useBooking }                 from '../../context/BookingContext';
import { calculatePrice, getOneWayFee, searchVehicles } from '../../services/api';
import { WizardShell, WizardProgress, buildSteps, useAuthModal } from './BookingShared';
import {
    fixLeafletIcons, makePinIcon, getCityCenter,
    getVehicleCoords, calcNights, segIcon, SEGMENT_ICONS,
} from './bookingConstants';
import './VendorSelectPage.css';
import '../BookingWizard.css';

fixLeafletIcons(L);

// ── FlyTo helper (inside MapContainer) ───────────────────────────────────────
function FlyTo({ center }) {
    const map = useMap();
    useEffect(() => {
        if (center) map.flyTo(center, 13, { duration: 1 });
    }, [center, map]);
    return null;
}

// ── Default filter state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DEFAULT_FILTERS = {
    fuel_type:      '',
    transmission:   '',
    model_search:   '',
    certified_only: false,
    sort:           'price_asc',
};

export default function VendorSelectPage() {
    const navigate             = useNavigate();
    const { booking, update }  = useBooking();
    const { openAuth, AuthModalEl } = useAuthModal();

    // Raw vehicles from API (filtered server-side by segment + city + dates)
    const [vehicles,       setVehicles]       = useState([]);
    const [loadingVehicles,setLoadingVehicles] = useState(true);
    const [vehicleError,   setVehicleError]   = useState('');

    // Client-side filters
    const [filters, setFilters] = useState(DEFAULT_FILTERS);

    // Prices keyed by vehicle.id
    const [prices,        setPrices]        = useState({});
    const [loadingPrices, setLoadingPrices] = useState(false);

    // One-way fee (cross-city trips)
    const [oneWayFee, setOneWayFee] = useState(0);

    // Currently selected vehicle
    const [selectedVehicle, setSelectedVehicle] = useState(null);
    const [error,           setError]           = useState('');

    // ── Guards ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!booking.selectedSegment || !booking.pickupCity) {
            navigate('/book/select-car');
        }
    }, [booking.selectedSegment, booking.pickupCity, navigate]);

    const nights     = calcNights(booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate);
    const cityCenter = getCityCenter(booking.pickupCity?.name);
    const segment    = booking.selectedSegment || '';

    // ── One-way fee ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (booking.isDifferentReturn && booking.pickupCity?.id && booking.returnCity?.id) {
            getOneWayFee(booking.pickupCity.id, booking.returnCity.id)
                .then(({ data }) => setOneWayFee(parseFloat(data.fee) || 0))
                .catch(() => setOneWayFee(0));
        }
    }, [booking.isDifferentReturn, booking.pickupCity, booking.returnCity]);

    // ── Fetch vehicles for this segment ───────────────────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!booking.pickupCity?.id || !segment) return;
        const load = async () => {
            setLoadingVehicles(true); setVehicleError('');
            try {
                const { data } = await searchVehicles({
                    city:        booking.pickupCity.id,
                    pickup_date: booking.pickupDate,
                    return_date: booking.returnDate,
                    segment,
                });
                setVehicles(data.results || data || []);
            } catch {
                setVehicleError('Could not load vehicles. Check your connection.');
                setVehicles([]);
            } finally {
                setLoadingVehicles(false);
            }
        };
        load();
    }, [booking.pickupCity, booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate, segment]);

    // ── Fetch prices for all loaded vehicles ──────────────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!vehicles.length) return;
        const fetchPrices = async () => {
            setLoadingPrices(true);
            const results = {};
            await Promise.all(vehicles.map(async v => {
                try {
                    const { data } = await calculatePrice({
                        vehicle_id:  v.id,
                        pickup_date: booking.pickupDate,
                        return_date: booking.returnDate,
                        pickup_time: booking.pickupTime || null,
                        return_time: booking.returnTime || null,
                        addons:      [],
                        one_way_fee: oneWayFee,
                    });
                    results[v.id] = data;
                } catch {
                    const base = parseFloat(v.daily_rate) * nights;
                    const gst  = base * 0.18;
                    results[v.id] = {
                        base_amount: base.toFixed(2),
                        gst_amount:  gst.toFixed(2),
                        grand_total: (base + gst + oneWayFee).toFixed(2),
                        security_deposit: '2000.00',
                    };
                }
            }));
            setPrices(results);
            setLoadingPrices(false);
        };
        fetchPrices();
    }, [vehicles, booking.pickupDate, booking.returnDate, oneWayFee, nights]);

    // ── Extract unique values for filter dropdowns ────────────────────────────
    const uniqueFuelTypes     = useMemo(() => [...new Set(vehicles.map(v => v.fuel_type))].sort(), [vehicles]);
    const uniqueTransmissions = useMemo(() => [...new Set(vehicles.map(v => v.transmission))].sort(), [vehicles]);
    const uniqueModels        = useMemo(() => [...new Set(vehicles.map(v => `${v.make} ${v.model}`))].sort(), [vehicles]);

    // ── Client-side filtering + sorting ──────────────────────────────────────
    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = [...vehicles];

        if (filters.fuel_type)
            result = result.filter(v => v.fuel_type === filters.fuel_type);
        if (filters.transmission)
            result = result.filter(v => v.transmission === filters.transmission);
        if (filters.model_search.trim())
            result = result.filter(v =>
                `${v.make} ${v.model}`.toLowerCase().includes(filters.model_search.toLowerCase())
            );
        if (filters.certified_only)
            result = result.filter(v => v.is_certified);

        result.sort((a, b) => {
            const pa = prices[a.id] ? parseFloat(prices[a.id].grand_total) : parseFloat(a.daily_rate) * nights;
            const pb = prices[b.id] ? parseFloat(prices[b.id].grand_total) : parseFloat(b.daily_rate) * nights;
            if (filters.sort === 'price_asc')  return pa - pb;
            if (filters.sort === 'price_desc') return pb - pa;
            if (filters.sort === 'rating')
                return parseFloat(b.vendor_profile?.rating || 0) - parseFloat(a.vendor_profile?.rating || 0);
            return 0;
        });

        return result;
    }, [vehicles, filters, prices, nights]);

    const setFilter = (key, value) =>
        setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));

    const clearFilters = () => setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS);

    const hasActiveFilter = Object.entries(filters).some(([k, v]) =>
        k !== 'sort' && v !== '' && v !== false
    );

    // ── Select a vehicle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSelectVehicle = (v) => {
        setSelectedVehicle(v);
        update({ selectedVehicle: null, pickupLocation: null, pickupVendor: null });
        setError('');
    };

    // ── Confirm vendor and continue ───────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleConfirmVendor = () => {
        if (!selectedVehicle) {
            setError('Please select a vehicle from the map or list.');
            return;
        }
        const coords = getVehicleCoords(selectedVehicle, cityCenter, 0);
        update({
            selectedVehicle,
            selectedModel: {
                make:    selectedVehicle.make,
                model:   selectedVehicle.model,
                segment: selectedVehicle.segment,
                vehicles: [selectedVehicle],
            },
            pickupLocation: {
                id:   selectedVehicle.pickup_location?.id || selectedVehicle.id,
                name: selectedVehicle.vendor_profile?.business_name || 'Vendor Location',
                lat:  coords[0],
                lng:  coords[1],
            },
            pickupVendor: selectedVehicle.vendor_profile,
            oneWayFee,
        });

        if (booking.isDifferentReturn) {
            navigate('/book/return-vendor');
        } else {
            update({ returnLocation: null, returnVendor: null });
            navigate('/book/addons');
        }
    };

    if (!segment) return null;

    const steps   = buildSteps('vendor', booking.isDifferentReturn);
    const segLabel = segment.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + segment.slice(1);
    const segEmoji = SEGMENT_ICONS[segment] || '🚗';

    return (
        <WizardShell onLoginClick={openAuth} className="vsp-page">
            <WizardProgress steps={steps} />

            {/* Segment recap banner */}
            <div className="vsp__model-recap">
                <div className="vsp__model-recap-icon">{segEmoji}</div>
                <div>
                    <h2>{segLabel}s in {booking.pickupCity?.name}</h2>
                    <p>
                        {loadingVehicles
                            ? 'Loading vehicles…'
                            : `${vehicles.length} vehicle${vehicles.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} · ${nights} day${nights > 1 ? 's' : ''}`
                        }
                    </p>
                </div>
                <button className="vsp__change-car" onClick={() => navigate('/book/select-car')}>
                    ← Change Type
                </button>
            </div>

            {vehicleError && (
                <div className="wizard-error">{vehicleError}</div>
            )}

            <div className="vsp__body">

                {/* ── Filter sidebar ── */}
                <aside className="vsp__filters">
                    <h3>Filter Results</h3>

                    {/* Model search */}
                    <div className="vsp__filter-group">
                        <label>Search Model</label>
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="e.g. Swift, Creta…"
                            value={filters.model_search}
                            onChange={e => setFilter('model_search', e.target.value)}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* Fuel type */}
                    <div className="vsp__filter-group">
                        <label>Fuel Type</label>
                        <select value={filters.fuel_type} onChange={e => setFilter('fuel_type', e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="">Any Fuel</option>
                            {uniqueFuelTypes.map(f => (
                                <option key={f} value={f}>{f.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + f.slice(1)}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    {/* Transmission */}
                    <div className="vsp__filter-group">
                        <label>Transmission</label>
                        <select value={filters.transmission} onChange={e => setFilter('transmission', e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="">Any</option>
                            {uniqueTransmissions.map(t => (
                                <option key={t} value={t}>{t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1)}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    {/* Sort */}
                    <div className="vsp__filter-group">
                        <label>Sort By</label>
                        <select value={filters.sort} onChange={e => setFilter('sort', e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="price_asc">Price: Low → High</option>
                            <option value="price_desc">Price: High → Low</option>
                            <option value="rating">Vendor Rating</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    {/* Certified only toggle */}
                    <label className="vsp__certified-toggle">
                        <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={filters.certified_only}
                            onChange={e => setFilter('certified_only', e.target.checked)}
                        />
                        <span className="vsp__certified-track" />
                        <span>Certified only 🏅</span>

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// cdConstants.js
// Colour maps, status constants, and pure helpers shared across all
// CustomerDashboard sub-components.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const STATUS_CLR = {
    PENDING:   { bg: '#FEF3C7', color: '#D97706', border: '#FCD34D' },
    CONFIRMED: { bg: '#DBEAFE', color: '#1D4ED8', border: '#93C5FD' },
    ACTIVE:    { bg: '#D1FAE5', color: '#059669', border: '#6EE7B7' },
    COMPLETED: { bg: '#F3F4F6', color: '#6B7280', border: '#D1D5DB' },
    CANCELLED: { bg: '#FEE2E2', color: '#EF4444', border: '#FCA5A5' },
};

// ── Date / time helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function fmtDate(d) {
    if (!d) return '—';
    return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
        day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric',
    });
}

export function fmtDatetime(d) {
    if (!d) return '—';
    return new Date(d).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
        day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
    });
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// cdShared.jsx
// Tiny reusable UI primitives used across CustomerDashboard sub-components.
// No API calls — pure presentation only.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { STATUS_CLR } from './cdConstants';

// ── Status badge ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function StatusBadge({ status }) {
    const s = STATUS_CLR[status] || { bg: '#F3F4F6', color: '#6B7280', border: '#D1D5DB' };
    return (
        <span style={{
            display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center',
            padding: '3px 9px', borderRadius: 999,
            fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700,
            letterSpacing: '0.4px', textTransform: 'uppercase',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            background: s.bg, color: s.color,
            border: `1px solid ${s.border}`,
        }}>
            {status}
        </span>
    );
}

// ── Info row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function InfoRow({ label, value, highlight }) {
    return (
        <div className="cd-info-row">
            <span className="cd-info-row__lbl">{label}</span>
            <strong
                className="cd-info-row__val"
                style={highlight ? { color: 'var(--cd-acc)', fontSize: 15 } : {}}
            >
                {value || '—'}
            </strong>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Toast notification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function Toast({ msg, type, onDone }) {
    useEffect(() => {
        const t = setTimeout(onDone, 3500);
        return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }, [onDone]);

    return (
        <div className={`cd-toast cd-toast--${type}`}>
            {type === 'success'
                ? <span className="toast-icon success">&#10003;</span>
                : <span className="toast-icon warning">!</span>
            }
            {msg}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Star rating input / display ────────────────────────────────────────────
export function StarRating({ value, onChange, readonly }) {
    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(n => (
                <button
                    key={n}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => !readonly && onChange?.(n)}
                    style={{
                        background: 'none', border: 'none',
                        cursor: readonly ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                        fontSize: 22,
                        color: n <= value ? '#E8A020' : '#D1D5DB',
                        padding: 0, transition: 'color 0.15s',
                    }}
                >
                    &#9733;
                </button>
            ))}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Filter dropdown ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function FilterDropdown({ label, value, options, onChange }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const ref = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const h = e => {
            if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false);
        };
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
    }, []);

    const selected = options.find(o => o.value === value);
    const isActive = value !== '' && value != null;

    return (
        <div className="cd-filter-dropdown" ref={ref}>
            <button
                className={`cd-filter-dropdown__trigger${isActive ? ' active' : ''}${open ? ' open' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setOpen(v => !v)}
            >
                <span className="cd-filter-dropdown__label">{label}</span>
                {isActive && (
                    <span className="cd-filter-dropdown__chip">{selected?.label}</span>
                )}
                <span className={`cd-filter-dropdown__chevron${open ? ' flipped' : ''}`}>▾</span>
            </button>
            {open && (
                <div className="cd-filter-dropdown__menu">
                    {options.map(opt => (
                        <button
                            key={opt.value}
                            className={`cd-filter-dropdown__item${value === opt.value ? ' selected' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => { onChange(opt.value); setOpen(false); }}
                        >
                            {opt.color && (
                                <span
                                    className="cd-filter-dropdown__dot"
                                    style={{ background: opt.color }}
                                />
                            )}
                            <span>{opt.label}</span>
                            {value === opt.value && (
                                <span className="cd-filter-dropdown__check">✓</span>
                            )}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { Sidebar }  from '../../components/common/Navbar';
import NotificationsPanel from '../../components/notifications/NotificationsPanel';
import Navbar        from '../../components/common/Navbar';

// ── API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import {
    getMyBookings, getMyBookingDetail,
    getLoyaltyBalance, getCustomerProfile,
    getPendingReviews,
    getMySubmittedReviews,
} from '../../services/api';

// ── Shared primitives ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import { Toast } from './cdShared';

// ── Modals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import BookingDetailModal from './modals/BookingDetailModal';
import WriteReviewModal   from './modals/WriteReviewModal';
import ViewReviewModal    from './modals/ViewReviewModal';
import KYCVerifyModal     from './modals/KYCVerifyModal';

// ── Tabs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import BookingsTab  from './tabs/BookingsTab';
import ReviewsTab   from './tabs/ReviewsTab';
import MyReviewsTab from './tabs/MyReviewsTab';
import LoyaltyTab   from './tabs/LoyaltyTab';
import ProfileTab   from './tabs/ProfileTab';

// ── CSS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import './CustomerDashboard.css';
import '../../components/common/DataTable.css';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function CustomerDashboard() {
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const [tab, setTab] = useState('bookings');

    // ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [bookings,          setBookings]          = useState([]);
    const [loyalty,           setLoyalty]           = useState(null);
    const [profile,           setProfile]           = useState(null);
    const [pendingReviews,    setPendingReviews]    = useState([]);
    const [submittedReviews,  setSubmittedReviews]  = useState([]);

    // ── UI state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [loading,                 setLoading]                 = useState(true);
    const [error,                   setError]                   = useState('');
    const [toast,                   setToast]                   = useState(null);
    const [submittedReviewsLoading, setSubmittedReviewsLoading] = useState(false);

    // ── Booking detail cache ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [bookingDetails, setBookingDetails] = useState({});
    const [detailLoading,  setDetailLoading]  = useState(false);

    // ── Modal open state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [selectedBooking,        setSelectedBooking]        = useState(null);
    const [selectedPendingReview,  setSelectedPendingReview]  = useState(null);
    const [selectedSubmittedReview,setSelectedSubmittedReview]= useState(null);
    const [kycModal,               setKycModal]               = useState(null);
    const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
    const highlightRef = useRef(null);

    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const showToast = useCallback((msg, type = 'success') => {
        setToast({ msg, type });
    }, []);

    // ── Load submitted reviews ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const loadSubmittedReviews = useCallback(async () => {
        setSubmittedReviewsLoading(true);
        try {
            const { data: completedData } = await getMyBookings('COMPLETED');
            const completedList = completedData.results || completedData;
            const detailPromises = completedList
                .slice(0, 20)
                .map(b => getMyBookingDetail(b.id).then(r => r.data).catch(() => null));
            const details = (await Promise.all(detailPromises)).filter(Boolean);
            const { data } = await getMySubmittedReviews(details);
            setSubmittedReviews(data.results || []);
        } catch {
            showToast('Could not load submitted reviews.', 'error');
        } finally {
            setSubmittedReviewsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [showToast]);

    // ── Tab data loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const loadTab = useCallback(async t => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError('');
        try {
            if (t === 'bookings') {
                const { data } = await getMyBookings();
                setBookings(data.results || data);

            } else if (t === 'profile') {
                const [p, l] = await Promise.all([
                    getCustomerProfile(),
                    getLoyaltyBalance(),
                ]);
                setProfile(p.data);
                setLoyalty(l.data);

            } else if (t === 'loyalty') {
                const { data } = await getLoyaltyBalance();
                setLoyalty(data);

            } else if (t === 'reviews') {
                const { data } = await getPendingReviews();
                setPendingReviews(data.pending_reviews || data.results || data);

            } else if (t === 'my-reviews') {
                await loadSubmittedReviews();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            setError(`Could not load data. ${e.response?.data?.detail || ''}`);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, [loadSubmittedReviews]);

    useEffect(() => { loadTab(tab); }, [tab, loadTab]);

    // Pre-load bookings + loyalty for hero KPIs on mount
    useEffect(() => {
        Promise.all([getMyBookings(), getLoyaltyBalance()])
            .then(([b, l]) => {
                setBookings(b.data.results || b.data);
                setLoyalty(l.data);
            })
            .catch(() => {});
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const tabParam = searchParams.get('tab');
        if (tabParam && tabParam !== tab) setTab(tabParam);
        const highlight = searchParams.get('highlight');
        if (highlight) highlightRef.current = highlight;
    }, [searchParams]);


    useEffect(() => {
        if (tab === 'bookings' && highlightRef.current && bookings.length > 0) {
            const match = bookings.find((b) => String(b.id) === String(highlightRef.current));
            if (match) openBookingDetail(match);
            highlightRef.current = null;
            const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
            next.delete('highlight');
            setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
        }
    }, [bookings, tab]);

    // ── Open booking detail (with caching) ───────────────────────────────────
    const openBookingDetail = async booking => {
        setSelectedBooking(booking);
        if (!bookingDetails[booking.id]) {
            setDetailLoading(true);
            try {
                const { data } = await getMyBookingDetail(booking.id);
                setBookingDetails(prev => ({ ...prev, [booking.id]: data }));
            } catch {
                showToast('Could not load booking details.', 'error');
            } finally {
                setDetailLoading(false);
            }
        }
    };

    // ── Refresh booking after action (sign, pay, cancel, inspect) ────────────
    const refreshBooking = useCallback(async bookingId => {
        try {
            const [detailRes, listRes] = await Promise.all([
                getMyBookingDetail(bookingId),
                getMyBookings(),
            ]);
            setBookingDetails(prev => ({ ...prev, [bookingId]: detailRes.data }));
            setBookings(listRes.data.results || listRes.data);
            setSelectedBooking(prev =>
                prev?.id === bookingId
                    ? { ...prev, ...(listRes.data.results?.find(b => b.id === bookingId) || {}) }
                    : prev,
            );
        } catch {
            showToast('Could not refresh booking.', 'error');
        }
    }, [showToast]);

    // ── KYC verified callback ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleKYCVerified = async type => {
        setKycModal(null);
        try {
            const { data } = await getCustomerProfile();
            setProfile(data);
        } catch {}
        showToast(`${type === 'phone' ? 'Phone number' : 'Email address'} verified successfully!`);
    };

    // ── Derived KPIs for hero strip ───────────────────────────────────────────
    const activeCount    = bookings.filter(b => ['CONFIRMED', 'ACTIVE'].includes(b.status)).length;
    const completedCount = bookings.filter(b => b.status === 'COMPLETED').length;
    const totalSpend     = bookings
        .filter(b => !['CANCELLED', 'PENDING'].includes(b.status))
        .reduce((s, b) => s + parseFloat(b.total_amount || 0), 0);

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    return (
        <div className="cd">
            <Navbar hideLogo />
            <Sidebar activeTab={tab} onTabChange={setTab} />

            {/* Toast */}
            {toast && (
                <Toast msg={toast.msg} type={toast.type} onDone={() => setToast(null)} />
            )}

            {/* KYC OTP Modal */}
            {kycModal && (
                <KYCVerifyModal
                    type={kycModal.type}
                    value={kycModal.value}
                    userEmail={profile?.email || user?.email || ''}
                    onClose={() => setKycModal(null)}
                    onVerified={() => handleKYCVerified(kycModal.type)}
                    showToast={showToast}
                />
            )}

            {/* Booking detail modal — only via "View Booking" button */}
            {selectedBooking && (
                <BookingDetailModal
                    booking={selectedBooking}
                    detail={bookingDetails[selectedBooking.id]}
                    loading={detailLoading && !bookingDetails[selectedBooking.id]}
                    onRefresh={() => refreshBooking(selectedBooking.id)}
                    showToast={showToast}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedBooking(null)}
                />
            )}

            {/* Write review modal */}
            {selectedPendingReview && (
                <WriteReviewModal
                    booking={selectedPendingReview}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedPendingReview(null)}
                    onSubmitted={bookingId =>
                        setPendingReviews(p => p.filter(b => b.booking_id !== bookingId))
                    }
                    showToast={showToast}
                />
            )}

            {/* View submitted review modal */}
            {selectedSubmittedReview && (
                <ViewReviewModal
                    review={selectedSubmittedReview}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedSubmittedReview(null)}
                />
            )}

            {/* ── Page shell ── */}
            <div className="cd__shell">
                <div className="cd__inner">

                    {/* ── Hero banner ── */}
                    <div className="cd__hero">
                        <div className="cd__hero-banner" />
                        <div className="cd__hero-body">
                            <div className="cd__hero-left">
                                <div className="cd__hero-avatar">
                                    {(user?.full_name || user?.email || 'U')[0].toUpperCase()}
                                </div>
                                <div className="cd__hero-info">
                                    <div className="cd__hero-name">
                                        Welcome back, {user?.full_name?.split(' ')[0] || 'there'}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="cd__hero-sub">{user?.email}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="cd__kpis">
                                {[
                                    [activeCount,                                                         'Active Bookings', '#1D4ED8'],
                                    [completedCount,                                                      'Completed',       '#059669'],
                                    [`₹${Math.round(totalSpend).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,               'Total Spend',     '#0DB89E'],
                                    [loyalty ? `${loyalty.loyalty_points}` : '—',                        'Loyalty Pts',     '#D97706'],
                                ].map(([v, l, color]) => (
                                    <div key={l} className="cd__kpi">
                                        <span className="cd__kpi-val" style={{ color }}>{v}</span>
                                        <span className="cd__kpi-lbl">{l}</span>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* ── Loading / error states ── */}
                    {loading && tab !== 'my-reviews' && (
                        <div className="cd-loading">
                            <div className="cd-spinner" /> Loading…
                        </div>
                    )}
                    {error && <div className="cd-error">{error}</div>}

                    {/* ── Tab content ── */}
                    {!loading && tab === 'bookings' && (
                        <BookingsTab
                            bookings={bookings}
                            onViewBooking={openBookingDetail}
                        />
                    )}

                    {!loading && tab === 'reviews' && (
                        <ReviewsTab
                            pendingReviews={pendingReviews}
                            onWriteReview={row => setSelectedPendingReview(row)}
                        />
                    )}

                    {tab === 'my-reviews' && (
                        <MyReviewsTab
                            submittedReviews={submittedReviews}
                            loading={submittedReviewsLoading}
                            onViewReview={row => setSelectedSubmittedReview(row)}
                        />
                    )}

                    {!loading && tab === 'loyalty' && (
                        <LoyaltyTab
                            loyalty={loyalty}
                            onLoyaltyUpdate={newBalance =>
                                setLoyalty(p => ({ ...p, loyalty_points: newBalance }))
                            }
                            showToast={showToast}
                        />
                    )}

                    {!loading && tab === 'profile' && profile && (
                        <ProfileTab
                            profile={profile}
                            user={user}
                            onProfileSaved={updates =>
                                setProfile(p => ({ ...p, ...updates }))
                            }
                            onOpenKYCModal={(type, value) =>
                                setKycModal({ type, value })
                            }
                            showToast={showToast}
                        />
                    )}

                    {tab === 'notifications' && <NotificationsPanel />}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

                                        key={ph.id}

                                        style={{ cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 6, overflow: 'hidden' }}
                                    >
                                        <img
                                            src={ph.image}
                                            alt="insp"
                                            style={{
                                                width: 70, height: 54, objectFit: 'cover',
                                                borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid var(--cd-bdr)',
                                                display: 'block',
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }

    if (isPickup && existingInspection && !existingInspection.is_locked) {
        const handleVerifyOtp = async () => {
            if (otpCode.length !== 6) { showToast('Enter 6-digit OTP.', 'error'); return; }
            setOtpBusy(true);
            try {
                await signInspection(bookingId, 'pickup', 'verify', otpCode);
                showToast('Pickup verified! Trip is now ACTIVE.');
                setOtpCode('');
                onRefresh();
            } catch (e) {
                showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Invalid OTP.', 'error');
            }
            setOtpBusy(false);
        };

        return (
            <div style={{ border: '1px solid #FCD34D', borderRadius: 10, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                <div
                    onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
                    style={{
                        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        padding: '10px 14px', background: '#FFFBEB', cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                >
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        <div style={ICON_STYLE(true)}>P</div>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Pickup Inspection</strong>
                        <span style={{
                            background: '#FEF3C7', color: '#D97706', border: '1px solid #FCD34D',
                            fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999,
                        }}>
                            Enter OTP from Vendor
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--cd-muted)' }}>
                        {expanded ? '▲' : '▼'}

                        <div style={{

                            borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 12px', fontSize: 13,

                            <strong>Enter OTP from Vendor</strong>
                            <p style={{ marginTop: 4, fontSize: 12, color: '#1D4ED8' }}>

                                className="cd-input"

                                    width: 140, textAlign: 'center',
                                    letterSpacing: '6px', fontSize: 20,
                                    fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                }}
                                maxLength={6}
                                placeholder="——————"
                                value={otpCode}
                                onChange={e => setOtpCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6))}

    }

    // ── Return: customer generates OTP for vendor ──────────────────────────
    if (!isPickup && existingInspection && !existingInspection.is_locked) {

                const { data } = await signInspection(bookingId, 'return', 'generate', null);

                        onClose={() => setLightboxIndex(null)}

                        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        padding: '10px 14px', background: '#FFFBEB', cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        <div style={ICON_STYLE(false)}>D</div>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Drop-off Inspection</strong>
                        <span style={{
                            background: '#FEF3C7', color: '#D97706', border: '1px solid #FCD34D',
                            fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999,
                        }}>
                            Review & Generate OTP
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--cd-muted)' }}>
                        {expanded ? '▲' : '▼'}
                    </span>
                </div>

                        <div style={{
                            background: '#F8FAFB', border: '1px solid var(--cd-bdr)',
                            borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 12px',
                        }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap', fontSize: 13 }}>
                                <span>Odometer: <strong>{existingInspection.odometer_reading} km</strong></span>
                                <span>Fuel: <strong>{existingInspection.fuel_level}</strong></span>
                                {existingInspection.damage_reported && (

                                        Damage: <strong>{existingInspection.damage_notes}</strong>

                                {photos.map((ph, idx) => (

                                        style={{ cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 6, overflow: 'hidden' }}

                                        <img

                                            alt="insp"

                                    </div>

                                    letterSpacing: 10, fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#059669',

                                    Generate New OTP
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>

        );

    // ── Not yet available ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!canCreate) {

                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
            }}>
                <div style={ICON_STYLE(isPickup)}>{isPickup ? 'P' : 'D'}</div>
                <span>
                    {isPickup
                        ? 'Pickup inspection — available after agreement is signed.'
                        : 'Drop-off inspection — filled by vendor when you return the vehicle.'}
                </span>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // ── Drop-off: not applicable for customer creation ─────────────────────
    if (!isPickup) {
        return (
            <div style={{
                border: '1px dashed var(--cd-bdr)', borderRadius: 10,
                padding: '12px 14px', fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--cd-muted)',
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
            }}>
                <div style={ICON_STYLE(false)}>D</div>
                <span>Drop-off inspection is recorded by the vendor when you return the vehicle.</span>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // ── Pickup creation form ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSave = async () => {
        if (!form.odometer_reading) { showToast('Odometer reading is required.', 'error'); return; }
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('odometer_reading', form.odometer_reading);
            fd.append('fuel_level', form.fuel_level);
            fd.append('notes', form.notes);
            fd.append('checklist', JSON.stringify({
                exterior: true, interior: true, tyres: true, documents: true,
            }));
            const { data: inspData } = await createInspection(bookingId, 'pickup', fd);
            if (photoFile && inspData?.inspection_id) {
                const pfd = new FormData();
                pfd.append('image', photoFile);
                pfd.append('angle', 'other');
                try {
                    await uploadInspectionPhoto(inspData.inspection_id, pfd);
                } catch {
                    showToast('Inspection saved, but photo upload failed.', 'error');
                }
            }
            showToast('Pickup inspection submitted!');
            onRefresh();
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed.', 'error');
        }
        setSaving(false);
    };

    return (
        <div style={{ border: '1px solid var(--cd-acc)', borderRadius: 10, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div
                onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
                style={{
                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    padding: '10px 14px', background: 'var(--cd-acc-l)', cursor: 'pointer',
                    borderBottom: expanded ? '1px solid var(--cd-acc)' : 'none',
                }}
            >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <div style={ICON_STYLE(true)}>P</div>
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Pickup Inspection</strong>
                    <span style={{
                        background: '#DBEAFE', color: '#1D4ED8', border: '1px solid #93C5FD',
                        fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999,
                    }}>
                        Ready to Fill
                    </span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--cd-muted)' }}>
                    {expanded ? 'Hide' : 'Fill Form'}
                </span>
            </div>

            {expanded && (
                <div style={{ padding: '14px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
                        <div className="cd-form-field">
                            <label>Odometer Reading (km) *</label>
                            <input
                                className="cd-input"
                                type="number"
                                value={form.odometer_reading}
                                onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, odometer_reading: e.target.value }))}
                                placeholder="e.g. 45230"
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="cd-form-field">
                            <label>Fuel Level</label>
                            <select
                                className="cd-input"
                                value={form.fuel_level}
                                onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, fuel_level: e.target.value }))}
                            >
                                {['empty', 'quarter', 'half', 'three_quarter', 'full'].map(v => (
                                    <option key={v} value={v}>{v.replace('_', ' ')}</option>
                                ))}
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="cd-form-field">
                        <label>Notes (optional)</label>
                        <textarea
                            className="cd-input cd-textarea"

                        />

                        className="cd-btn cd-btn--primary"
                        onClick={handleSave}
                        disabled={saving}
                    >
                        {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Submit Pickup Inspection'}
                    </button>
                </div>

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function PhotoLightbox({ photos, initialIndex, onClose }) {
    const [current, setCurrent] = useState(initialIndex || 0);

    useEffect(() => {
        const h = e => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape')     onClose();
            if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') setCurrent(c => Math.min(c + 1, photos.length - 1));
            if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  setCurrent(c => Math.max(c - 1, 0));
        };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', h);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', h);
    }, [photos.length, onClose]);

    const navBtnStyle = (disabled) => ({
        background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
        color: '#fff', borderRadius: 8,
        padding: '10px 16px', fontSize: 18,
        cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
        opacity: disabled ? 0.3 : 1,
    });

    return (
        <div
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
                position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 9999,
                background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.88)',
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16,
            }}
        >
            <button
                onClick={onClose}
                style={{
                    position: 'absolute', top: 20, right: 24,
                    background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                    color: '#fff', borderRadius: 8,
                    padding: '6px 14px', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
            >
                ✕ Close
            </button>

            <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16 }}>
                <button
                    style={navBtnStyle(current === 0)}
                    onClick={() => setCurrent(c => Math.max(c - 1, 0))}
                    disabled={current === 0}
                >‹</button>

                <img
                    src={photos[current].image}
                    alt={photos[current].angle || 'inspection'}
                    style={{
                        maxWidth: 'min(80vw, 900px)', maxHeight: '70vh',
                        objectFit: 'contain', borderRadius: 12,
                    }}
                />

                <button
                    style={navBtnStyle(current === photos.length - 1)}
                    onClick={() => setCurrent(c => Math.min(c + 1, photos.length - 1))}
                    disabled={current === photos.length - 1}
                >›</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

=== PATH: D:\Work\car_rental_service\frontend\src\pages\CustomerDashboard\modals\KYCVerifyModal.jsx ===
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
    sendKYCPhoneOTP, verifyKYCPhoneOTP,
    sendKYCEmailOTP, verifyKYCEmailOTP,
} from '../../../services/api';

export default function KYCVerifyModal({ type, value, userEmail, onClose, onVerified, showToast }) {
    const [step, setStep]   = useState('idle'); // idle | sending | sent | verifying | done
    const [otp, setOtp]     = useState('');
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const isPhone = type === 'phone';
    const label   = isPhone ? 'Phone Number' : 'Email Address';

    const handleSend = async () => {
        setStep('sending'); setError('');
        try {
            if (isPhone) await sendKYCPhoneOTP(value, userEmail);
            else         await sendKYCEmailOTP(value);
            setStep('sent');
            showToast(`OTP sent to your ${label.toLowerCase()}.`);
        } catch (e) {
            setError(e.response?.data?.error || `Failed to send OTP.`);
            setStep('idle');
        }
    };

    const handleVerify = async () => {
        if (otp.length !== 6) { setError('Enter the 6-digit OTP.'); return; }
        setStep('verifying'); setError('');
        try {
            if (isPhone) await verifyKYCPhoneOTP(userEmail, otp);
            else         await verifyKYCEmailOTP(value, otp);
            setStep('done');
            showToast(`${label} verified successfully!`);
            setTimeout(() => onVerified(), 600);
        } catch (e) {
            setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Invalid OTP. Please try again.');
            setStep('sent');
        }
    };

    return (
        <div className="cd-modal-backdrop" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
            <div className="cd-modal" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="cd-modal__head">
                    <div>
                        <h3 className="cd-modal__title">Verify {label}</h3>
                        <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--cd-muted)', marginTop: 3 }}>
                            {isPhone ? `📱 ${value}` : `✉ ${value}`}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <button className="cd-modal__close" onClick={onClose}>&times;</button>
                </div>

                {/* Body */}
                <div className="cd-modal__body">
                    {step === 'done' ? (
                        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '24px 0' }}>
                            <div style={{
                                width: 56, height: 56, borderRadius: '50%',
                                background: '#D1FAE5', border: '2px solid #6EE7B7',
                                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                                margin: '0 auto 14px', fontSize: 24,
                            }}>✓</div>
                            <h3 style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#059669' }}>{label} Verified!</h3>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <>
                            {/* Dev hint */}
                            <div style={{
                                background: '#FEF3C7', border: '1px solid #FCD34D',
                                borderRadius: 8, padding: '9px 12px',
                                fontSize: 12, color: '#92400E',
                            }}>
                                <strong>Dev Mode:</strong> OTP is{' '}
                                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, letterSpacing: 2 }}>
                                    123456
                                </span>.
                            </div>

                            <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--cd-txt2)' }}>
                                We'll send a one-time code to your {label.toLowerCase()}.
                            </p>

                            {step === 'idle' && (
                                <button
                                    className="cd-btn cd-btn--primary"
                                    onClick={handleSend}
                                    style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
                                >
                                    Send OTP
                                </button>
                            )}

                            {step === 'sending' && (
                                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, color: 'var(--cd-muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>
                                    <div className="cd-spinner" /> Sending OTP…
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {step === 'sent' && (
                                <>
                                    <div>
                                        <label style={{
                                            fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase',
                                            letterSpacing: '0.5px', color: 'var(--cd-muted)',
                                            display: 'block', marginBottom: 7,
                                        }}>
                                            Enter 6-digit OTP
                                        </label>
                                        <input
                                            className="cd-input"
                                            style={{
                                                textAlign: 'center', letterSpacing: '8px',
                                                fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                            }}
                                            maxLength={6}
                                            placeholder="——————"
                                            value={otp}
                                            onChange={e => {
                                                setOtp(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6));
                                                setError('');
                                            }}
                                            autoFocus
                                        />
                                    </div>
                                    <button
                                        className="cd-btn cd-btn--primary"
                                        onClick={handleVerify}
                                        disabled={otp.length !== 6}
                                        style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
                                    >
                                        Verify OTP
                                    </button>
                                    <button
                                        className="cd-btn cd-btn--ghost"
                                        onClick={handleSend}
                                        style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 12 }}
                                    >
                                        Resend OTP
                                    </button>
                                </>
                            )}

                            {step === 'verifying' && (
                                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, color: 'var(--cd-muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>
                                    <div className="cd-spinner" /> Verifying…
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {error && (
                                <div style={{
                                    background: '#FEE2E2', border: '1px solid #FCA5A5',
                                    borderRadius: 8, padding: '8px 12px',
                                    fontSize: 12, color: '#B91C1C',
                                }}>
                                    {error}
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </>
                    )}
                </div>

                {step !== 'done' && (
                    <div className="cd-modal__foot">
                        <button className="cd-btn cd-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { dummyPayment } from '../../../services/api';

export default function PaymentModal({ booking, detail, onClose, onSuccess, showToast }) {
    const [method,  setMethod]  = useState('online');
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

    const pricing       = detail?.pricing_snapshot || {};
    const grandTotal    = parseFloat(pricing.grand_total || booking.total_amount || 0);
    const deposit       = parseFloat(pricing.security_deposit || detail?.deposit_amount || 0);
    const advancePct    = 30;
    const advanceAmt    = Math.round((grandTotal * advancePct) / 100);
    const remaining     = grandTotal - advanceAmt;
    const advancePaid   = pricing.advance_paid   || false;
    const remainingPaid = pricing.remaining_paid || false;
    const fullPaid      = pricing.full_payment_paid || (advancePaid && remainingPaid);
    const canPayRemaining = advancePaid && !remainingPaid && !fullPaid;
    const payableNow    = canPayRemaining ? remaining : advanceAmt;

    const handlePay = async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const pt = canPayRemaining ? 'remaining' : 'advance';
            const { data } = await dummyPayment(booking.id, { payment_type: pt, method });
            showToast(data.message || 'Payment successful!');
            onSuccess?.();
            onClose();
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Payment failed.', 'error');
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    // Already fully paid
    if (fullPaid || (advancePaid && remainingPaid)) {
        return (
            <div className="cd-modal-backdrop" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
                <div className="cd-modal">
                    <div className="cd-modal__head">
                        <h3 className="cd-modal__title">Payment</h3>
                        <button className="cd-modal__close" onClick={onClose}>&times;</button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="cd-modal__body" style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: '32px 24px' }}>
                        <div style={{
                            width: 56, height: 56, borderRadius: '50%',
                            background: '#D1FAE5', border: '2px solid #6EE7B7',
                            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                            margin: '0 auto 14px', fontSize: 24,
                        }}>✓</div>
                        <h3 style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Fully Paid</h3>
                        <p style={{ color: 'var(--cd-muted)', marginTop: 8 }}>
                            Grand Total ₹{grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')} — all payments received.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="cd-modal__foot">
                        <button className="cd-btn cd-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>Close</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <div className="cd-modal-backdrop" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
            <div className="cd-modal">
                <div className="cd-modal__head">
                    <h3 className="cd-modal__title">Payment</h3>
                    <button className="cd-modal__close" onClick={onClose}>&times;</button>
                </div>

                <div className="cd-modal__body">
                    {/* Breakdown */}
                    <div className="cd-payment-breakdown">
                        <div className="cd-payment-breakdown__row">
                            <span>Grand Total</span>
                            <strong>₹{grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</strong>
                        </div>
                        <div className="cd-payment-breakdown__row">
                            <span>Security Deposit</span>
                            <span className="cd-muted-val">₹{deposit.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="cd-payment-breakdown__divider" />
                        <div
                            className="cd-payment-breakdown__row"
                            style={advancePaid ? { opacity: 0.5 } : {}}
                        >
                            <span>Advance ({advancePct}%)</span>
                            <strong style={advancePaid ? { color: '#059669' } : {}}>
                                {advancePaid ? 'Paid' : `₹${advanceAmt.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`}
                            </strong>
                        </div>
                        <div
                            className="cd-payment-breakdown__row"
                            style={remainingPaid ? { opacity: 0.5 } : {}}
                        >
                            <span>Remaining (70%)</span>
                            <strong style={remainingPaid ? { color: '#059669' } : {}}>
                                {remainingPaid ? 'Paid' : `₹${remaining.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`}
                            </strong>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Payment method */}
                    <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
                        <p style={{
                            fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
                            color: 'var(--cd-muted)', textTransform: 'uppercase',
                            letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 8,
                        }}>
                            Payment Method
                        </p>
                        <div className="cd-payment-modes">
                            {[
                                ['online', 'Online Payment', 'UPI, Cards, Net Banking'],
                                ['cash',   'Cash',           'Pay at vendor location'],
                            ].map(([val, label, sub]) => (

                        onClick={handlePay}

                        {loading ? 'Processing…' : `Pay ₹${payableNow.toLocaleString('en-IN')} Now`}

    );

}

import { submitReview } from '../../../services/api';
import { StarRating } from '../cdShared';

export default function WriteReviewModal({ booking, onClose, onSubmitted, showToast }) {
    const [vendorRating,  setVendorRating]  = useState(0);
    const [vehicleRating, setVehicleRating] = useState(0);
    const [comment,       setComment]       = useState('');
    const [submitting,    setSubmitting]    = useState(false);

    const handleSubmit = async () => {
        if (!vendorRating) { showToast('Please select a vendor rating.', 'error'); return; }
        setSubmitting(true);
        try {
            await submitReview({
                booking_id:     booking.booking_id,
                vendor_rating:  vendorRating,
                vehicle_rating: vehicleRating || vendorRating,
                review_text:    comment,
            });
            showToast('Review submitted. Thank you!');
            onSubmitted(booking.booking_id);
            onClose();
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to submit review.', 'error');
        } finally {
            setSubmitting(false);
        }
    };

    return (
        <div className="cd-modal-backdrop" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
            <div className="cd-modal" style={{ maxWidth: 500 }} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="cd-modal__head">
                    <div>
                        <h3 className="cd-modal__title">Write a Review</h3>
                        <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--cd-muted)', marginTop: 3 }}>
                            {booking.vehicle_display} · {booking.booking_ref}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <button className="cd-modal__close" onClick={onClose}>&times;</button>
                </div>

                {/* Body */}
                <div className="cd-modal__body">
                    <div>
                        <p className="cd-review-label">Vendor Rating *</p>
                        <StarRating value={vendorRating} onChange={setVendorRating} />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <p className="cd-review-label">Vehicle Rating</p>
                        <StarRating value={vehicleRating} onChange={setVehicleRating} />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label style={{
                            fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
                            textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px',
                            color: 'var(--cd-muted)', display: 'block', marginBottom: 6,
                        }}>
                            Your Experience (optional)
                        </label>
                        <textarea
                            className="cd-input cd-textarea"
                            placeholder="Share your experience…"
                            value={comment}
                            onChange={e => setComment(e.target.value)}
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Footer */}
                <div className="cd-modal__foot">
                    <button className="cd-btn cd-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
                    <button
                        className="cd-btn cd-btn--primary"
                        onClick={handleSubmit}
                        disabled={submitting || !vendorRating}
                    >
                        {submitting ? 'Submitting…' : 'Submit Review'}
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import DataTable from '../../../components/common/DataTable';
import { StatusBadge } from '../cdShared';
