// ── Mobile-only booking card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobileBookingCard({ booking, onViewBooking }) {
    const vehicle =
        booking.vehicle_display ||
        `${booking.vehicle?.make || ''} ${booking.vehicle?.model || ''}`.trim() ||
        '—';
    const plate = booking.vehicle?.plate_number || '';

    return (
        <button
            className="cd-mob-booking-card"
            onClick={() => onViewBooking(booking)}
            aria-label={`View booking ${booking.booking_ref}`}
        >
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--head">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__ref">{booking.booking_ref}</span>
                <StatusBadge status={booking.status} />
            </div>

            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__vehicle">{vehicle}</span>
                {plate && (
                    <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__plate">{plate}</span>
                )}
            </div>

            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--footer">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__dates">
                    {booking.pickup_date || '—'}
                    {' → '}
                    {booking.return_date || '—'}
                    {booking.rental_days ? ` · ${booking.rental_days}d` : ''}
                </span>
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__chevron" aria-hidden="true">›</span>
            </div>
        </button>
    );
}

// ── Mobile filter / search bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
    { value: '',          label: 'All'       },
    { value: 'PENDING',   label: 'Pending'   },
    { value: 'CONFIRMED', label: 'Confirmed' },
    { value: 'ACTIVE',    label: 'Active'    },
    { value: 'COMPLETED', label: 'Completed' },
    { value: 'CANCELLED', label: 'Cancelled' },
];

function MobileBookingList({ bookings, onViewBooking }) {
    const [search,       setSearch]       = useState('');
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = bookings;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter(
                b =>
                    (b.booking_ref || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (b.vehicle_display || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (b.vehicle?.make || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (b.vehicle?.model || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
            );
        }
        if (statusFilter) {
            result = result.filter(b => b.status === statusFilter);
        }
        return result;
    }, [bookings, search, statusFilter]);

    return (
        <div className="cd-mob-bookings">
            {/* Search */}
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__search-wrap">
                <svg className="cd-mob-bookings__search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <input
                    className="cd-mob-bookings__search"
                    type="search"
                    placeholder="Search bookings…"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    aria-label="Search bookings"
                />
            </div>

            {/* Status pills */}
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__pills" role="group" aria-label="Filter by status">
                {STATUS_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
                    <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        className={`cd-mob-bookings__pill${statusFilter === opt.value ? ' cd-mob-bookings__pill--active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => setStatusFilter(opt.value)}
                    >
                        {opt.label}
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>

            {/* Result count */}
            {(search || statusFilter) && (
                <p className="cd-mob-bookings__count">
                    {filtered.length} of {bookings.length} booking{bookings.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </p>
            )}

            {/* Cards */}
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="cd-empty" style={{ padding: '40px 24px' }}>
                    <span className="cd-empty__icon">📅</span>
                    <p>No bookings match your search.</p>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="cd-mob-bookings__list">
                    {filtered.map((b, i) => (
                        <MobileBookingCard
                            key={b.id ?? i}
                            booking={b}
                            onViewBooking={onViewBooking}
                        />
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { redeemLoyalty } from '../../../services/api';

export default function LoyaltyTab({ loyalty, onLoyaltyUpdate, showToast }) {
    const [redeemPoints, setRedeemPoints] = useState('');
    const [redeemLoading, setRedeemLoading] = useState(false);

    if (!loyalty) return null;

    const tier = loyalty.loyalty_points >= 1000
        ? 'Gold Member'
        : loyalty.loyalty_points >= 500
            ? 'Silver Member'
            : 'Bronze Member';

    const totalValue = loyalty.total_value_inr
        || loyalty.loyalty_points * parseFloat(loyalty.point_value_inr || 0.5);

    const handleRedeem = async e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const pts = parseInt(redeemPoints);
        if (!pts || pts <= 0) { showToast('Enter valid points.', 'error'); return; }
        setRedeemLoading(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await redeemLoyalty(pts);
            onLoyaltyUpdate(
                data.new_balance ?? loyalty.loyalty_points - pts,
            );
            setRedeemPoints('');
            showToast(`Redeemed ${pts} pts — ₹${data.discount_inr} discount!`);
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Redemption failed.', 'error');
        } finally {
            setRedeemLoading(false);
        }
    };

    return (
        <div className="cd-section">
            <div className="cd-loyalty-layout">

                {/* Points card */}
                <div className="cd-loyalty-card">
                    <div className="cd-loyalty-card__bg" />
                    <div className="cd-loyalty-card__top">
                        <span className="cd-loyalty-card__star">&#9733;</span>
                        <span className="cd-loyalty-card__brand">DriveLux Rewards</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="cd-loyalty-card__pts">{loyalty.loyalty_points}</div>
                    <div className="cd-loyalty-card__label">Points</div>
                    <div className="cd-loyalty-card__worth">
                        Worth <strong>₹{totalValue}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="cd-loyalty-card__tier">{tier}</div>
                </div>

                {/* Right panel */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>

                    {/* Redeem card */}
                    <div className="cd-card">
                        <h3 className="cd-card__title">Redeem Points</h3>
                        <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--cd-muted)', marginBottom: 14 }}>
                            1 point = ₹{loyalty.point_value_inr || '0.50'}
                        </p>
                        <form
                            onSubmit={handleRedeem}
                            style={{
                                display: 'flex', gap: 10,
                                flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'flex-end',
                            }}
                        >
                            <div>
                                <label style={{
                                    fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700,
                                    textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px',
                                    color: 'var(--cd-muted)', display: 'block', marginBottom: 5,
                                }}>
                                    Points to Redeem
                                </label>
                                <input
                                    className="cd-input"
                                    type="number"
                                    style={{ width: 160 }}
                                    placeholder={`Max ${loyalty.loyalty_points}`}
                                    value={redeemPoints}
                                    onChange={e => setRedeemPoints(e.target.value)}
                                    min={1}
                                    max={loyalty.loyalty_points}
                                />
                            </div>
                            <button
                                type="submit"
                                className="cd-btn cd-btn--primary"
                                disabled={redeemLoading || !redeemPoints}
                            >
                                {redeemLoading ? 'Redeeming…' : 'Redeem Now'}
                            </button>
                        </form>
                    </div>

                    {/* How it works info card */}
                    <div className="cd-card">
                        <h3 className="cd-card__title">How It Works</h3>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, marginTop: 4 }}>
                            {[
                                ['🚗', 'Earn points on every completed rental'],
                                ['⭐', 'Write reviews to earn bonus points'],
                                ['💰', 'Redeem points for discounts on future bookings'],
                                ['🏆', 'Unlock Gold tier at 1000 points for extra perks'],
                            ].map(([icon, text]) => (
                                <div key={text} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'flex-start', fontSize: 13 }}>
                                    <span style={{ fontSize: 16, flexShrink: 0 }}>{icon}</span>
                                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--cd-txt2)', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{text}</span>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import DataTable from '../../../components/common/DataTable';
import { fmtDate } from '../cdConstants';

function Stars({ value, size = 14 }) {
    return (
        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 1 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(n => (
                <span
                    key={n}
                    style={{ fontSize: size, color: n <= (value || 0) ? '#E8A020' : '#E5E7EB', lineHeight: 1 }}
                >
                    ★
                </span>
            ))}
        </span>
    );
}

// ── Mobile card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

                        {opt.label}

                ))}

            {(search || ratingFilter) && (

import React, { useState } from 'react';

// ── Reusable field components ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function InfoRow({ label, value }) {
    return (
        <div className="cd-info-row cd-info-row--bordered">
            <span className="cd-info-row__lbl">{label}</span>
            <strong className="cd-info-row__val">{value || '—'}</strong>
        </div>
    );
}

function FormField({ label, children }) {
    return (
        <div className="cd-form-field">
            <label>{label}</label>
            {children}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── KYC verify row (phone or email) ───────────────────────────────────────

function VerifyRow({ icon, label, value, isVerified, onVerify }) {
    return (
        <div className="cd-kyc-verify-row">
            <div className="cd-kyc-verify-row__left">
                <div className="cd-kyc-verify-row__icon">{icon}</div>
                <div>
                    <div className="cd-kyc-verify-row__label">{label}</div>
                    <div className="cd-kyc-verify-row__value">{value || '—'}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div className="cd-kyc-verify-row__right">
                {isVerified ? (
                    <span className="cd-kyc-verify-badge cd-kyc-verify-badge--verified">✓ Verified</span>
                ) : value ? (
                    <button className="cd-btn cd-btn--primary cd-btn--sm" onClick={onVerify}>
                        Verify {label.split(' ')[0]}
                    </button>
                ) : (
                    <span className="cd-kyc-verify-badge cd-kyc-verify-badge--missing">
                        No {label.toLowerCase()} on file
                    </span>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

export default function ProfileTab({
    profile, user,
    onProfileSaved,
    onOpenKYCModal,
    showToast,
}) {
    const [editing, setEditing]   = useState(false);
    const [saving,  setSaving]    = useState(false);
    const [form,    setForm]      = useState({
        full_name:        profile?.full_name        || '',
        phone:            profile?.phone            || '',
        driving_licence:  profile?.driving_licence  || '',
        dl_expiry:        profile?.dl_expiry        || '',
        date_of_birth:    profile?.date_of_birth    || '',
        aadhaar_number:   profile?.aadhaar_number   || '',
        pan_number:       profile?.pan_number       || '',
    });

    const s = k => e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.value }));

    const handleSave = async () => {
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            await updateCustomerProfile(form);
            onProfileSaved(form);
            setEditing(false);
            showToast('Profile updated.');
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(
                e.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(e.response.data) : 'Save failed.',
                'error',
            );
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    };

    const kycStatusClass = profile?.kyc_status === 'verified'
        ? 'cd-kyc-status--verified'
        : profile?.kyc_status === 'rejected'
            ? 'cd-kyc-status--rejected'
            : 'cd-kyc-status--pending';

    const kycStatusText = profile?.kyc_status === 'verified'
        ? '✓ Fully Verified'
        : profile?.kyc_status === 'rejected'
            ? '✕ Rejected — Contact Support'
            : '⏳ Pending Verification';

    return (
        <div className="cd-section">
            <div className="cd-profile-layout">

                {/* Personal information card */}
                <div className="cd-card">
                    <div className="cd-card__head">
                        <div><h3 className="cd-card__title">Personal Information</h3></div>
                        <button
                            className="cd-btn cd-btn--outline cd-btn--sm"
                            onClick={() => setEditing(!editing)}
                        >
                            {editing ? 'Cancel' : 'Edit'}
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    {editing ? (
                        <div className="cd-profile-form">
                            {[
                                ['full_name',       'Full Name',            'text'],
                                ['phone',           'Phone Number',         'tel'],
                                ['date_of_birth',   'Date of Birth',        'date'],
                                ['driving_licence', 'Driving Licence No.',  'text'],
                                ['dl_expiry',       'DL Expiry Date',       'date'],
                                ['aadhaar_number',  'Aadhaar Number',       'text'],
                                ['pan_number',      'PAN Number',           'text'],
                            ].map(([key, label, type]) => (
                                <FormField key={key} label={label}>
                                    <input
                                        className="cd-input"
                                        type={type}
                                        value={form[key] || ''}
                                        onChange={s(key)}
                                    />
                                </FormField>
                            ))}
                            <button
                                className="cd-btn cd-btn--primary"
                                onClick={handleSave}
                                disabled={saving}
                            >
                                {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save Changes'}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="cd-profile-rows">
                            <InfoRow label="Name"            value={profile?.full_name} />
                            <InfoRow label="Email"           value={profile?.email} />
                            <InfoRow label="Phone"           value={profile?.phone} />
                            <InfoRow label="Date of Birth"   value={profile?.date_of_birth} />
                            <InfoRow label="Driving Licence" value={profile?.driving_licence} />
                            <InfoRow label="DL Expiry"       value={profile?.dl_expiry} />
                            <InfoRow
                                label="Aadhaar"
                                value={profile?.aadhaar_number
                                    ? '••••' + profile.aadhaar_number.slice(-4)
                                    : '—'}
                            />
                            <InfoRow label="PAN"             value={profile?.pan_number} />
                            <div className="cd-info-row cd-info-row--bordered">
                                <span className="cd-info-row__lbl">KYC Status</span>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import DataTable from '../../../components/common/DataTable';

// ── Mobile card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobilePendingCard({ review, onWriteReview }) {
    return (
        <button
            className="cd-mob-booking-card"
            onClick={() => onWriteReview(review)}
            aria-label={`Write review for ${review.booking_ref}`}
        >
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--head">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__ref">{review.booking_ref}</span>
                <span className="cd-mob-review-write-badge">Write ★</span>
            </div>
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__vehicle">
                    {review.vehicle_display || '—'}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--footer">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__dates">
                    {review.vendor_name
                        ? `${review.vendor_name}${review.return_date ? ' · Returned ' + review.return_date : ''}`
                        : review.return_date
                            ? `Returned ${review.return_date}`
                            : '—'}
                </span>
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__chevron" aria-hidden="true">›</span>
            </div>
        </button>
    );
}

// ── Mobile list ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobilePendingList({ pendingReviews, onWriteReview }) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        if (!search.trim()) return pendingReviews;
        const q = search.toLowerCase();
        return pendingReviews.filter(
            r =>
                (r.booking_ref      || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (r.vehicle_display  || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (r.vendor_name      || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
        );
    }, [pendingReviews, search]);

    return (
        <div className="cd-mob-bookings">
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__search-wrap">
                <svg className="cd-mob-bookings__search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <input
                    className="cd-mob-bookings__search"
                    type="search"
                    placeholder="Search pending reviews…"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    aria-label="Search pending reviews"
                />
            </div>

            {search && (
                <p className="cd-mob-bookings__count">
                    {filtered.length} of {pendingReviews.length} pending
                </p>
            )}

            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="cd-empty" style={{ padding: '40px 24px' }}>
                    <span className="cd-empty__icon">⭐</span>
                    <p>No reviews match your search.</p>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="cd-mob-bookings__list">
                    {filtered.map((r, i) => (
                        <MobilePendingCard
                            key={r.booking_id ?? i}
                            review={r}
                            onWriteReview={onWriteReview}
                        />
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// BookingDetailPanel.jsx
// Full booking detail: customer info, trip details, payment status,
// pricing breakdown, inspections, damage claim, cancel.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { StatusBadge, InfoRow, Field, FormInput } from './VendorShared';
import InspectionPanel from './InspectionPanel';
import { dummyPayment, cancelBooking, raiseDamageClaim } from '../../services/api';

export default function BookingDetailPanel({ booking, onClose, onRefresh, showToast }) {
    const pricing    = booking.pricing_snapshot || {};
    const grandTotal = parseFloat(pricing.grand_total || booking.total_amount || 0);
    const advancePct = 30;
    const advanceAmt = Math.round(grandTotal * advancePct / 100);
    const remaining  = grandTotal - advanceAmt;

    const advancePaid    = pricing.advance_paid    || booking.payment_captured || false;
    const remainingPaid  = pricing.remaining_paid  || false;
    const fullPaid       = pricing.full_payment_paid || (advancePaid && remainingPaid);
    const deposit        = parseFloat(pricing.security_deposit || booking.deposit_amount || 0);

    const customer     = booking.customer     || {};
    const customerName  = customer.full_name  || booking.customer_name  || '—';
    const customerEmail = customer.email      || booking.customer_email || '—';
    const customerPhone = customer.phone      || booking.customer_phone || '—';

    const pickupInsp       = (booking.inspections || []).find(i => i.inspection_type === 'PICKUP');
    const returnInsp       = (booking.inspections || []).find(i => i.inspection_type === 'RETURN');
    const canCreateReturn  = ['ACTIVE'].includes(booking.status);
    const canCancel        = ['PENDING', 'CONFIRMED'].includes(booking.status);
    const canPayRemaining  = advancePaid && !remainingPaid && !fullPaid && ['CONFIRMED', 'ACTIVE'].includes(booking.status);

    const [showPayForm,    setShowPayForm]    = useState(false);
    const [payMethod,      setPayMethod]      = useState('cash');
    const [payLoading,     setPayLoading]     = useState(false);
    const [cancelConfirm,  setCancelConfirm]  = useState(false);
    const [cancelReason,   setCancelReason]   = useState('');
    const [cancelLoading,  setCancelLoading]  = useState(false);
    const [damageForm,     setDamageForm]     = useState({ notes: '', amount: '' });
    const [damageLoading,  setDamageLoading]  = useState(false);

    const handleRecordPayment = async () => {
        setPayLoading(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await dummyPayment(booking.id, { payment_type: 'remaining', method: payMethod });
            showToast(data.message || 'Payment recorded.');
            setShowPayForm(false);
            onRefresh();
        } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Could not record payment.', 'error'); }
        setPayLoading(false);
    };

    const handleCancel = async () => {
        setCancelLoading(true);
        try {
            await cancelBooking(booking.id, cancelReason || 'Vendor cancelled');
            showToast('Booking cancelled.');
            setCancelConfirm(false);
            onRefresh();
        } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Could not cancel.', 'error'); }
        setCancelLoading(false);
    };

    const handleDamageClaim = async () => {
        if (!damageForm.amount) { showToast('Enter claim amount.', 'error'); return; }
        setDamageLoading(true);
        try {
            await raiseDamageClaim(booking.id, damageForm);
            showToast('Damage claim raised.');
            setDamageForm({ notes: '', amount: '' });
        } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed.', 'error'); }
        setDamageLoading(false);
    };

    return (
        <div className="vd-detail-panel">
            {/* Head */}
            <div className="vd-detail-panel__head">
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 14, flex: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    <div style={{ background: 'var(--vs2)', border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)', borderRadius: 10, width: 44, height: 44, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--vt2)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        CAR
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16 }}>{booking.vehicle_display || 'Vehicle'}</h3>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 6 }}>
                            <StatusBadge status={booking.status} />
                            {booking.payment_captured && <span className="vd-flag vd-flag--ok">Payment Captured</span>}
                            {booking.agreement_signed && <span className="vd-flag vd-flag--ok">Agreement Signed</span>}
                            {booking.deposit_held     && <span className="vd-flag vd-flag--warn">Deposit Held</span>}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 3, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700 }}>₹{parseFloat(booking.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--vm)' }}>{booking.booking_ref}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button className="vd-close-btn" onClick={onClose}>← Back to List</button>
            </div>

            {/* Info grid */}
            <div className="vd-detail-panel__grid">
                {/* Customer */}
                <div className="vd-info-group">
                    <div className="vd-info-group__title">Customer</div>
                    <InfoRow label="Name"  value={customerName}  />
                    <InfoRow label="Email" value={customerEmail} />
                    <InfoRow label="Phone" value={customerPhone} />
                </div>

                {/* Trip */}
                <div className="vd-info-group">
                    <div className="vd-info-group__title">Trip Details</div>
                    <InfoRow label="Pickup"   value={`${booking.pickup_date}${booking.pickup_time ? ' @ ' + booking.pickup_time : ''}`} />
                    <InfoRow label="Return"   value={`${booking.return_date}${booking.return_time ? ' @ ' + booking.return_time : ''}`} />
                    <InfoRow label="Duration" value={`${booking.rental_days} day(s)`} />
                </div>

                {/* Payment status */}
                <div className="vd-info-group">
                    <div className="vd-info-group__title">Payment Status</div>
                    <InfoRow label="Grand Total"        value={`₹${grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`} highlight />
                    <InfoRow label={`Advance (${advancePct}%)`} value={advancePaid ? `Paid — ₹${advanceAmt.toLocaleString('en-IN')}` : `Due — ₹${advanceAmt.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`} />
                    <InfoRow label="Remaining (70%)"    value={(fullPaid || remainingPaid) ? `Paid — ₹${remaining.toLocaleString('en-IN')}` : `Due — ₹${remaining.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`} />
                    <InfoRow label="Security Deposit"   value={`₹${deposit.toLocaleString('en-IN')} (${booking.deposit_released ? 'Released' : booking.deposit_held ? 'Held' : 'Pending'})`} />

                    {canPayRemaining && !showPayForm && (
                        <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--outline vd-btn--sm" style={{ marginTop: 8 }} onClick={() => setShowPayForm(true)}>
                            Record Remaining Payment
                        </button>
                    )}
                    {showPayForm && (
                        <div style={{ background: '#F0FDF4', border: '1px solid #6EE7B7', borderRadius: 10, padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, marginTop: 8 }}>
                            <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Record ₹{remaining.toLocaleString('en-IN')} received</strong>
                            <Field label="Payment Method">
                                <select className="vd-input vd-select" value={payMethod} onChange={e => setPayMethod(e.target.value)}>
                                    <option value="cash">Cash</option>
                                    <option value="upi">UPI</option>
                                    <option value="online">Online</option>
                                </select>
                            </Field>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                                <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--success vd-btn--sm" onClick={handleRecordPayment} disabled={payLoading}>
                                    {payLoading ? 'Recording…' : 'Confirm Received'}
                                </button>
                                <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--ghost vd-btn--sm" onClick={() => setShowPayForm(false)}>Cancel</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {/* Pricing breakdown */}
                <div className="vd-info-group">
                    <div className="vd-info-group__title">Pricing Breakdown</div>
                    <InfoRow label="Daily Rate"   value={`₹${parseFloat(pricing.daily_rate  || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}/day`} />
                    <InfoRow label="Base Rental"  value={`₹${parseFloat(pricing.base_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`} />
                    <InfoRow label="GST (18%)"    value={`₹${parseFloat(pricing.gst_amount  || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`} />
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Inspections */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.6px', color: 'var(--vm)' }}>Inspections</div>
                <div className="vd-inspection-grid">
                    <InspectionPanel
                        key={`pickup-${pickupInsp?.id}-${pickupInsp?.is_locked}`}
                        bookingId={booking.id}
                        inspectionType="PICKUP"
                        existingInspection={pickupInsp}
                        canCreate={false}
                        showToast={showToast}
                        onRefresh={onRefresh}
                    />
                    <InspectionPanel
                        key={`return-${returnInsp?.id}-${returnInsp?.is_locked}`}
                        bookingId={booking.id}
                        inspectionType="RETURN"

                        canCreate={canCreateReturn}
                        showToast={showToast}
                        onRefresh={onRefresh}
                    />

            {/* Actions */}
            <div className="vd-booking-actions">
                {booking.status === 'COMPLETED' && (
                    <div className="vd-action-block">
                        <p className="vd-action-label">Raise Damage Claim</p>
                        <div className="vd-fg vd-fg--2">
                            <Field label="Notes">
                                <textarea className="vd-input vd-textarea" value={damageForm.notes} onChange={e => setDamageForm(p => ({ ...p, notes: e.target.value }))} />
                            </Field>
                            <FormInput label="Amount (₹)" type="number" value={damageForm.amount} onChange={e => setDamageForm(p => ({ ...p, amount: e.target.value }))} />
                        </div>
                        <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--danger vd-btn--sm" onClick={handleDamageClaim} disabled={damageLoading}>
                            {damageLoading ? '…' : 'Raise Claim'}
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}
                {canCancel && !cancelConfirm && (
                    <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--danger-outline vd-btn--sm" style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }} onClick={() => setCancelConfirm(true)}>
                        Cancel Booking
                    </button>
                )}
                {cancelConfirm && (
                    <div className="vd-cancel-confirm" style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                        <input className="vd-input" placeholder="Reason (optional)" value={cancelReason} onChange={e => setCancelReason(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 200 }} />
                        <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--danger vd-btn--sm" onClick={handleCancel} disabled={cancelLoading}>
                            {cancelLoading ? 'Cancelling…' : 'Yes, Cancel'}
                        </button>
                        <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--ghost vd-btn--sm" onClick={() => setCancelConfirm(false)}>Keep It</button>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// InspectionPanel.jsx
// Handles all inspection states:
//   • Locked (completed) — read-only accordion
//   • Pickup awaiting customer OTP — generate OTP button
//   • Return awaiting customer OTP — enter OTP to verify
//   • Return form ready to fill — odometer / fuel / damage
//   • Not applicable — placeholder message
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { PhotoLightbox } from './VendorMediaComponents';
import { Field, FormInput, FormSelect } from './VendorShared';
import { createInspection, signInspection } from '../../services/api';

export default function InspectionPanel({
    bookingId,
    inspectionType,
    existingInspection,
    canCreate,
    showToast,
    onRefresh,
}) {
    const isPickup = inspectionType === 'PICKUP';
    const label    = isPickup ? 'Pickup' : 'Drop-off';

    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        odometer_reading: '', fuel_level: 'full', notes: '',
        damage_reported: false, damage_notes: '', damage_amount: '',
    });
    const [saving,            setSaving]            = useState(false);
    const [otpSent,           setOtpSent]           = useState(false);
    const [otpCode,           setOtpCode]           = useState('');
    const [otpBusy,           setOtpBusy]           = useState(false);
    const [expanded,          setExpanded]          = useState(false);
    const [vendorOtpDisplay,  setVendorOtpDisplay]  = useState(null);
    const [lightboxIndex,     setLightboxIndex]     = useState(null);

    // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const labelDot = (bg, color, text) => (
        <span style={{ width: 24, height: 24, borderRadius: 6, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, background: bg, color }}>{text}</span>
    );

    const AccordionHeader = ({ bg, borderColor, children }) => (
        <div
            style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '10px 14px', cursor: 'pointer', background: bg, borderBottom: expanded ? `1px solid ${borderColor}` : 'none' }}
            onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
        >
            {children}
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--vm)' }}>{expanded ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
        </div>
    );

    // ── 1. Locked inspection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (existingInspection?.is_locked) {
        const photos   = existingInspection.photos || [];
        const infoRows = [
            ['Odometer',        `${existingInspection.odometer_reading} km`],
            ['Fuel Level',       existingInspection.fuel_level],
            ['Customer Signed',  existingInspection.customer_signed ? 'Yes' : 'Pending'],
            ['Vendor Signed',    existingInspection.vendor_signed   ? 'Yes' : 'Pending'],
            ...(existingInspection.notes ? [['Notes', existingInspection.notes]] : []),
        ];
        return (
            <div style={{ border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)', borderRadius: 10, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                {lightboxIndex !== null && photos.length > 0 && (
                    <PhotoLightbox photos={photos} initialIndex={lightboxIndex} onClose={() => setLightboxIndex(null)} />
                )}
                <AccordionHeader bg={isPickup ? '#EFF6FF' : '#F0FDF4'} borderColor="var(--vbdr)">
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        {labelDot(isPickup ? '#DBEAFE' : '#D1FAE5', isPickup ? '#1D4ED8' : '#059669', isPickup ? 'P' : 'D')}
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{label} Inspection</strong>
                        <span style={{ background: '#D1FAE5', color: '#059669', border: '1px solid #6EE7B7', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999 }}>Locked</span>
                    </div>
                </AccordionHeader>
                {expanded && (
                    <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                        {infoRows.map(([l, v]) => (
                            <div key={l} className="vd-info-pair" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}><span>{l}</span><strong>{v}</strong></div>
                        ))}
                        {photos.length > 0 && (
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 6 }}>
                                {photos.map((ph, idx) => (
                                    <div key={ph.id} onClick={() => setLightboxIndex(idx)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 6, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                                        <img src={ph.image} alt="insp" style={{ width: 70, height: 54, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)', display: 'block' }} />
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }

    // ── 2. Pickup — awaiting customer OTP ─────────────────────────────────────
    if (isPickup && existingInspection && !existingInspection.is_locked) {
        const photos = existingInspection.photos || [];

        const handleGenerateOtp = async () => {
            setOtpBusy(true);
            try {
                const { data } = await signInspection(bookingId, 'pickup', 'generate', null);
                setVendorOtpDisplay(data.otp_code);
                setOtpSent(true);
                showToast('OTP generated! Share with the customer.', 'success');
            } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed.', 'error'); }
            setOtpBusy(false);
        };

        return (
            <div style={{ border: '1px solid #FCD34D', borderRadius: 10, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                {lightboxIndex !== null && photos.length > 0 && (
                    <PhotoLightbox photos={photos} initialIndex={lightboxIndex} onClose={() => setLightboxIndex(null)} />
                )}
                <AccordionHeader bg="#FFFBEB" borderColor="#FCD34D">
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        {labelDot('#DBEAFE', '#1D4ED8', 'P')}
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Pickup Inspection</strong>
                        <span style={{ background: '#FEF3C7', color: '#D97706', border: '1px solid #FCD34D', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999 }}>Customer Awaiting OTP</span>
                    </div>
                </AccordionHeader>
                {expanded && (
                    <div style={{ padding: '14px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
                        <div style={{ background: '#F8FAFB', border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap', fontSize: 13 }}>
                                <span>Odometer: <strong>{existingInspection.odometer_reading} km</strong></span>
                                <span>Fuel: <strong>{existingInspection.fuel_level}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {photos.length > 0 && (
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                                {photos.map((ph, idx) => (
                                    <div key={ph.id} onClick={() => setLightboxIndex(idx)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 6, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                                        <img src={ph.image} alt="insp" style={{ width: 80, height: 60, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)', display: 'block' }} />
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                        {!otpSent ? (
                            <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--primary" onClick={handleGenerateOtp} disabled={otpBusy}>
                                {otpBusy ? 'Generating…' : 'Generate OTP for Customer'}
                            </button>
                        ) : (
                            <div style={{ background: '#D1FAE5', border: '1px solid #6EE7B7', borderRadius: 10, padding: '16px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                                <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#059669', marginBottom: 10, fontWeight: 600 }}>Share this OTP with the customer:</p>
                                <div style={{ fontSize: 36, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: 10, fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#059669' }}>{vendorOtpDisplay}</div>
                                <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--ghost vd-btn--sm" style={{ marginTop: 10 }} onClick={handleGenerateOtp} disabled={otpBusy}>Generate New OTP</button>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }

    // ── 3. Return — awaiting customer OTP ─────────────────────────────────────
    if (!isPickup && existingInspection && !existingInspection.is_locked) {
        const photos = existingInspection.photos || [];

        const handleVerifyOtp = async () => {
            if (otpCode.length !== 6) { showToast('Enter 6-digit OTP.', 'error'); return; }
            setOtpBusy(true);
            try {
                const { data } = await signInspection(bookingId, 'return', 'verify', otpCode);
                showToast(data.message || 'Drop-off signed!');

            setOtpBusy(false);
        };

        return (

                    <PhotoLightbox photos={photos} initialIndex={lightboxIndex} onClose={() => setLightboxIndex(null)} />
                )}
                <AccordionHeader bg="#FFFBEB" borderColor="#FCD34D">
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        {labelDot('#D1FAE5', '#059669', 'D')}
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Drop-off Inspection</strong>
                        <span style={{ background: '#FEF3C7', color: '#D97706', border: '1px solid #FCD34D', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999 }}>Awaiting Customer OTP</span>
                    </div>

                                )}

                                {photos.map((ph, idx) => (

                                        <img src={ph.image} alt="insp" style={{ width: 80, height: 60, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)', display: 'block' }} />
                                    </div>
                                ))}

                        <div>

    const handleSave = async () => {

            fd.append('fuel_level',       form.fuel_level);

                </div>

                        <FormSelect label="Fuel Level" value={form.fuel_level} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, fuel_level: e.target.value }))} options={['empty', 'quarter', 'half', 'three_quarter', 'full']} />
                    </div>
                    <Field label="Notes (optional)">
                        <textarea className="vd-input vd-textarea" value={form.notes} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, notes: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Any observations…" />
                    </Field>
                    <div style={{ background: '#FFF7F7', border: '1px solid #FECACA', borderRadius: 8, padding: 12 }}>
                        <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            <input type="checkbox" checked={form.damage_reported} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, damage_reported: e.target.checked }))} />
                            <span style={{ color: form.damage_reported ? '#EF4444' : 'inherit' }}>Damage Reported</span>
                        </label>
                        {form.damage_reported && (
                            <div className="vd-fg vd-fg--2" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                                <Field label="Damage Notes">
                                    <textarea className="vd-input vd-textarea" value={form.damage_notes} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, damage_notes: e.target.value }))} />
                                </Field>
                                <FormInput label="Damage Amount (₹)" type="number" value={form.damage_amount} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, damage_amount: e.target.value }))} />
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <button className="vd-btn vd-btn--primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
                        {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Submit Drop-off Inspection'}
                    </button>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export function isKYCComplete(profile) {
    if (!profile) return false;
    return !!(profile.bank_account_no && profile.city_id && profile.latitude && profile.longitude);
}

export const fmtDate = (d) => {
    if (!d) return '—';
    return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
};

export const fmtDatetime = (d) => {
    if (!d) return '—';
    return new Date(d).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { Sidebar }  from '../../components/common/Navbar';
import Navbar        from '../../components/common/Navbar';
import DataTable     from '../../components/common/DataTable';
import NotificationsPanel from '../../components/notifications/NotificationsPanel';
import '../../components/common/DataTable.css';

// ── API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import {
    getVendorBookings, getVendorProfile, updateVendorProfile, uploadVendorKYC,
    getVendorAnalytics, getMyVehicles, createVehicle, updateVehicle,
    toggleVehicleStatus, blockAvailability, unblockAvailability, getVehicleAvailability,
    getVendorNetwork, joinNetwork, leaveNetwork, getCities, getCityLocations,
    getMyHandovers, getVendorBookingDetail, fetchVendorReviews,
} from '../../services/api';

// ── Sub-components ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import { Toast, KYCGateBanner }    from './VendorShared';
import BookingDetailPanel          from './BookingDetailPanel';
import VehicleManageModal          from './modals/VehicleManageModal';
import HandoverDetailModal         from './modals/HandoverDetailModal';
import ReviewDetailModal           from './modals/ReviewDetailModal';

// ── Tabs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import OverviewTab  from './tabs/OverviewTab';
import BookingsTab  from './tabs/BookingsTab';
import FleetTab     from './tabs/FleetTab';
import HandoversTab from './tabs/HandoversTab';
import NetworkTab   from './tabs/NetworkTab';
import ReviewsTab   from './tabs/ReviewsTab';
import ProfileTab   from './tabs/ProfileTab';

// ── CSS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import './VendorDashboard.css';

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import { isKYCComplete } from './vendorConstants';

const KYC_REQUIRED_TABS = ['bookings', 'fleet', 'network', 'handovers'];

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function VendorDashboard() {
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const [tab, setTab] = useState('overview');

    // ── Data state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [bookings,      setBookings]      = useState([]);
    const [vehicles,      setVehicles]      = useState([]);
    const [analytics,     setAnalytics]     = useState(null);
    const [profile,       setProfile]       = useState(null);
    const [network,       setNetwork]       = useState([]);
    const [handovers,     setHandovers]     = useState([]);
    const [cities,        setCities]        = useState([]);
    const [cityLocations, setCityLocations] = useState([]);
    const [vendorReviews, setVendorReviews] = useState([]);

    // ── UI state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [loading,      setLoading]      = useState(true);
    const [error,        setError]        = useState('');
    const [toast,        setToast]        = useState(null);
    const [showAddVehicle, setShowAddVehicle] = useState(false);

    // ── Vehicle form state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [vehicleForm, setVehicleForm] = useState({
        make: '', model: '', year: new Date().getFullYear(), colour: '',
        plate_number: '', segment: 'sedan', fuel_type: 'petrol',
        transmission: 'manual', capacity: 5, daily_rate: '',
        city: '', pickup_location: '', odometer_at_listing: 0,
    });
    const vf = k => e => setVehicleForm(p => ({ ...p, [k]: e.target.value }));

    // ── Doc / photo / availability state (passed into VehicleManageModal) ─────
    const [docUploads,   setDocUploads]   = useState({});
    const [photoUpload,  setPhotoUpload]  = useState({ file: null, angle: 'front', is_cover: false });
    const [availData,    setAvailData]    = useState({});
    const [blockInput,   setBlockInput]   = useState({});

    // ── Profile / KYC form state ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [profileEdit,  setProfileEdit]  = useState(false);
    const [profileForm,  setProfileForm]  = useState({});
    const [kycForm,      setKycForm]      = useState({
        aadhaar_number: '', pan_number: '', bank_account_name: '',
        bank_account_no: '', bank_ifsc: '', shop_opening_time: '',
        shop_closing_time: '', addr_line1: '', addr_line2: '', addr_line3: '',
        city: '', country: 'India', pincode: '', latitude: '', longitude: '',
    });
    const [kycFile,         setKycFile]         = useState(null);
    const [kycStateDisplay, setKycStateDisplay] = useState('');
    const [showMap,         setShowMap]         = useState(false);

    // ── Network form state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [networkForm, setNetworkForm] = useState({ city: '', max_vehicles: 3, handling_fee_override: '' });

    // ── Booking status filter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [bookingStatusFilter, setBookingStatusFilter] = useState('');

    // ── Modals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [selectedBooking,  setSelectedBooking]  = useState(null);
    const [bookingDetail,    setBookingDetail]    = useState(null);
    const [selectedVehicle,  setSelectedVehicle]  = useState(null);
    const [selectedHandover, setSelectedHandover] = useState(null);
    const [handoverNotes,    setHandoverNotes]    = useState({});
    const [handoverPhotoFile,setHandoverPhotoFile]= useState({});

    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const showToast   = useCallback((msg, type = 'success') => setToast({ msg, type }), []);
    const goToKYC     = useCallback(() => setTab('profile'), []);
    const kycComplete = isKYCComplete(profile);
    const showKYCGate = KYC_REQUIRED_TABS.includes(tab) && !kycComplete && profile !== null;

    // ── City locations (for vehicle form) ─────────────────────────────────────
    const loadCityLocations = useCallback(async (cityId) => {
        if (!cityId) { setCityLocations([]); return; }
        try {
            const { data } = await getCityLocations(cityId);
            setCityLocations(data.results || data);
        } catch { setCityLocations([]); }
    }, []);

    const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
    const highlightRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (vehicleForm.city) loadCityLocations(vehicleForm.city);
    }, [vehicleForm.city, loadCityLocations]);

    // Auto-fill state display from selected city
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!kycForm.city) { setKycStateDisplay(''); return; }
        const found = cities.find(c => String(c.id) === String(kycForm.city));
        setKycStateDisplay(found ? found.state : '');
    }, [kycForm.city, cities]);

    // ── Tab data loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const loadTab = useCallback(async (t) => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError('');
        try {
            const cityRes = await getCities();
            setCities(cityRes.data.results || cityRes.data);

            if (t === 'overview' || t === 'bookings') {
                const [b, a] = await Promise.all([
                    getVendorBookings(bookingStatusFilter || undefined),
                    getVendorAnalytics(),
                ]);
                setBookings(b.data.results || b.data);
                setAnalytics(a.data);
            }
            if (t === 'fleet') {
                const { data } = await getMyVehicles();
                setVehicles(data.results || data);
            }
            if (t === 'profile') {
                const { data } = await getVendorProfile();
                setProfile(data);
                setProfileForm({ shop_opening_time: data.shop_opening_time || '', shop_closing_time: data.shop_closing_time || '' });
                setKycForm({
                    aadhaar_number:    data.aadhaar_number    || '',
                    pan_number:        data.pan_number        || '',
                    bank_account_name: data.bank_account_name || '',
                    bank_account_no:   data.bank_account_no   || '',
                    bank_ifsc:         data.bank_ifsc         || '',
                    shop_opening_time: data.shop_opening_time || '',
                    shop_closing_time: data.shop_closing_time || '',
                    addr_line1:        data.addr_line1        || '',
                    addr_line2:        data.addr_line2        || '',
                    addr_line3:        data.addr_line3        || '',
                    city:    data.city_id ? String(data.city_id) : '',
                    country: data.country || 'India',
                    pincode: data.pincode || '',
                    latitude:  data.latitude  ? parseFloat(Number(data.latitude).toFixed(7))  : '',
                    longitude: data.longitude ? parseFloat(Number(data.longitude).toFixed(7)) : '',
                });
                if (data.state) setKycStateDisplay(data.state);
            }
            if (t === 'network') {
                const { data } = await getVendorNetwork();
                setNetwork(data.results || data);
            }
            if (t === 'handovers') {
                const { data } = await getMyHandovers();
                setHandovers(data.results || data);
            }
            if (t === 'reviews') {
                const { data } = await fetchVendorReviews(user.id, 'recency');
                setVendorReviews(data.results || data);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            setError(`Could not load ${t}. ${e.response?.data?.detail || e.message || ''}`);
        }
        setLoading(false);
    }, [bookingStatusFilter, user?.id]);

    useEffect(() => { loadTab(tab); }, [tab]);

    // Load profile silently on mount (for KYC gate and hero badges)
    useEffect(() => {
        getVendorProfile()
            .then(({ data }) => setProfile(data))
            .catch(() => {});
    }, []);

    // Re-fetch bookings when status filter changes
    useEffect(() => {
        if (tab === 'bookings' || tab === 'overview') {
            getVendorBookings(bookingStatusFilter || undefined)
                .then(({ data }) => setBookings(data.results || data))
                .catch(() => {});
        }
    }, [bookingStatusFilter]);


    useEffect(() => {
        const tabParam = searchParams.get('tab');
        if (tabParam && tabParam !== tab) setTab(tabParam);
        const highlight = searchParams.get('highlight');
        if (highlight) highlightRef.current = highlight;
    }, [searchParams]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (tab === 'bookings' && highlightRef.current && bookings.length > 0) {
            const match = bookings.find((b) => String(b.id) === String(highlightRef.current));
            if (match) openBookingDetail(match);
            highlightRef.current = null;
            const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
            next.delete('highlight');
            setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
        }
    }, [bookings, tab]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (tab === 'fleet' && highlightRef.current && vehicles.length > 0) {
            const match = vehicles.find((v) => String(v.id) === String(highlightRef.current));
            if (match) setSelectedVehicle(match);
            highlightRef.current = null;
            const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
            next.delete('highlight');
            setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
        }
    }, [vehicles, tab]);

    // ── Booking actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const openBookingDetail = async (booking) => {
        setSelectedBooking(booking);
        try {
            const { data } = await getVendorBookingDetail(booking.id);
            setBookingDetail(data);
        } catch { setBookingDetail(booking); }
    };

    const refreshBookingDetail = useCallback(async () => {
        if (!selectedBooking) return;
        try {
            const [detail, list] = await Promise.all([
                getVendorBookingDetail(selectedBooking.id),
                getVendorBookings(bookingStatusFilter || undefined),
            ]);
            setBookingDetail(detail.data);
            setBookings(list.data.results || list.data);
        } catch { showToast('Could not refresh.', 'error'); }
    }, [selectedBooking, bookingStatusFilter, showToast]);

    // ── Vehicle actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleAddVehicle = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        try {
            const fd = new FormData();
            Object.entries(vehicleForm).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (v !== '') fd.append(k, v); });
            await createVehicle(fd);
            const { data } = await getMyVehicles();      // re-fetch the authoritative list
            setVehicles(data.results || data);
            setShowAddVehicle(false);
            showToast('Vehicle registered! Upload RC, Insurance, PUC and 10+ photos to go LIVE.');
        } catch (e) {
            showToast(e.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(e.response.data) : 'Failed.', 'error');
        }
    };

    const handleToggleVehicle = async (vehicleId) => {
        try {
            const { data } = await toggleVehicleStatus(vehicleId);
            setVehicles(p => p.map(v => v.id === vehicleId ? { ...v, status: data.status } : v));
            showToast(`Vehicle ${data.status}.`);
        } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Toggle failed.', 'error'); }
    };

    const handleUpdateVehicle = async (vehicleId, form) => {
        const { data: updated } = await updateVehicle(vehicleId, form);
        const { data: list } = await getMyVehicles();
        const freshVehicles = list.results || list;
        setVehicles(freshVehicles);
        setSelectedVehicle((prev) =>
            prev?.id === vehicleId
                ? (freshVehicles.find(v => v.id === vehicleId) || updated || prev)
                : prev
        );
        return updated;
    };

    const loadAvailability = async (vehicleId) => {
        try {
            const { data } = await getVehicleAvailability(vehicleId, new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7));
            setAvailData(p => ({ ...p, [vehicleId]: data }));
        } catch { showToast('Could not load availability.', 'error'); }
    };

    const handleBlock = async (vehicleId) => {
        const dates = (blockInput[vehicleId] || '').split(',').map(d => d.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        if (!dates.length) { showToast('Enter comma-separated dates.', 'error'); return; }
        try {
            await blockAvailability(vehicleId, dates);
            await loadAvailability(vehicleId);
            setBlockInput(p => ({ ...p, [vehicleId]: '' }));
            showToast(`${dates.length} date(s) blocked.`);
        } catch { showToast('Failed.', 'error'); }
    };

    const handleUnblock = async (vehicleId, date) => {
        try {
            await unblockAvailability(vehicleId, [date]);
            await loadAvailability(vehicleId);
            showToast('Date unblocked.');
        } catch { showToast('Could not unblock.', 'error'); }
    };

    // ── Profile / KYC actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleProfileSave = async () => {
        try {
            await updateVendorProfile(profileForm);
            showToast('Profile updated.');
            setProfileEdit(false);
            await loadTab('profile');
        } catch { showToast('Update failed.', 'error'); }
    };

    const handleKYCSubmit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!kycForm.city)                          { showToast('Select a city.', 'error'); return; }
        if (!kycForm.latitude || !kycForm.longitude){ showToast('Pin your location on the map.', 'error'); return; }
        const fd = new FormData();
        ['aadhaar_number','pan_number','bank_account_name','bank_account_no','bank_ifsc',
         'shop_opening_time','shop_closing_time','addr_line1','addr_line2','addr_line3',
         'city','country','pincode','latitude','longitude'].forEach(k => { if (kycForm[k]) fd.append(k, kycForm[k]); });
        if (kycFile) fd.append('kyc_document', kycFile);
        try {
            await uploadVendorKYC(fd);
            showToast('KYC submitted!');
            await loadTab('profile');
        } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(e.response.data) : 'Failed.', 'error'); }
    };

    // ── Network actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleJoinNetwork = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!networkForm.city) { showToast('Select a city.', 'error'); return; }
        try {
            await joinNetwork({ city: networkForm.city, max_vehicles: networkForm.max_vehicles });
            showToast('Joined!');
            await loadTab('network');
        } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed.', 'error'); }
    };

    const handleLeaveNetwork = async (id) => {
        if (!window.confirm('Leave this city network?')) return;
        try {
            await leaveNetwork(id);
            setNetwork(p => p.filter(n => n.id !== id));
            showToast('Left.');
        } catch { showToast('Failed.', 'error'); }
    };

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// VendorMediaComponents.jsx
// PhotoLightbox  — full-screen image carousel (keyboard navigable)
// KYCDocumentViewer — shows vendor KYC doc as thumbnail / PDF link
// MapPicker     — Leaflet map for vendor pickup location pin
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

// ── Photo lightbox ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function PhotoLightbox({ photos, initialIndex, onClose }) {
    const [current, setCurrent] = useState(initialIndex || 0);

    useEffect(() => {
        const h = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape')      onClose();
            if (e.key === 'ArrowRight')  setCurrent(c => Math.min(c + 1, photos.length - 1));
            if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')   setCurrent(c => Math.max(c - 1, 0));
        };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', h);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', h);
    }, [photos.length, onClose]);

    return (
        <div
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 9999, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.88)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}
        >
            <button
                onClick={onClose}
                style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 20, right: 24, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', color: '#fff', borderRadius: 8, padding: '6px 14px', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}
            >
                ✕ Close
            </button>
            <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16 }}>
                <button
                    onClick={() => setCurrent(c => Math.max(c - 1, 0))}
                    disabled={current === 0}
                    style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', color: '#fff', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 16px', fontSize: 18, cursor: current === 0 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', opacity: current === 0 ? 0.3 : 1 }}
                >‹</button>
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    <img
                        src={photos[current].image || photos[current].url || photos[current]}
                        alt={photos[current].angle || 'photo'}
                        style={{ maxWidth: 'min(80vw, 900px)', maxHeight: '70vh', objectFit: 'contain', borderRadius: 12 }}
                    />
                    {photos[current].angle && (
                        <div style={{ marginTop: 10, fontSize: 12, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)', textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
                            {photos[current].angle} · {current + 1}/{photos.length}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
                <button
                    onClick={() => setCurrent(c => Math.min(c + 1, photos.length - 1))}
                    disabled={current === photos.length - 1}
                    style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', color: '#fff', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 16px', fontSize: 18, cursor: current === photos.length - 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', opacity: current === photos.length - 1 ? 0.3 : 1 }}
                >›</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// ── KYC document viewer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function KYCDocumentViewer({ profile }) {
    const [lightboxOpen, setLightboxOpen] = useState(false);
    if (!profile?.kyc_document) return null;

    const isPDF   = profile.kyc_document.toLowerCase().includes('.pdf');
    const isImage = /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)$/i.test(profile.kyc_document);

    return (
        <div className="vd-kyc-doc-viewer">
            <div className="vd-kyc-doc-viewer__label">KYC Document</div>
            {isImage ? (
                <>
                    <div className="vd-kyc-doc-viewer__thumb" onClick={() => setLightboxOpen(true)}>
                        <img src={profile.kyc_document} alt="KYC Document" />
                        <div className="vd-kyc-doc-viewer__overlay"><span>🔍 Click to enlarge</span></div>
                    </div>
                    {lightboxOpen && (
                        <PhotoLightbox
                            photos={[{ image: profile.kyc_document, angle: 'KYC Document' }]}
                            initialIndex={0}
                            onClose={() => setLightboxOpen(false)}
                        />
                    )}
                </>
            ) : isPDF ? (
                <a href={profile.kyc_document} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="vd-kyc-doc-viewer__pdf-link">
                    <span>📄</span><span>View PDF Document</span>
                </a>
            ) : (
                <a href={profile.kyc_document} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="vd-btn vd-btn--outline vd-btn--sm">
                    View Document
                </a>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Map picker ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function MapPicker({ lat, lng, onLocationSelect }) {
    const mapRef        = useRef(null);
    const leafletMapRef = useRef(null);
    const markerRef     = useRef(null);
    const [mapReady,    setMapReady]    = useState(false);
    const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState('');
    const [searching,   setSearching]   = useState(false);

    // Load Leaflet dynamically
    useEffect(() => {
        if (window.L) { setMapReady(true); return; }
        const link   = document.createElement('link');
        link.rel     = 'stylesheet';
        link.href    = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css';
        document.head.appendChild(link);
        const script    = document.createElement('script');
        script.src      = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js';
        script.onload   = () => setMapReady(true);
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }, []);

    // Initialise map once Leaflet is ready
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!mapReady || !mapRef.current || leafletMapRef.current) return;
        const L   = window.L;
        const map = L.map(mapRef.current).setView([lat || 20.5937, lng || 78.9629], lat ? 15 : 5);
        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(map);

        const makeIcon = () => L.divIcon({
            className: '',
            html: `<div style="width:28px;height:28px;background:#0DB89E;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 0;transform:rotate(-45deg);border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3);"></div>`,
            iconSize: [28, 28], iconAnchor: [14, 28],
        });

        if (lat && lng) {
            markerRef.current = L.marker([lat, lng], { icon: makeIcon(), draggable: true }).addTo(map);
            markerRef.current.on('dragend', e => {
                const { lat: la, lng: lo } = e.target.getLatLng();
                onLocationSelect(la, lo);
            });
        }

        map.on('click', e => {
            const { lat: la, lng: lo } = e.latlng;
            if (markerRef.current) {
                markerRef.current.setLatLng([la, lo]);
            } else {
                markerRef.current = L.marker([la, lo], { icon: makeIcon(), draggable: true }).addTo(map);
                markerRef.current.on('dragend', ev => {
                    const { lat: dla, lng: dlo } = ev.target.getLatLng();
                    onLocationSelect(dla, dlo);
                });
            }
            onLocationSelect(la, lo);
        });

        leafletMapRef.current = map;
        setTimeout(() => map.invalidateSize(), 200);
    }, [mapReady]); // eslint-disable-line

    // Sync marker when lat/lng props change
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!leafletMapRef.current || !window.L || !lat || !lng) return;
        if (markerRef.current) markerRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
        leafletMapRef.current.setView([lat, lng], 15);
    }, [lat, lng]);

    const handleSearch = async () => {
        if (!searchInput.trim()) return;
        setSearching(true);
        try {
            const res  = await fetch(`https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchInput)}&format=json&limit=1`);
            const data = await res.json();
            if (data.length > 0) {
                const la = parseFloat(data[0].lat);
                const lo = parseFloat(data[0].lon);
                leafletMapRef.current.setView([la, lo], 16);
                const L      = window.L;
                const icon   = L.divIcon({ className: '', html: `<div style="width:28px;height:28px;background:#0DB89E;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 0;transform:rotate(-45deg);border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3);"></div>`, iconSize: [28, 28], iconAnchor: [14, 28] });
                if (markerRef.current) {
                    markerRef.current.setLatLng([la, lo]);
                } else {
                    markerRef.current = L.marker([la, lo], { icon, draggable: true }).addTo(leafletMapRef.current);
                    markerRef.current.on('dragend', e => {
                        const { lat: dla, lng: dlo } = e.target.getLatLng();
                        onLocationSelect(dla, dlo);
                    });
                }
                onLocationSelect(la, lo);
            }
        } catch { /* ignore network errors */ }
        setSearching(false);
    };

    return (
        <div className="vd-map-picker">
            <div className="vd-map-picker__toolbar">
                <div className="vd-map-picker__hint">📍 Click the map to pin your exact pickup location.</div>
                <div className="vd-map-picker__search">
                    <input
                        className="vd-input"
                        placeholder="Search address…"
                        value={searchInput}
                        onChange={e => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
                        onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSearch()}
                        style={{ flex: 1 }}
                    />
                    <button className="vd-upload-btn" onClick={handleSearch} disabled={searching}>
                        {searching ? '…' : 'Search'}
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
            {!mapReady && (
                <div className="vd-map-picker__loading">
                    <div className="vd-spinner" /> Loading map…
                </div>
            )}
            <div ref={mapRef} className="vd-map-picker__canvas" style={{ display: mapReady ? 'block' : 'none' }} />
            {lat && lng && (
                <div className="vd-map-picker__coords">
                    <span>📌 {parseFloat(lat).toFixed(6)}, {parseFloat(lng).toFixed(6)}</span>
                    <button className="vd-link-btn vd-link-btn--danger" onClick={() => onLocationSelect(null, null)}>✕ Clear</button>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Toast notification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function Toast({ msg, type, onDone }) {
    useEffect(() => {
        const t = setTimeout(onDone, 3500);
        return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }, [onDone]);

    return (
        <div className={`vd-toast vd-toast--${type}`}>
            {type === 'success'
                ? <span style={{ width: 20, height: 20, borderRadius: '50%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, flexShrink: 0, background: '#D1FAE5', color: '#059669' }}>✓</span>
                : <span style={{ width: 20, height: 20, borderRadius: '50%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, flexShrink: 0, background: '#FEE2E2', color: '#EF4444' }}>!</span>}
            {msg}
        </div>
    );
}

}

                type={type}

                min={min}
                max={max}

    );
}

                        : <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>
                )}

        </Field>
    );
}
