            .catch(() => setRevenueShare(null))
            .finally(() => setRevenueLoading(false));
    }, [h.booking]);

    const handleAction = async (action) => {
        try {
            const notes = handoverNotes[h.id] || '';
            if      (action === 'confirm')             await confirmHandoverReceipt(h.id, notes);
            else if (action === 'inspection_complete') await completeHandoverInspection(h.id);
            else if (action === 'retrieval')           await arrangeHandoverRetrieval(h.id);
            else if (action === 'grant_sublist')       await grantSublistPermission(h.id);
            else if (action === 'revoke_sublist')      await revokeSublistPermission(h.id);
            showToast('Action completed!');
            onRefresh();
        } catch (e) { showToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Action failed.', 'error'); }
    };

    const handlePhotoUpload = async () => {
        const file = handoverPhotoFile[h.id];
        if (!file) { showToast('Select a photo.', 'error'); return; }
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('image', file);
        try {
            await uploadHandoverPhoto(h.id, fd);
            showToast('Photo uploaded!');
        } catch { showToast('Upload failed.', 'error'); }
    };

    const s = HANDOVER_STATUS_CLR[h.status] || { bg: '#F3F4F6', color: '#6B7280' };

    // Is the current vendor the one RECEIVING this handover (i.e. offering parking)?
    // If so, their earning is partner_handling_fee. If they're the ORIGINATING
    // vendor (the one whose car this is), their share is originating_vendor_amt.
    const isReceivingVendor = !!h.receiving_vendor_name;

    return (
        <div className="vd-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
            <div className="vd-modal" style={{ maxWidth: 600 }} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                <div className="vd-modal__head">
                    <div>
                        <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 800 }}>{h.vehicle_display || `Handover #${h.id}`}</h2>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                            <span className="vd-badge" style={{ background: s.bg, color: s.color }}>{h.status}</span>
                            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--vm)' }}>{h.booking_ref}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={onClose} className="vd-close-btn">✕ Close</button>
                </div>

                <div style={{ padding: '18px 20px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, overflowY: 'auto', maxHeight: '65vh' }}>
                    <div className="vd-info-group">
                        <div className="vd-info-group__title">Handover Info</div>
                        {[
                            ['Originating Vendor', h.originating_vendor_name],
                            ['Return Point',       h.return_point_name || '—'],
                            ['Days Held',         `${h.days_held || 0}d`],
                            ['Photos Uploaded',    h.handover_photos_uploaded ? 'Yes' : 'No'],
                            ['Full Inspection',    h.full_inspection_done ? 'Done' : 'Pending'],
                        ].map(([l, v]) => <InfoRow key={l} label={l} value={v} />)}
                    </div>

                    {/* ── NEW: Revenue Share panel ── */}
                    <div className="vd-info-group" style={{ background: '#F0FDF4', borderColor: '#86EFAC' }}>
                        <div className="vd-info-group__title" style={{ color: '#059669', borderBottomColor: '#059669' }}>
                            💰 Revenue Share
                        </div>
                        {revenueLoading ? (
                            <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--vm)' }}>Loading…</p>
                        ) : !revenueShare ? (
                            <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--vm)' }}>Not yet calculated for this booking.</p>
                        ) : (
                            <>
                                <InfoRow label="Total Booking Value" value={`₹${parseFloat(revenueShare.total_revenue).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`} />
                                {isReceivingVendor ? (
                                    <>
                                        <InfoRow
                                            label="You Earn (Handling Fee)"
                                            value={<strong style={{ color: '#059669' }}>₹{parseFloat(revenueShare.partner_handling_fee).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</strong>}

                                            Shown after the platform's facilitation commission has already been deducted.
                                        </p>
                                    </>
                                ) : (
                                    <>
                                        <InfoRow
                                            label="You Earn (Originating Vendor)"
                                            value={<strong style={{ color: '#059669' }}>₹{parseFloat(revenueShare.originating_vendor_amt).toLocaleString('en-IN')} ({revenueShare.originating_vendor_pct}%)</strong>}
                                        />

function Stars({ value, size = 18 }) {
    return (
        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 1 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(n => (
                <span key={n} style={{ fontSize: size, color: n <= (value || 0) ? '#E8A020' : '#E5E7EB', lineHeight: 1 }}>★</span>
            ))}
        </span>
    );
}

// VehicleManageModal.jsx
// Full vehicle management modal: pipeline progress bar, docs sub-tab,
// photos sub-tab, availability sub-tab, edit-details sub-tab, status toggle.
//
// Fix: Documents tab — image files now open in PhotoLightbox (same-page modal)
// instead of a new browser tab, consistent with the Photos sub-tab behaviour.
// PDF and non-image files still open in a new tab (no lightbox for those).
//
// Edit Details sub-tab: vendors can update previously-submitted fleet info.
// If the vehicle has already passed initial admin review, the submitted
// values are NOT applied immediately — the backend stages them in
// pending_changes and sets needs_review=True. Live values stay unchanged
// until an admin approves. This modal reflects that: it shows the pending
// diff (if any) and labels the submit button accordingly.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { PhotoLightbox } from '../VendorMediaComponents';
import { VEHICLE_STATUS_CLR, DOC_TYPES, ANGLES, fmtDatetime } from '../vendorConstants';
import { uploadVehicleDoc, uploadVehiclePhoto } from '../../../services/api';

const PIPELINE = ['PENDING_DOCS', 'DOCS_SUBMITTED', 'ADMIN_APPROVED', 'CERTIFIED', 'LIVE'];

// Statuses that mean the vehicle has already been through admin review at
// least once — editing core details past this point triggers the
// stage-for-approval behaviour on the backend.
const REVIEWED_STATUSES = ['ADMIN_APPROVED', 'CERTIFIED', 'LIVE', 'INACTIVE'];

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const isImageUrl = url =>
    url && /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)(\?.*)?$/i.test(url);

// ── Edit Details form ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EditDetailsForm({ vehicle: v, onSave, showToast }) {
    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        make:             v.make || '',
        model:            v.model || '',
        year:             v.year || '',
        colour:           v.colour || '',
        segment:          v.segment || '',
        fuel_type:        v.fuel_type || '',
        transmission:     v.transmission || '',
        capacity:         v.capacity || '',
        daily_rate:       v.daily_rate || '',
        current_odometer: v.current_odometer ?? v.odometer_at_listing ?? '',
    });
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

    const set = key => e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [key]: e.target.value }));

    const alreadyReviewed = REVIEWED_STATUSES.includes(v.status);
    const pending = v.pending_changes_readable || [];

    const distanceSinceVerified =
        v.last_verified_odometer != null && form.current_odometer !== ''
            ? Number(form.current_odometer) - v.last_verified_odometer
            : null;

    const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            await onSave(form);
            if (alreadyReviewed) {
                showToast('Changes submitted — awaiting admin approval. Live values are unchanged for now.');
            } else {
                showToast('Vehicle details updated.');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showToast(
                err.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(err.response.data) : 'Update failed.',
                'error',
            );
        }
        setSaving(false);
    };

    return (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            {alreadyReviewed && (
                <div style={{
                    background: '#FFFBEB', border: '1px solid #FCD34D', borderRadius: 8,
                    padding: '10px 12px', fontSize: 12, color: '#92400E', marginBottom: 14,
                    display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-start',
                }}>
                    <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>⚠</span>
                    <span>
                        This vehicle has already been reviewed by admin. Changes here will NOT
                        go live immediately — they'll be submitted for admin approval, and the
                        currently approved details stay visible to customers and admin until
                        approved.
                    </span>
                </div>
            )}

            {pending.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{
                    background: '#FEF3C7', border: '1px solid #FCD34D', borderRadius: 8,
                    padding: '10px 12px', fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 14,
                }}>
                    <strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 6, color: '#92400E' }}>
                        Pending admin review:
                    </strong>
                    {pending.map(c => (
                        <div key={c.field} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 10, color: '#78350F' }}>
                            <span>{c.label}</span>
                            <span><s style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>{c.old_value ?? '—'}</s> → {c.new_value ?? '—'}</span>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="vd-fg vd-fg--3">
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Make</label>
                    <input className="vd-input" value={form.make} onChange={set('make')} required />
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Model</label>
                    <input className="vd-input" value={form.model} onChange={set('model')} required />
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Year</label>
                    <input className="vd-input" type="number" value={form.year} onChange={set('year')} required />
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Colour</label>
                    <input className="vd-input" value={form.colour} onChange={set('colour')} />
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Daily Rate (₹)</label>
                    <input className="vd-input" type="number" value={form.daily_rate} onChange={set('daily_rate')} required />
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Seats</label>
                    <input className="vd-input" type="number" value={form.capacity} onChange={set('capacity')} required />
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Segment</label>
                    <select className="vd-input vd-select" value={form.segment} onChange={set('segment')}>
                        {['hatchback', 'sedan', 'suv', 'luxury', 'van', 'truck'].map(s => (
                            <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Fuel</label>
                    <select className="vd-input vd-select" value={form.fuel_type} onChange={set('fuel_type')}>
                        {['petrol', 'diesel', 'electric', 'hybrid', 'cng'].map(f => (
                            <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Transmission</label>
                    <select className="vd-input vd-select" value={form.transmission} onChange={set('transmission')}>
                        {['manual', 'automatic'].map(t => (
                            <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* ── Odometer / re-verification block ── */}
            <div style={{
                marginTop: 16, background: 'var(--vs2)', border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)',
                borderRadius: 10, padding: 14, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8,
            }}>
                <div className="vd-form-field">
                    <label>Current Odometer (km)</label>
                    <input
                        className="vd-input"
                        type="number"
                        value={form.current_odometer}
                        onChange={set('current_odometer')}
                        placeholder="e.g. 42500"
                    />
                </div>

                {v.last_verified_odometer != null && (
                    <p style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--vm)', margin: 0 }}>
                        Last verified at {Number(v.last_verified_odometer).toLocaleString('en-IN')} km.
                        {distanceSinceVerified != null && distanceSinceVerified >= 0 && (
                            <> {distanceSinceVerified.toLocaleString('en-IN')} km travelled since then.</>
                        )}
                    </p>
                )}

                {v.needs_reverification && (
                    <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#D97706', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0 }}>
                        🔁 This vehicle is currently flagged for admin re-verification due to distance travelled.
                    </p>
                )}

                {v.needs_review && (
                    <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#D97706', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0 }}>
                        ✏️ You have changes awaiting admin approval.
                        {v.last_edited_at && <> Submitted {fmtDatetime(v.last_edited_at)}.</>}
                    </p>
                )}
            </div>

            <button type="submit" className="vd-btn vd-btn--primary" style={{ marginTop: 16 }} disabled={saving}>
                {saving ? 'Saving…' : alreadyReviewed ? 'Submit for Admin Approval' : 'Save Changes'}
            </button>
        </form>
    );
}

            setLightboxIdx(0);
        } else {
            window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');

        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('image',    photoUpload.file);
        fd.append('angle',    photoUpload.angle);
        fd.append('is_cover', photoUpload.is_cover ? 'true' : 'false');

            await uploadVehiclePhoto(v.id, fd);

        } catch {
            showToast('Photo upload failed.', 'error');
        }

    // ── Edit details save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSaveDetails = async (form) => {

        onRefresh();
    };

                                </span>
                            )}

                                {v.status === 'LIVE' ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}

// Tapping a card opens BookingDetailPanel via onOpenBooking (existing flow).
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import DataTable from '../../../components/common/DataTable';
import { StatusBadge } from '../VendorShared';
import { STATUS_CLR } from '../vendorConstants';

// ── Status filter options ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
    { value: '',          label: 'All'       },
    { value: 'PENDING',   label: 'Pending'   },
    { value: 'CONFIRMED', label: 'Confirmed' },
    { value: 'ACTIVE',    label: 'Active'    },
    { value: 'COMPLETED', label: 'Completed' },
    { value: 'CANCELLED', label: 'Cancelled' },
];

// ── Mobile card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobileBookingCard({ booking: b, onOpenBooking }) {
    const customer = b.customer_name || b.customer?.full_name || '—';
    const amount   = parseFloat(b.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN');

    return (
        <button
            className="cd-mob-booking-card"
            onClick={() => onOpenBooking(b)}
            aria-label={`View booking ${b.booking_ref}`}
        >
            {/* Row 1: ref + status */}
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--head">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__ref">{b.booking_ref}</span>
                <StatusBadge status={b.status} />
            </div>

            {/* Row 2: customer name + amount */}
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row" style={{ justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__vehicle">{customer}</span>
                <span className="vd-mob-booking-card__amount">₹{amount}</span>
            </div>

            {/* Row 3: vehicle */}
            {b.vehicle_display && (
                <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row">
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--vt2)' }}>{b.vehicle_display}</span>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Row 4: dates + flags + chevron */}
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--footer">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__dates">
                    {b.pickup_date || '—'}{' → '}{b.return_date || '—'}
                    {b.rental_days ? ` · ${b.rental_days}d` : ''}
                </span>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                    {b.payment_captured && (
                        <span className="vd-mob-flag vd-mob-flag--ok">Paid</span>
                    )}
                    {b.agreement_signed && (
                        <span className="vd-mob-flag vd-mob-flag--ok">Signed</span>
                    )}
                    <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__chevron" aria-hidden="true">›</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </button>
    );
}

// ── Mobile list ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobileBookingList({ bookings, onOpenBooking }) {
    const [search,       setSearch]       = useState('');
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = bookings;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter(
                b =>
                    (b.booking_ref          || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (b.customer_name        || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (b.customer?.full_name  || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (b.vehicle_display      || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
            );
        }
        if (statusFilter) {
            result = result.filter(b => b.status === statusFilter);
        }
        return result;
    }, [bookings, search, statusFilter]);

    return (
        <div className="cd-mob-bookings">
            {/* Search */}
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__search-wrap">
                <svg className="cd-mob-bookings__search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <input
                    className="cd-mob-bookings__search vd-mob-search"
                    type="search"
                    placeholder="Search by ref, customer, vehicle…"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    aria-label="Search bookings"
                />
            </div>

            {/* Status pills */}
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__pills" role="group" aria-label="Filter by status">
                {STATUS_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
                    <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        className={`cd-mob-bookings__pill vd-mob-pill${statusFilter === opt.value ? ' cd-mob-bookings__pill--active vd-mob-pill--active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => setStatusFilter(opt.value)}
                    >
                        {opt.label}
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>

            {(search || statusFilter) && (
                <p className="cd-mob-bookings__count">
                    {filtered.length} of {bookings.length} booking{bookings.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </p>
            )}

            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vd-empty" style={{ padding: '40px 24px' }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 32 }}>📅</span>
                    <p>No bookings match your search.</p>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="cd-mob-bookings__list">
                    {filtered.map((b, i) => (
                        <MobileBookingCard key={b.id ?? i} booking={b} onOpenBooking={onOpenBooking} />
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

// ── Mobile fleet list ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobileFleetList({ vehicles, onSelectVehicle }) {

    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {

        }

                    type="search"
                    placeholder="Search by make, model, plate…"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    aria-label="Search fleet"
                />
            </div>

            {/* Status pills */}
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__pills" role="group" aria-label="Filter by status">

                    >
                        {opt.label}
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>

            {(search || statusFilter) && (
                <p className="cd-mob-bookings__count">
                    {filtered.length} of {vehicles.length} vehicle{vehicles.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </p>
            )}

            {filtered.length === 0 ? (

                    <p>No vehicles match your search.</p>

// ── Mobile list ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobileHandoverList({ handovers, onSelectHandover }) {
    const [search,       setSearch]       = useState('');
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = handovers;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter(
                h =>
                    (h.vehicle_display           || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (h.booking_ref               || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (h.originating_vendor_name   || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
            );
        }
        if (statusFilter) {
            result = result.filter(h => h.status === statusFilter);
        }
        return result;
    }, [handovers, search, statusFilter]);

    return (
        <div className="cd-mob-bookings">
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__search-wrap">
                <svg className="cd-mob-bookings__search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <input
                    className="cd-mob-bookings__search vd-mob-search"
                    type="search"
                    placeholder="Search handovers…"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    aria-label="Search handovers"
                />
            </div>

            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__pills" role="group" aria-label="Filter by status">
                {STATUS_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
                    <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        className={`cd-mob-bookings__pill vd-mob-pill${statusFilter === opt.value ? ' cd-mob-bookings__pill--active vd-mob-pill--active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => setStatusFilter(opt.value)}
                    >
                        {opt.label}
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>

            {(search || statusFilter) && (
                <p className="cd-mob-bookings__count">
                    {filtered.length} of {handovers.length} handover{handovers.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </p>
            )}

            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vd-empty" style={{ padding: '40px 24px' }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 32 }}>📦</span>
                    <p>No handovers match your search.</p>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="cd-mob-bookings__list">
                    {filtered.map((h, i) => (
                        <MobileHandoverCard key={h.id ?? i} handover={h} onSelectHandover={onSelectHandover} />
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function Stars({ value, size = 14 }) {
    return (
        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 1 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(n => (
                <span key={n} style={{ fontSize: size, color: n <= (value || 0) ? '#E8A020' : '#E5E7EB', lineHeight: 1 }}>★</span>
            ))}
        </span>
    );

// ── Mobile review card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobileReviewCard({ review: r, onSelectReview }) {
    const ratingColor = (r.vendor_rating || 0) >= 4 ? '#059669'
                      : (r.vendor_rating || 0) === 3 ? '#D97706'
                      : '#EF4444';
    const ratingBg    = (r.vendor_rating || 0) >= 4 ? '#D1FAE5'
                      : (r.vendor_rating || 0) === 3 ? '#FEF3C7'
                      : '#FEE2E2';

    return (
        <button
            className="cd-mob-booking-card"
            onClick={() => onSelectReview(r)}
            aria-label={`View review from ${r.customer_name || 'customer'}`}
        >
            {/* Row 1: customer + overall rating chip */}
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--head">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__vehicle" style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {r.customer_name || '—'}
                </span>
                <span style={{
                    fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, padding: '2px 8px',
                    borderRadius: 999, background: ratingBg, color: ratingColor,
                    flexShrink: 0,
                }}>
                    ★ {r.vendor_rating || 0}/5
                </span>
            </div>

            {/* Row 2: vehicle */}
            {r.vehicle_display && (
                <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row">
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--vt2)' }}>{r.vehicle_display}</span>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Row 3: inline star ratings */}
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
                <span className="cd-mob-review-rating-group">
                    <span className="cd-mob-review-rating-lbl">Vendor</span>
                    <Stars value={r.vendor_rating} />
                </span>
                <span className="cd-mob-review-rating-group">
                    <span className="cd-mob-review-rating-lbl">Vehicle</span>
                    <Stars value={r.vehicle_rating} />
                </span>
            </div>

            {/* Row 4: review excerpt + date + chevron */}
            <div className="cd-mob-booking-card__row cd-mob-booking-card__row--footer">
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__dates" style={{ fontStyle: r.review_text ? 'italic' : 'normal' }}>
                    {r.review_text
                        ? `"${r.review_text.slice(0, 50)}${r.review_text.length > 50 ? '…' : '"'}`
                        : fmtDate(r.created_at)}
                </span>
                <span className="cd-mob-booking-card__chevron" aria-hidden="true">›</span>

const RATING_OPTIONS = [
    { value: '',  label: 'All' },
    { value: '5', label: '5 ★' },
    { value: '4', label: '4 ★' },
    { value: '3', label: '3 ★' },
    { value: '2', label: '2 ★' },
    { value: '1', label: '1 ★' },
];

// ── Mobile review list ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MobileReviewList({ reviews, onSelectReview }) {
    const [search,       setSearch]       = useState('');
    const [ratingFilter, setRatingFilter] = useState('');

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = reviews;
        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter(
                r =>
                    (r.customer_name   || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (r.vehicle_display || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (r.review_text     || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
            );
        }
        if (ratingFilter) {
            result = result.filter(r => String(r.vendor_rating) === ratingFilter);
        }
        return result;
    }, [reviews, search, ratingFilter]);

    return (
        <div className="cd-mob-bookings">
            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__search-wrap">
                <svg className="cd-mob-bookings__search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                    <path d="M13 13l3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <input
                    className="cd-mob-bookings__search vd-mob-search"
                    type="search"
                    placeholder="Search reviews…"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    aria-label="Search reviews"
                />
            </div>

            <div className="cd-mob-bookings__pills" role="group" aria-label="Filter by rating">
                {RATING_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
                    <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        className={`cd-mob-bookings__pill vd-mob-pill${ratingFilter === opt.value ? ' cd-mob-bookings__pill--active vd-mob-pill--active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => setRatingFilter(opt.value)}
                    >
                        {opt.label}
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>

            {(search || ratingFilter) && (
                <p className="cd-mob-bookings__count">
                    {filtered.length} of {reviews.length} review{reviews.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </p>
            )}

            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vd-empty" style={{ padding: '40px 24px' }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 32 }}>💬</span>
                    <p>No reviews match your search.</p>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="cd-mob-bookings__list">
                    {filtered.map((r, i) => (
                        <MobileReviewCard key={r.id ?? i} review={r} onSelectReview={onSelectReview} />
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export default function ReviewsTab({ userId, profile, initialReviews, initialOrdering }) {

    const [ordering,       setOrdering]       = useState(initialOrdering || 'recency');
    const [loading,        setLoading]        = useState(false);
    const [selectedReview, setSelectedReview] = useState(null);

    const changeOrdering = async (val) => {
        setOrdering(val);
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const { data } = await fetchVendorReviews(userId, val);
            setReviews(data.results || data);
        } catch { setReviews([]); }
        finally { setLoading(false); }
    };

    return (
        <div className="vd-section">

                        {[['recency', '🕐 Newest'], ['rating', '★ Rating']].map(([val, label]) => (
                            <button
                                key={val}
                                className={`vd-btn vd-btn--sm ${ordering === val ? 'vd-btn--primary' : 'vd-btn--ghost'}`}
                                onClick={() => changeOrdering(val)}
                            >
                                {label}
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                }
            >
                {reviews.length > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(100px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                        {[
                            [reviews.length, 'Total', '#1D4ED8'],
                            [(reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.vendor_rating || 0), 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1), 'Avg Rating', '#E8A020'],
                            [reviews.filter(r => (r.vendor_rating || 0) >= 4).length, 'Positive', '#059669'],
                            [reviews.filter(r => (r.vendor_rating || 0) <= 2).length, 'Critical', '#EF4444'],
                        ].map(([v, l, color]) => (
                            <div key={l} style={{ background: 'var(--vs2)', border: '1px solid var(--vbdr)', borderRadius: 10, padding: '10px 12px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                                <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, color }}>{v}</div>
                                <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '.5px', color: 'var(--vm)', marginTop: 3 }}>{l}</div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                )}
            </SectionCard>

            {loading ? (
                <div className="vd-loading"><div className="vd-spinner" /> Loading reviews…</div>
            ) : (
                <>
                    {/* Desktop */}
                    <div className="cd-bookings-desktop">
                        <DataTable

=== PATH: D:\Work\car_rental_service\frontend\src\services\api.js ===
import axios from "axios";

const BASE_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000/api";

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
});

api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("access_token");
  if (token) config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  return config;
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (err) => {
    const original = err.config;
    if (err.response?.status === 401 && !original._retry) {
      original._retry = true;
      try {
        const refresh = localStorage.getItem("refresh_token");
        const { data } = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/users/token/refresh/`, { refresh });
        localStorage.setItem("access_token", data.access);
        original.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${data.access}`;
        return api(original);
      } catch {
        localStorage.clear();
        window.location.href = "/";
      }
    }
    return Promise.reject(err);
  }
);

// ── Auth ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── HARDCODED (DEV) — ACTIVE ──────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Send OTP to customer's phone number for KYC verification.
 * DEV: Always succeeds, OTP is "123456" (logged to console).
 * @param {string} phone - The phone number to send OTP to
 * @param {string} email - The user's email (used to look up the account)
 */
export const sendKYCPhoneOTP = async (phone, email) => {
  console.log(`[DEV] KYC Phone OTP → ${phone} (account: ${email}). Use 123456`);
  // Simulate network delay
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
  return { data: { message: `OTP sent to ${phone}. Use 123456 in development.` } };
};

/**
 * Verify OTP entered by customer for phone KYC.
 * DEV: Accepts "123456" only.
 * @param {string} email - The user's email (account identifier)
 * @param {string} code - The 6-digit OTP entered by the user
 */
export const verifyKYCPhoneOTP = async (email, code) => {
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
  if (code === "123456") {
    return { data: { valid: true, message: "Phone number verified successfully." } };
  }
  const err = new Error("Invalid OTP");
  err.response = { data: { error: "Invalid OTP. In development, use 123456." } };
  throw err;
};

/**
 * Send OTP to customer's email address for KYC verification.
 * DEV: Always succeeds, OTP is "123456" (logged to console).
 * @param {string} email - The email address to verify
 */

// NEW: Customer submitted reviews (read-only listing of own reviews)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Fetch all reviews submitted by the currently logged-in customer.
 *
 * The existing backend has no dedicated "my reviews" endpoint, so we
 * derive the list by fetching completed bookings.  Each completed
 * booking's detail includes a `review` sub-object when present.
 *
 * We accept a pre-loaded list of completed booking details to avoid
 * redundant network calls from the dashboard, or fetch them here.
 *
 * Usage in CustomerDashboard:
 *   const reviews = await getMySubmittedReviews(completedBookingDetails);
 */
export const getMySubmittedReviews = async (completedBookingDetails = []) => {
  // Extract reviews from already-fetched booking detail objects
  const reviews = completedBookingDetails
    .filter(b => b.review)
    .map(b => ({
      booking_id:      b.id,
      booking_ref:     b.booking_ref,
      vehicle_display: b.vehicle_display ||
        `${b.vehicle?.year || ''} ${b.vehicle?.make || ''} ${b.vehicle?.model || ''}`.trim(),
      return_date:     b.return_date,
      vendor_rating:   b.review.vendor_rating,
      vehicle_rating:  b.review.vehicle_rating,
      review_text:     b.review.review_text,
      created_at:      b.review.created_at,
    }));
  return { data: { results: reviews } };
};

export const updateTargetingRule= (id, d)  => api.patch(`/personalization/rules/${id}/`, d);
export const deleteTargetingRule= (id)     => api.delete(`/personalization/rules/${id}/`);
export const runRuleNow         = (id)     => api.post(`/personalization/rules/${id}/run-now/`);

export const getRuleExecutionLogs = (params) => api.get('/personalization/logs/', { params });
export const runScheduledSweep    = ()       => api.post('/personalization/run-scheduled-sweep/');

export default api;
